title: Rare genetic variability in human drug target genes modulates drug response and can guide precision medicine
key_claim_en: Of 1094 population variants within 6 Å of bound drugs (17.5% carrier frequency), 18 of 19 tested in vitro abrogated function or altered drug effect. ACE variants left baseline activity unchanged yet differed more than 10-fold in ACE-inhibitor response.
key_claim_zh: 在 1094 个位于结合药物 6 Å 范围内的人群变异中（携带者频率 17.5%），体外检测的 19 个变异里有 18 个丧失功能或改变药物效应。ACE 变异使基线活性保持不变，但对 ACE 抑制剂的响应相差超过 10 倍。
so_what_en: ACE variants change the drug response with baseline activity unchanged (operator change), and pathogenicity-predictor accuracy drops below 76% on drug-altering variants; variant features need drug-specific supervision.
so_what_zh: ACE 变异在基线活性不变的情况下改变药物响应（算子变化），而致病性预测器在改变药效的变异上准确度降至 76% 以下；变异特征需要药物特异的监督。
caveat_en: Published Science Advances version read in full. Effects come from heterologous overexpression assays (5 ACE, 7 TUBB1, 7 BCHE variants) with IC50 about 10-fold above clinical exposure; no transcriptomic readout.
caveat_zh: 已读 Science Advances 发表版全文。效应来自异源过表达实验（5 个 ACE、7 个 TUBB1、7 个 BCHE 变异），IC50 约为临床暴露水平的 10 倍；没有转录组读出。

title: Advancing regulatory variant effect prediction with AlphaGenome
key_claim_en: Self-reported SOTA on 22 of 24 track and 25 of 26 variant-effect evaluations; on 17,675 fine-mapped GTEx eQTLs signed Spearman is 0.50 versus 0.10 on absolute values. Authors state personal-genome prediction is not benchmarked and condition-specific variant effects remain challenging.
key_claim_zh: 自报在 24 项 track 任务中的 22 项和 26 项变异效应评估中的 25 项达到最先进水平；在 17,675 个精细定位的 GTEx eQTL 上，带符号 Spearman 为 0.50，取绝对值后仅 0.10。作者称个人基因组预测尚未基准评测，条件特异的变异效应仍具挑战。
so_what_en: Usable as a population-level eQTL-effect prior for class-2 variants; personal-genome prediction is unbenchmarked and condition-specific effects remain challenging, so genotype-by-drug use needs its own validation.
so_what_zh: 可作为类别 2 变异群体层面 eQTL 效应的先验；个人基因组预测未经基准评测，条件特异效应仍具挑战，因此任何基因型×药物用途都需要自行验证。
caveat_en: Published Nature version read in full; it reports 25 of 26 variant-effect evaluations, while the preprint abstract reports 24 of 26. Performance is self-reported.
caveat_zh: 已读 Nature 发表版全文；其报告 26 项变异效应评估中的 25 项，而预印本摘要报告 26 项中的 24 项。性能为自报。

title: Predicting RNA-seq coverage from DNA sequence as a unifying model of gene regulation
key_claim_en: Borzoi predicts RNA-seq coverage from 524 kb of DNA in 32 bp bins (7,611 tracks). On fine-mapped GTEx eQTLs, mean AUROC 0.794 versus Enformer 0.747 and effect-size Spearman 0.334 versus 0.227 (self-reported); eGene prioritization was at best marginally better than a TSS-distance baseline.
key_claim_zh: Borzoi 以 524 kb DNA 序列在 32 bp 分辨率下预测 RNA-seq 覆盖度（7,611 条轨道）。在精细定位的 GTEx eQTL 上，平均 AUROC 为 0.794，Enformer 为 0.747；效应量 Spearman 为 0.334，Enformer 为 0.227（自报）；eGene 优先排序至多仅略优于 TSS 距离基线。
so_what_en: Sequence backbone for variant-to-expression scoring, benchmarked here on population-level eQTLs; GV05 shows related models fail across individuals, so use for personal variant effects must be validated.
so_what_zh: 用于变异到表达评分的序列骨干，此处在群体层面的 eQTL 上做了基准评测；GV05 表明相关模型在个体间失效，因此用于个人变异效应必须经过验证。
caveat_en: Full text of the published article read; performance figures are the authors' own comparisons with Enformer; the text read reports no cross-individual evaluation.
caveat_zh: 已读发表版全文；性能数字是作者自己与 Enformer 的比较；所读文本没有报告跨个体评估。

title: Personal transcriptome variation is poorly explained by current genomic deep learning models
key_claim_en: On 421 Geuvadis individuals (lymphoblastoid cell lines), four sequence models (Enformer, Basenji2, ExPecto, Xpresso) reach reference-genome across-gene Spearman 0.33 to 0.57 but cross-individual correlations centre near zero with frequent wrong direction; per-gene linear models explain much more.
key_claim_zh: 在 421 名 Geuvadis 个体（淋巴母细胞系）上，四个序列模型（Enformer、Basenji2、ExPecto、Xpresso）在参考序列上的跨基因 Spearman 为 0.33 至 0.57，但跨个体相关性集中在零附近且方向常常错误；逐基因线性模型的解释力强得多。
so_what_en: Across-gene accuracy hides the failure: a genotype-aware model must be scored on cross-individual (delta) correlation and direction against a per-gene linear baseline.
so_what_zh: 跨基因准确度掩盖了失败：基因型感知模型必须在跨个体（差值）相关性和方向上评分，并与逐基因线性基线比较。
caveat_en: Published Nature Genetics version read in full; bioRxiv version not read. Single tissue (lymphoblastoid cell lines) and one cohort.
caveat_zh: 已读 Nature Genetics 发表版全文；未读 bioRxiv 版本。仅一种组织（淋巴母细胞系）、一个队列。

title: Benchmarking of deep neural networks for predicting personal gene expression from DNA sequence highlights shortcomings
key_claim_en: Enformer on 839 ROSMAP individuals (WGS, cortex RNA-seq): across 6,825 genes mean cross-individual Pearson 0.01, and 195 of 598 significantly correlated genes were anti-correlated; PrediXcan significantly predicted 921 versus 162 for Enformer among 1,570 genes (mean R 0.26 versus 0.02).
key_claim_zh: Enformer 在 839 名 ROSMAP 个体（全基因组测序、皮层 RNA-seq）上：6,825 个基因的跨个体 Pearson 均值为 0.01，598 个显著相关的基因中有 195 个呈反相关；在 1,570 个基因中 PrediXcan 显著预测 921 个而 Enformer 为 162 个（平均 R 为 0.26 对 0.02）。
so_what_en: A second cohort, a different tissue and 839 donors reproduce the GV05 pattern, so the cross-individual weakness is not a Geuvadis artefact; a per-gene linear baseline is the bar.
so_what_zh: 第二个队列、不同组织、839 名供体复现了 GV05 的模式，说明跨个体的弱点不是 Geuvadis 特有的假象；逐基因线性基线是需要超越的标准。
caveat_en: Preprint version deposited in PMC (PMC10055057) read in full; the published Nature Genetics version was not read, so its numbers may differ.
caveat_zh: 已读 PMC 收录的预印本版（PMC10055057）全文；未读 Nature Genetics 发表版，其数字可能不同。

title: Personalized gene expression prediction in the era of deep learning: a review
key_claim_en: Review reports Enformer cross-individual Spearman 0.045 versus about 0.25 for PrediXcan on Geuvadis; fine-tuning on paired genome and RNA-seq (Performer, 84% of genes at least matching elastic net) works per gene but not for held-out genes; ancestry shift cuts Pearson by more than 0.1.
key_claim_zh: 综述称，在 Geuvadis 上 Enformer 的跨个体 Spearman 仅 0.045，而 PrediXcan 约为 0.25；在配对基因组与 RNA-seq 上微调（Performer：84% 的基因至少与 elastic net 持平）对单个基因有效，但对留出基因无效；族裔迁移使 Pearson 下降超过 0.1。
so_what_en: A genotype-aware model must beat a per-gene linear baseline on cross-individual, held-out-gene and cross-ancestry tests; the review reports fine-tuned deep models at best match it.
so_what_zh: 基因型感知模型必须在跨个体、留出基因和跨族裔检验上超过逐基因线性基线；综述报告微调后的深度模型至多与之持平。
caveat_en: Review read in full. Its 0.045 is not in the GV05 text, and its 921 of 13,397 genes differs from GV06 (921 of 1,570); cite the primary papers, not this review.
caveat_zh: 已读综述全文。它所引的 0.045 不在 GV05 的文本中，其 921（共 13,397 个基因）也与 GV06（1,570 个基因中 921 个）不一致；应引用原始论文而非本综述。

title: Preference-Based Fine-Tuning of Genomic Sequence Models for Personal Expression Prediction with Data Augmentation
key_claim_en: Fine-tunes Enformer by alternating real-data regression with preference optimization on thousands of synthetic 1000 Genomes genotypes labelled by PrediXcan pseudo-expression; on GEUVADIS it reportedly beats AlphaGenome, PrediXcan and Enformer fine-tuned without synthetic data (self-reported, abstract only).
key_claim_zh: 通过交替进行真实数据回归与基于 PrediXcan 伪表达标签的合成数据偏好优化来微调 Enformer，合成数据为数千个模拟的 1000 Genomes 基因型；在 GEUVADIS 上据称优于 AlphaGenome、PrediXcan 以及未用合成数据微调的 Enformer（自报，仅摘要）。
so_what_en: Design hint: augment scarce paired genotype-expression data with simulated genotypes and eQTL-model pseudo-labels, trained with a relative (preference) objective; effect sizes are not available at abstract level.
so_what_zh: 设计提示：用模拟基因型和 eQTL 模型伪标签扩充稀缺的基因型–表达配对数据，并用相对（偏好）目标训练；摘要层面无法得到效应量。
caveat_en: Abstract only (bioRxiv metadata, version 4); the row's URL is version 1; no numbers or full text read, and not peer reviewed.
caveat_zh: 仅读摘要（bioRxiv 元数据，第 4 版）；所引 URL 为第 1 版；未读到数字和全文，尚未同行评议。

title: Genetic drug target validation using Mendelian randomisation
key_claim_en: Drug-target MR uses cis variants as instruments; four positive-control targets (HMGCR, PCSK9, NPC1L1, CETP). Tissue-specific eQTL-weighted estimates do not always agree with blood pQTL analyses or trials: PCSK9 expression raised CHD risk in adrenal gland (OR 1.09) but lowered it in uterus (OR 0.92).
key_claim_zh: 药物靶点 MR 以 cis 变异作工具变量；HMGCR、PCSK9、NPC1L1、CETP 四个靶点作阳性对照。组织特异的 eQTL 加权估计并不总与血液 pQTL 分析或临床试验一致：PCSK9 表达在肾上腺中使 CHD 风险升高（OR 1.09），在子宫中则使其降低（OR 0.92）。
so_what_en: Cis-variant direction priors for a target are tissue-dependent (sign flips between adrenal gland and uterus), so they need cell-type conditioning; outputs are disease risks, not transcriptomes.
so_what_zh: 为靶点调节提供 cis 变异方向先验时，符号随组织而变（肾上腺与子宫相反），因此需要按细胞类型条件化；输出是疾病风险而非转录组。
caveat_en: Full text read. No multiple-testing correction (type I error 0.05); the authors suggest GTEx ancestry mix or post-mortem collection may contribute to tissue heterogeneity.
caveat_zh: 已读全文。未做多重检验校正（I 类错误率 0.05）；作者提示 GTEx 的祖源构成或死后采样可能造成组织间异质性。

title: Unraveling Novel Genetic Determinants of Thiopurine Response Via TWAS
key_claim_en: TWAS (S-PrediXcan, whole blood) in 663 pediatric ALL patients found 31 genes at q < 0.90 for 6MP dose intensity; only GNAQ passed multiple-testing correction in the validation cohorts, via a single eQTL (rs60561071).
key_claim_zh: 在 663 名儿童 ALL 患者中做 TWAS（S-PrediXcan，全血），以 q < 0.90 找到 31 个与 6MP 剂量强度相关的基因；只有 GNAQ 在验证队列中通过多重检验校正，且依赖单个 eQTL（rs60561071）。
so_what_en: Genotype-to-drug-tolerance evidence via imputed expression is sparse (one validated gene of 31 at q < 0.90) and yields no transcriptome response; use only as a direction prior.
so_what_zh: 经填补表达得到的基因型–药物耐受证据稀少（q < 0.90 下 31 个基因中只有 1 个得到验证），且不给出转录组响应；只宜用作方向先验。
caveat_en: Read in full; the q < 0.90 cut-off is permissive, no significant ANC (toxicity) association was found (p > 0.19), and cohort TOTXV is n = 390 in the abstract but 408 in Results.
caveat_zh: 已读全文；q < 0.90 的入选阈值较宽松，未发现 ANC（毒性）的显著关联（p > 0.19），且队列 TOTXV 在摘要中为 n = 390、在结果中为 408。

title: Characterizing the genetic architecture of drug response using gene-context interaction methods
key_claim_en: In 342,257 UK Biobank individuals, statin response heritability for LDL is 9% (21% drug-independent); TxEWAS (imputed expression × treatment) finds 156 modifier genes, all 131 with additive effects sign-opposed (buffering); 36 of 155 replicated in 34,874 statin users.
key_claim_zh: 在 342,257 名 UK Biobank 个体中，他汀对 LDL 的响应遗传度为 9%（不依赖药物的为 21%）；TxEWAS（填补表达×处理）找到 156 个调节基因，其中 131 个具有显著加性效应的基因，其交互效应符号全部与加性效应相反（缓冲）；155 个中有 36 个在 34,874 名他汀使用者中重复。
so_what_en: A drug can uniformly dampen baseline genetic effects (statins, LDL), so a genotype-aware model should learn drug-dependent attenuation of genotype effects, not only additive shifts.
so_what_zh: 药物可以均匀地削弱基线遗传效应（他汀、LDL），因此基因型感知模型应学习药物依赖的基因型效应衰减，而不只是加性偏移。
caveat_en: Published Cell Genomics version read in full. Cross-sectional UK Biobank with possible endogeneity bias; the PCSK9 interaction did not replicate; outputs are clinical traits, not transcriptomes.
caveat_zh: 已读 Cell Genomics 发表版全文。UK Biobank 为横断面数据，可能存在内生性偏倚；PCSK9 交互未重复；输出是临床性状而非转录组。

title: Genome-wide prediction of disease variants with a deep protein language model
key_claim_en: ESM1b (650M-parameter protein language model) scores all ~450M possible human missense variants; reportedly separates ~150K ClinVar/HGMD pathogenic and benign variants better than prior methods (self-reported, abstract only); ~2M variants in ~9K genes are damaging in some isoforms only.
key_claim_zh: ESM1b（650M 参数的蛋白语言模型）为全部约 450M 个可能的人类错义变异打分；据称区分约 150K 个 ClinVar/HGMD 致病与良性变异的表现优于既有方法（自报，仅摘要）；约 9K 个基因中约 2M 个变异只在部分异构体中有害。
so_what_en: Cheap genome-wide coding-variant feature that scores damage, not drug response; GV01 reports pathogenicity predictors drop below 76% accuracy on drug-altering variants, so use it only as an input feature.
so_what_zh: 廉价的全基因组编码变异特征，评分的是损伤而非药物响应；GV01 报告致病性预测器在改变药效的变异上准确度降至 76% 以下，因此只宜作输入特征。
caveat_en: Only the bioRxiv abstract was read; the Springer page returned a bot challenge, so the published Nature Genetics version was not read; performance claims are self-reported.
caveat_zh: 仅读了 bioRxiv 摘要；Springer 页面返回机器人验证，因此未读已发表的 Nature Genetics 版本；性能主张为自报。

title: A catalogue of genetic mutations to help pinpoint the cause of diseases
key_claim_en: AlphaMissense scores all 71 million possible missense variants (0 to 1; CC BY v.4 since March 2024). Trained on human and primate population-frequency labels; classifies 89% at a threshold with 90% precision on known disease variants (self-reported).
key_claim_zh: AlphaMissense 为全部 71 百万（约 7100 万）个可能的错义变异打分（0 到 1；自 2024 年 3 月起为 CC BY v.4）。以人类和灵长类群体频率标签训练；在对已知致病变异精确度为 90% 的阈值下可分类 89%（自报）。
so_what_en: Free genome-wide coding-variant feature labelled by population frequency, not drug response; use as an input feature only, since GV01 shows pathogenicity predictors lose accuracy on drug-altering variants.
so_what_zh: 免费的全基因组编码变异特征，标签来自群体频率而非药物响应；只宜作输入特征，因为 GV01 表明致病性预测器在改变药效的变异上会损失准确度。
caveat_en: Company page about its own product read; the Science paper was not, and performance is self-reported. The page gives no auROC or assay correlation; its ClinVar warning concerns other methods.
caveat_zh: 已读公司关于其自身产品的页面，未读 Science 论文，性能为自报。页面未给出 auROC 或实验相关性；其 ClinVar 警示针对的是其他方法。

title: Boltz-2: Towards Accurate and Efficient Binding Affinity Prediction
key_claim_en: Authors say no AI model has yet matched FEP or lab-assay accuracy; Boltz-2 only approaches FEP (Pearson 0.66 on a 4-target subset; above 0.55 on 3 of 8 internal assays; self-reported). Affinity loss weights pairwise intra-assay differences above absolute values.
key_claim_zh: 作者称尚无 AI 模型达到 FEP 或实验室测定的准确度，Boltz-2 只是接近 FEP（4 靶点子集上 Pearson 0.66；8 个内部测定中 3 个高于 0.55；自报）。亲和力损失给成对的测定内差值赋予高于绝对值的权重。
so_what_en: Benchmarks rank ligand analogues per target, not protein variants, and accuracy varies by assay, so variant-affinity use is unvalidated; the pairwise intra-assay loss is a template for genotype contrasts.
so_what_zh: 基准按靶点对配体类似物排序，而不是对蛋白变异排序，且准确度随测定而异，因此用于变异亲和力尚未验证；成对的测定内差值损失可作为监督基因型对比的模板。
caveat_en: Preprint text (PMC12262699) read in full; performance is self-reported by the developers; the text read has no mutation or variant evaluation.
caveat_zh: 已读预印本全文（PMC12262699）；性能由开发者自报；所读文本没有突变或变异评估。

title: BoltzOmics: Predicting genetic variant effects on drug binding with Boltz-2
key_claim_en: Boltz-2 pipeline on binding-site variants of hERG, NaV1.5, HER2, CYP3A4: mean Pearson with pIC50 0.74 to 0.76 (wild type) and 0.48 to 0.60 (mutants), above docking and DTA baselines (self-reported); CYP3A4 within-drug variant ranking r = 0.30, 0.19, 0.66 by setting.
key_claim_zh: Boltz-2 流程用于 hERG、NaV1.5、HER2、CYP3A4 的结合位点变异：与 pIC50 的平均 Pearson，野生型 0.74 至 0.76，突变体 0.48 至 0.60，高于对接与 DTA 基线（自报）；CYP3A4 药物内变异排序 r 按设置分别为 0.30、0.19、0.66。
so_what_en: Reported correlations mostly rank drugs within a variant; the one within-drug variant ranking (CYP3A4) was weak in two of three settings (0.19 and 0.30), so genotype-effect accuracy is unproven.
so_what_zh: 报告的相关性多为同一变异内对药物排序；唯一的药物内变异排序（CYP3A4）在三个设置中的两个较弱（0.19 和 0.30），因此基因型效应的准确度尚未证实。
caveat_en: Published iScience version read in full. Benchmarks are small (two HER2, five NaV1.5 variants), retrospective and from heterogeneous assays, and Boltz-2 training overlap cannot be excluded; numbers are the authors' own.
caveat_zh: 已读 iScience 发表版全文。基准规模小（HER2 两个变异、NaV1.5 五个变异）、为回顾性且来自异质测定，Boltz-2 训练集重叠不能排除；数字由作者自报。

title: Predicting Mutation-Induced Relative Protein-Ligand Binding Affinity Changes via Conformational Sampling and Diversity Integration with Subsampled AlphaFold2 in Few-Shot Learning
key_claim_en: Few-shot Siamese model with AlphaFold2-subsampled conformation ensembles and ensemble docking predicts mutation-induced relative binding-affinity change; on 31 ABL kinase variants Spearman rose for five of six TKIs (abstract only, self-reported; baseline not stated).
key_claim_zh: 结合 AlphaFold2 子采样构象集合与集合对接的少样本 Siamese 模型，预测突变引起的相对结合亲和力变化；在 31 个 ABL 激酶变异上，六种 TKI 中五种的 Spearman 提高（仅摘要，自报；未说明基线）。
so_what_en: A relative (pairwise Siamese) target suits mutation-induced affinity change when mutant structures are missing; evidence is limited to 31 ABL variants and one kinase, at abstract level.
so_what_zh: 当突变体结构缺失时，相对（成对 Siamese）目标适合预测突变引起的亲和力变化；证据仅限于 31 个 ABL 变异和一种激酶，且为摘要层面。
caveat_en: Abstract only (bioRxiv version 2); no full text on disk. The abstract gives no correlation values or baseline for the increase.
caveat_zh: 仅读摘要（bioRxiv 第 2 版）；磁盘上没有全文。摘要没有给出相关系数数值，也没有提升所对照的基线。

title: scooby: modeling multimodal genomic profiles from DNA sequence at single-cell resolution
key_claim_en: Borzoi plus LoRA-adapted embeddings and a decoder conditioned on each cell's embedding (no per-cell heads). NeurIPS bone-marrow model (63,683 cells) beats seq2cells: 0.77 to 0.87 across genes, 0.43 to 0.55 across cell types; a OneK1K model beats Borzoi on cell-type eQTLs (self-reported).
key_claim_zh: Borzoi 加 LoRA 适配的嵌入，以及以每个细胞嵌入为条件的解码器（无逐细胞输出头）。NeurIPS 骨髓模型（63,683 个细胞）优于 seq2cells：跨基因相关 0.77 至 0.87，跨细胞类型 0.43 至 0.55；OneK1K 模型在细胞类型特异 eQTL 上优于 Borzoi（自报）。
so_what_en: Candidate route to cell-type-specific class-2 effects by scoring reference versus alternative alleles, without donor genotype input; distal and sign accuracy are limited, so it needs validation.
so_what_zh: 通过比较参考与替代等位基因来评分，是得到细胞类型特异的类别 2 效应的候选途径，且没有供体基因型输入；远端变异和符号准确度有限，因此需要验证。
caveat_en: Published Nature Methods version read in full; all numbers are the authors' own comparisons against seq2cells and Borzoi.
caveat_zh: 已读 Nature Methods 发表版全文；所有数字是作者自己与 seq2cells 和 Borzoi 的比较。

title: gagneurlab/scooby (GitHub)
key_claim_en: MIT-licensed code; pretrained scooby models for the NeurIPS, OneK1K and Epicardioids datasets are on Hugging Face; the decoder is conditioned on the cell's position in a precomputed single-cell embedding; training takes 1-2 days on 8 A40 GPUs; the README does not mention variant scoring.
key_claim_zh: MIT 许可的代码；NeurIPS、OneK1K 和 Epicardioids 数据集的预训练 scooby 模型在 Hugging Face 上；解码器以细胞在预先计算的单细胞嵌入中的位置为条件；训练在 8 块 A40 GPU 上需 1-2 天；README 未提及变异评分。
so_what_en: Code is reusable under MIT and a OneK1K-trained model exists; the README points to a separate repository of notebooks that reproduce the paper's results (GV26).
so_what_zh: 代码可在 MIT 许可下复用，并且存在在 OneK1K 上训练的模型；README 指向一个单独的笔记本仓库，用于复现论文结果（GV26）。

caveat_zh: 已读 README 和浅克隆；仓库的 MIT 许可覆盖其代码，Hugging Face 权重和 Zenodo 数据的许可未读；复现仓库未读。

title: CRISPR-Cas9–mediated saturated mutagenesis screen predicts clinical drug resistance with improved accuracy
key_claim_en: Saturation mutagenesis of BCR-ABL1 positions 311–319 in Ba/F3 cells under imatinib, dasatinib and ponatinib: a combined (drug-free growth plus inhibitor) effect predicted prevalence in about 1,400 resistant patient samples better than either alone; the correlation, over four mutations, was driven mainly by T315I and T317L.
key_claim_zh: 在 Ba/F3 细胞中，于 imatinib、dasatinib 和 ponatinib 下对 BCR-ABL1 的 311–319 位做饱和突变：综合效应（无药生长加抑制剂效应）对约 1,400 份耐药患者样本中突变流行度的预测优于任一单独效应；该相关性基于四个突变，主要由 T315I 和 T317L 驱动。
so_what_en: A class-1 variant's drug effect must be modelled with its drug-free fitness; FoldX stability scores predicted clinical prevalence poorly (R² < 0.2), so functional maps are the better supervision.
so_what_zh: 类别 1 变异的药物效应必须与其无药适应度联合建模；FoldX 稳定性评分对临床流行度的预测很差（R² < 0.2），因此功能图谱是更好的监督来源。
caveat_en: Published PNAS version read in full (PMC). Only kinase-domain positions 311–319 in murine Ba/F3 cells; the readout is growth, not transcription; the prevalence correlation rests on four mutations.
caveat_zh: 已读 PMC 上 PNAS 发表版全文。仅分析激酶结构域 311–319 位（小鼠 Ba/F3 细胞），读出是生长而非转录组；流行度相关性只基于四个突变。

title: A combined computational and experimental strategy identifies mutations conferring resistance to drugs targeting the BCR-ABL fusion protein
key_claim_en: Docking-based genetic algorithm (EVER) recovers most strong single-site BCR-ABL resistance mutations for imatinib, nilotinib and dasatinib; predicted-but-unobserved mutants also weakened binding, but IC50 rose under 15-fold versus at least 60-fold for clinical mutants, and four of eight had over sixfold higher catalytic efficacy.
key_claim_zh: 基于对接的遗传算法（EVER）重现了 imatinib、nilotinib 和 dasatinib 的大多数强单点 BCR-ABL 耐药突变；预测但未在临床观察到的突变同样削弱结合，但其 IC50 上升低于 15 倍，而临床突变至少 60 倍，并且八个中有四个的催化效率高出六倍以上。
so_what_en: Affinity change alone does not mark clinical resistance; IC50 shift and preserved catalytic activity do, as GV28 also found with growth data, so supervise variant features with functional readouts.
so_what_zh: 单靠亲和力变化无法标示临床耐药；IC50 位移和保留的催化活性才可以，GV28 用生长数据也得出同样结论，因此应以功能读出来监督变异特征。
caveat_en: Published Communications Biology version read in full; assays use purified ABL kinase domain, not cells; ponatinib is a hard case for the method.
caveat_zh: 已读 Communications Biology 发表版全文；实验使用纯化的 ABL 激酶结构域，而非细胞；ponatinib 对该方法是难例。

title: Dual functional genomics reveals a broad and convergent landscape of asciminib resistance in BCR::ABL1
key_claim_en: Base-editing screen and DMS at 125 nM asciminib in K562 cells found 279 novel resistance variants across SH3, SH2 and kinase domains. In a Y253H background epistasis was rare (guides V73A and Y139C only); V73A+Y253H gave 25% viability versus 3% predicted without interaction.
key_claim_zh: 在 K562 细胞中，碱基编辑筛选与 125 nM asciminib 下的 DMS 找到 279 个新的耐药变异，分布于 SH3、SH2 和激酶结构域。在 Y253H 背景下上位性罕见（仅 V73A 和 Y139C 引导）；V73A+Y253H 的存活率为 25%，而无相互作用的预测为 3%。
so_what_en: Variant-by-background epistasis under a drug is rare (two guides), supporting a sparse interaction term; resistance also arises outside the kinase domain; the readout is growth, not transcription.
so_what_zh: 药物下的变异×背景上位性罕见（两个引导），支持稀疏的交互项；耐药也可出现在激酶结构域之外；读出是生长而非转录。
caveat_en: Published Genome Medicine version read in full; K562 and Ba/F3 growth readouts, with DMS by cDNA overexpression; epistasis was tested in one background (Y253H).
caveat_zh: 已读 Genome Medicine 发表版全文；读出为 K562 和 Ba/F3 的生长，DMS 通过 cDNA 过表达完成；上位性只在一个背景（Y253H）中检验。

title: Discovery of target genes and pathways at GWAS loci by pooled single-cell CRISPR screens
key_claim_en: Pooled CRISPR screens with single-cell RNA and protein readout assigned 124 cis-target genes to 91 noncoding blood-trait GWAS loci; base editing linked specific variants to expression changes; trans-effect networks arose when cis targets were transcription factors or microRNAs and were enriched for GWAS variants.
key_claim_zh: 混池 CRISPR 筛选结合单细胞 RNA 与蛋白读出，把 124 个 cis 靶基因对应到 91 个非编码血液性状 GWAS 位点；碱基编辑把具体变异与表达变化联系起来；当 cis 靶标是转录因子或 microRNA 时出现 trans 效应网络，且网络富集 GWAS 变异。
so_what_en: Maps non-coding variants to cis target genes and trans networks at single-cell resolution, the middle layer a drug-response model would otherwise treat as a black box.
so_what_zh: 把非编码变异映射到 cis 靶基因和 trans 网络（单细胞分辨率），这是药物响应模型原本会当作黑箱的中间层。
caveat_en: Abstract of the published Science version only; no full text was read, so cell type, effect sizes and screen design are unverified, and any difference from the bioRxiv preprint is unchecked.
caveat_zh: 仅读已发表 Science 版本的摘要；没有读到全文，因此细胞类型、效应量和筛选设计未经核实；与 bioRxiv 预印本的差异未检查。

title: Leverage drug perturbation to reveal genetic regulators of hepatic gene expression in African Americans
key_claim_en: Primary hepatocyte cultures from African Americans (60 cultures, genotyped, RNA-seq) at baseline and after 6 drugs: 2,988 response eQTLs (drug-altered effect size) that more often overlap TF binding sites; joint mapping raised eQTL power 2.7-fold; rs61017966 raises CYP3A5 expression.
key_claim_zh: 来自非裔美国人的原代肝细胞培养物（60 份培养物，已做基因分型和 RNA-seq），在基线及 6 种药物处理后：2,988 个响应 eQTL（效应大小因药物而改变），更常与转录因子结合位点重叠；联合作图使 eQTL 检出功效提高 2.7 倍；rs61017966 提高 CYP3A5 表达。
so_what_en: Direct count of drug-by-genotype interactions in a pharmacokinetics-relevant tissue (2,988 response eQTLs), plus a design hint: pooling baseline and treated samples raises power 2.7-fold.
so_what_zh: 在药代动力学相关组织中直接统计到的药物×基因型交互数（2,988 个响应 eQTL），并提示一条设计原则：合并基线与处理样本可将功效提高 2.7 倍。
caveat_en: Preprint abstract only; donor number not stated. The headline reQTL is in CYP3A5, a drug-metabolism (PK) gene, a confounder for pharmacodynamic questions. Published version not read.
caveat_zh: 仅读到预印本摘要，未说明供体数量。头条 reQTL 位于药物代谢（PK）基因 CYP3A5，对药效动力学问题是混杂因素。未读到已发表版本。

title: Computational discovery of transcription factors associated with drug response
key_claim_en: GENMi links TF-binding-site SNPs to drug cytotoxicity (EC50) via cis-eQTLs from basal expression in 284 lymphoblastoid lines: 334 of 3,864 TF-treatment pairs significant (FDR ≤ 0.10); knockdown in two breast cancer lines confirmed 6 of 21 taxane and 4 of 14 anthracycline TFs.
key_claim_zh: GENMi 通过 284 株淋巴母细胞系中基础表达的 cis-eQTL，把转录因子结合位点上的 SNP 与药物细胞毒性（EC50）联系起来：3,864 个 TF-处理组合中 334 个显著（FDR ≤ 0.10）；在两株乳腺癌细胞系中敲低验证，紫杉烷类候选 TF 21 个中确认 6 个，蒽环类 14 个中确认 4 个。
so_what_en: A TF-mediated route from regulatory variant to drug sensitivity, giving candidate TFs to monitor; but expression is basal and the phenotype is cytotoxicity, so drug-induced transcription is not modeled.
so_what_zh: 给出一条经转录因子从调控变异到药物敏感性的路径，可提供需要监测的候选 TF；但表达是基础表达、表型是细胞毒性，并未建模药物诱导的转录。
caveat_en: Publisher page read in full. Associations use basal, not drug-induced, expression; authors give no false-negative estimate (no benchmark) and treat POLR2A and CTCF hits as likely artifacts.
caveat_zh: 已完整阅读出版商页面。关联使用的是基础表达而非药物诱导表达；作者没有给出假阴性估计（无基准），并认为 POLR2A 和 CTCF 的命中很可能是方法伪影。

title: Determining the genetic basis of anthracycline-cardiotoxicity by molecular response QTL mapping in induced cardiomyocytes
key_claim_en: iPSC-derived cardiomyocytes from 45 Hutterite individuals, 24 h, five doxorubicin concentrations: reQTLs for 376 genes (447 with allele-specific expression), 46% switching response pattern by allele; response eQTLs, not baseline eQTLs, enrich in cardiotoxicity GWAS (OR 1.95); 42 response sQTLs.
key_claim_zh: 45 名 Hutterite 个体的 iPSC 来源心肌细胞，24 小时，五个阿霉素浓度：376 个基因有 reQTL（加入等位基因特异表达后为 447 个），其中 46% 的等位基因会改变响应模式；响应 eQTL 而非基线 eQTL 在心脏毒性 GWAS 中富集（OR 1.95）；另有 42 个响应 sQTL。
so_what_en: Response eQTLs carry GWAS signal that baseline eQTLs lack; dose explains more variance than donor and acts non-linearly, so it should be an explicit model input.
so_what_zh: 响应 eQTL 带有基线 eQTL 所缺乏的 GWAS 信号；剂量解释的方差大于供体且呈非线性，因此应作为模型的显式输入。
caveat_en: Published eLife text read; the bioRxiv preprint was not. The in vivo link rests on a lasso model trained on 3 versus 3 patients (Spearman rho 0.38); donors are healthy Hutterites.
caveat_zh: 读的是已发表的 eLife 文本，未读 bioRxiv 预印本。体内关联依赖于用 3 对 3 名患者训练的 lasso 模型（Spearman rho 0.38）；供体为健康的 Hutterite 人群。

title: Anthracyclines induce cardiotoxicity through a shared gene expression response signature
key_claim_en: iPSC-cardiomyocytes from 6 healthy women, four TOP2 inhibitors plus trastuzumab (0.5 µM; 3 h, 24 h RNA-seq): 24 h anthracycline responses are shared (DOX versus EPI r2 = 0.97), trastuzumab has none; 93% of 142 DOX response eGenes from GD06 also respond to DNR.
key_claim_zh: 6 名健康女性的 iPSC 来源心肌细胞，四种 TOP2 抑制剂加曲妥珠单抗（0.5 µM；3 小时和 24 小时 RNA-seq）：24 小时的蒽环类响应高度共享（DOX 与 EPI 的 r2 = 0.97），曲妥珠单抗无响应；GD06 中 142 个 DOX 响应 eGene 里有 93% 也对 DNR 产生响应。
so_what_en: Within a drug class, responses and response-eQTL genes are largely shared, so a genotype-by-drug term could be shared across analogs; drug-specific genes are few (4% of 24 h response genes).
so_what_zh: 在同一药物类别内，响应和响应 eQTL 基因大多共享，因此基因型×药物项可在类似物之间共享；药物特异基因很少（占 24 小时响应基因的 4%）。
caveat_en: PMC text of the published PLOS Genetics paper read. Only six donors and one RNA-seq dose (0.5 µM); no eQTLs mapped here, genetic links come from overlap with published GD06 eGenes and GWAS gene sets.
caveat_zh: 读的是已发表 PLOS Genetics 论文的 PMC 文本。仅有 6 名供体和一个 RNA-seq 剂量（0.5 µM）；此处未做 eQTL 作图，遗传关联来自与已发表的 GD06 eGene 和 GWAS 基因集的重叠。

title: Interactions between Glucocorticoid Treatment and Cis-Regulatory Polymorphisms Contribute to Cellular Response Phenotypes
key_claim_en: 114 LCLs (57 YRI, 57 TSI), paired dexamethasone versus vehicle (8 h): 4,568 differentially expressed genes, but only 26 genes with cis-eQTL-by-treatment interactions (18 GC-only, 8 control-only) versus 6,813 with no-interaction eQTLs; no response eQTLs from SNPs at GR or 34 TF genes.
key_claim_zh: 114 株淋巴母细胞系（57 株 YRI、57 株 TSI），地塞米松与溶剂配对处理（8 小时）：4,568 个差异表达基因，但只有 26 个基因存在 cis-eQTL×处理交互（18 个仅在 GC 下、8 个仅在对照下），而无交互 eQTL 的基因有 6,813 个；GR 及 34 个 TF 基因处的 SNP 没有响应 eQTL。
so_what_en: Genotype-by-drug effects are sparse (26 versus 6,813 genes), local, and of GC-only or control-only type, suggesting separate treated-state and baseline terms; only 4 of 9 interaction eQTLs replicated.
so_what_zh: 基因型×药物效应稀疏（26 对 6,813 个基因）、局部，并分为仅 GC 下和仅对照下两类，提示应有分开的处理态项和基线项；9 个交互 eQTL 中仅 4 个得到重复。
caveat_en: PMC text of the published PLOS Genetics paper read. EBV-transformed lymphoblastoid lines, microarray expression, one dose and time (1 µM, 8 h); authors flag a higher false-positive rate for control-only eQTLs.
caveat_zh: 读的是已发表 PLOS Genetics 论文的 PMC 文本。EBV 转化的淋巴母细胞系，微阵列表达，仅一个剂量和时间点（1 µM，8 小时）；作者指出仅对照下 eQTL 的假阳性率可能更高。

title: Genetic control of the dynamic transcriptional response to immune stimuli and glucocorticoids at single-cell resolution
key_claim_en: scRNA-seq of PBMCs from 96 African American children with asthma, five conditions (control, LPS, PHA, LPS or PHA plus dexamethasone): 328 genes with response eQTLs; cell-type-specific eGene fractions (6%–51%) exceed treatment-specific ones (1%–5%); dexamethasone reverses stimulus effects on expression mean and variability.
key_claim_zh: 对 96 名患哮喘的非裔美国儿童的 PBMC 做单细胞 RNA-seq，共五个条件（对照、LPS、PHA、LPS 或 PHA 加地塞米松）：328 个基因有响应 eQTL；细胞类型特异 eGene 的比例（6%–51%）高于处理特异的比例（1%–5%）；地塞米松逆转刺激对表达均值和变异度的影响。
so_what_en: Genotype effects here depend more on cell type than on treatment, so a genotype-aware model needs cell-type-resolved conditioning; variability and pseudotime-dynamic QTLs add effects beyond mean shifts.
so_what_zh: 此处基因型效应对细胞类型的依赖强于对处理的依赖，因此感知基因型的模型需要按细胞类型分辨的条件输入；变异度 QTL 和伪时间动态 QTL 提供了均值变化之外的效应。
caveat_en: PMC text of the published Genome Research paper read. Asthmatic African American children only; cell counts differ between text (292,394) and Figure 1 legend (293,394); QTL counts are the authors' own at FDR 10%.
caveat_zh: 读的是已发表 Genome Research 论文的 PMC 文本。仅限患哮喘的非裔美国儿童；正文（292,394）与图 1 图注（293,394）的细胞数不一致；QTL 数量为作者自己在 FDR 10% 下得到。

title: Disease-associated loci share properties with response eQTLs under common environmental exposures
key_claim_en: Heterogeneous differentiating iPSC cultures from 51 Yoruba individuals, chronic ethanol, caffeine or nicotine (day 2 to 21), scRNA-seq of 1.4 million cells: 31 to 110 response eQTLs per cell type (380, 336, 276 eGenes by exposure), enriched in distal enhancers and constrained genes.
key_claim_zh: 来自 51 名 Yoruba 个体的异质性分化 iPSC 培养物，慢性给予乙醇、咖啡因或尼古丁（第 2 天至第 21 天），对 1.4 百万个细胞做 scRNA-seq：每种细胞类型有 31 至 110 个响应 eQTL（按暴露分别涉及 380、336、276 个 eGene），富集于远端增强子和受强选择约束的基因。
so_what_en: Response eQTLs resemble disease loci more than baseline eQTLs (GWAS colocalization 4.8% versus 0.4%), but treatment also shifts cell composition, so exposure and cell-state effects may be entangled.
so_what_zh: 响应 eQTL 比基线 eQTL 更像疾病位点（GWAS 共定位 4.8% 对 0.4%），但处理同时改变细胞组成，因此暴露效应与细胞状态效应可能纠缠在一起。
caveat_en: Research Square preprint text (PMC12136233) read; the Cell Genomics version cited in the row was not. Single ancestry (Yoruba), three exposures, chronic dosing; counts are the authors' own at LFSR 0.1.
caveat_zh: 读的是 Research Square 预印本文本（PMC12136233），未读行中引用的 Cell Genomics 版本。仅单一祖源（Yoruba）、三种暴露、慢性给药；计数为作者自己在 LFSR 0.1 下得到。

title: Allele-specific expression reveals interactions between genetic variation and environment
key_claim_en: EAGLE tests environment-by-genotype effects as association between an environmental factor and allelic imbalance (binomial mixed model, lead-eQTL heterozygosity as covariate): 922 blood RNA-seq samples, 30 factors, 35 associations at 10% FDR versus 4 by standard interaction testing; rat liver chemical exposures gave 442 associations.
key_claim_zh: EAGLE 把环境因素与等位基因失衡的关联作为基因型×环境效应的检验（二项混合模型，以主 eQTL 杂合状态为协变量）：922 份血液 RNA-seq、30 个环境因素，FDR 10% 下得到 35 个关联，而标准交互检验只有 4 个；大鼠肝脏的化学暴露数据给出 442 个关联。
so_what_en: An allele-specific GxE test uses each sample's own heterozygous alleles as internal control and avoids per-SNP testing; it also worked on chemical exposures in rats, without genotypes.
so_what_zh: 等位基因特异的基因型×环境检验以每个样本自身的杂合等位基因作内部对照，避免逐个 SNP 检验；它也适用于大鼠的化学暴露数据，且无需基因型。
caveat_en: Text read is the published Nature Methods version (PMC5501199), not the bioRxiv preprint cited in the row. Cohort environments are observational and the interaction count stays modest; replication was partial (6 of 10).
caveat_zh: 读的是已发表的 Nature Methods 版本（PMC5501199），而非行中引用的 bioRxiv 预印本。队列中的环境因素为观察性，交互数量仍有限；重复验证只是部分成功（10 个中 6 个）。

title: Global Analysis of the Impact of Environmental Perturbation on cis-Regulation of Gene Expression
key_claim_en: Primary human osteoblasts from 113 Swedish donors, untreated versus BMP-2 (2 h), dexamethasone (24 h) or PGE2 (24 h): 93% of cis-eQTLs at 1% FDR recur in another treatment, only about 1.4% are treatment-specific; dexamethasone-specific MYO6 and TNC effects validated by allelic expression.
key_claim_zh: 来自 113 名瑞典供体的原代人成骨细胞，未处理对比 BMP-2（2 小时）、地塞米松（24 小时）或 PGE2（24 小时）：FDR 1% 下 93% 的 cis-eQTL 在另一种处理中重现，仅约 1.4% 为处理特异；地塞米松特异的 MYO6 和 TNC 效应经等位基因表达验证。
so_what_en: Sparsity anchor: cis effects are mostly shared across conditions (93%), about 1.4% treatment-specific, so most genotype effects act as baseline shifts; TNC interaction appears at 24 h, not 2 h.
so_what_zh: 稀疏性锚点：cis 效应在各条件间大多共享（93%），约 1.4% 为处理特异，因此多数基因型效应表现为基线平移；TNC 交互出现在 24 小时而非 2 小时。
caveat_en: PMC text of the published paper read. One cell type (osteoblasts), one dose per treatment; treatment-specific eQTLs are only a slight excess over expected false positives; only 5 of 73 allelic-expression loci were treatment-specific.
caveat_zh: 读的是已发表论文的 PMC 文本。仅一种细胞类型（成骨细胞），每种处理只有一个剂量；处理特异 eQTL 仅略多于预期假阳性；73 个等位基因表达位点中只有 5 个为处理特异。

title: The single-cell eQTLGen consortium
key_claim_en: Consortium perspective, no new data: single-cell eQTL discovery power is 6.9-fold below bulk; a fixed budget spread over many individuals gives up to three times more power than 50,000 reads per cell; genetic multiplexing cuts cost per cell up to about 10-fold.
key_claim_zh: 联盟综述，无新数据：单细胞 eQTL 的发现功效比 bulk 低 6.9 倍；固定预算下把读数分散到多个个体，功效最多可达每细胞 50,000 条读数方案的三倍；基因型多重化可使每细胞成本最多降低约 10 倍。
so_what_en: Design guide for pooled, genotype-demultiplexed single-cell cohorts: many donors with fewer cells each, and perturbation can be multiplexed. The authors say network-level genetic effects on drug response remain unstudied.
so_what_zh: 汇集式、按基因型解复用的单细胞队列的设计指南：供体多而每个供体的细胞较少，且可把扰动一并多重化。作者称网络层面的遗传效应对药物响应的影响仍未被研究。
caveat_en: eLife article read (PMC7077978). An overview of consortium goals with no new data; the power figures are cited from other studies. The 2019 arXiv preprint has a different title and was not read.
caveat_zh: 已阅读 eLife 文章（PMC7077978）。这是对联盟目标的概述，没有新数据；功效数字引自其他研究。2019 年的 arXiv 预印本标题不同，未阅读。

title: An atlas of single-cell eQTLs dissects autoimmune disease genes and identifies novel drug classes for treatment
key_claim_en: JOBS models bulk eQTLs as a weighted sum of cell-type eQTLs from summary statistics; OneK1K (982 donors, 14 cell types) plus eQTLGen (over 30,000 donors) gives 586% more eQTLs, matching 4 times the OneK1K sample size (self-reported); a CMap-based drug-repurposing pipeline follows.
key_claim_zh: JOBS 用汇总统计量把 bulk eQTL 建模为各细胞类型 eQTL 的加权和；OneK1K（982 名供体、14 种细胞类型）加 eQTLGen（超过 30,000 名供体）使 eQTL 增加 586%，相当于 OneK1K 样本量的 4 倍（自报）；随后有一条基于 CMap 的药物重定位流程。
so_what_en: Borrowing strength from a large coarse resource to refine fine-grained effects is a transferable design for sparse genotype-by-drug data; but drugs enter only through CMap signatures, not genotype-by-drug expression.
so_what_zh: 借助大型粗粒度资源来细化细粒度效应，是可迁移到稀疏的基因型×药物数据的设计思路；但药物只通过 CMap 特征进入，并没有基因型×药物的表达数据。
caveat_en: Published Cell Genomics full text read (PMC12008810); the recorded 'secondary' note is obsolete. Numbers are the authors' own; non-European and diseased-sample data were not examined.
caveat_zh: 已阅读已发表的 Cell Genomics 全文（PMC12008810），原记录的“二手”说明已过时。数字为作者自报；未检验非欧洲人群和疾病样本数据。

title: Single-cell RNA-sequencing of peripheral blood mononuclear cells reveals widespread, context-specific gene expression regulation upon pathogenic exposure
key_claim_en: PBMC scRNA-seq, 120 individuals, unstimulated and 3 h or 24 h after three pathogens (about 1.3 million cells): 20.9% of eQTL genes are response eQTLs, mostly weakening after stimulation; effects follow cell type and time more than pathogen; most are detectable in bulk.
key_claim_zh: PBMC 单细胞 RNA-seq，120 名个体，未刺激及三种病原体刺激后 3 小时或 24 小时（约 1.3 百万个细胞）：20.9% 的 eQTL 基因是响应 eQTL，且多数在刺激后减弱；效应更多地随细胞类型和时间而非病原体而变；大多数在 bulk 数据中也能检出。
so_what_en: About one fifth of eQTL genes carry an interaction here (likely underestimated), so interaction terms need not be vanishingly rare; condition on cell type and time before stimulus identity.
so_what_zh: 此处约五分之一的 eQTL 基因带有交互效应（很可能被低估），因此交互项并非罕见到可忽略；应先按细胞类型和时间做条件，再考虑刺激物的种类。
caveat_en: Nature Communications full text read (PMC9174272). Stimuli are pathogens, not drugs; authors expect 20.9% to be underestimated; genome-wide concordance with bulk eQTLGen falls to 87.4%; Northern Netherlands donors only.
caveat_zh: 已阅读 Nature Communications 全文（PMC9174272）。刺激物是病原体而非药物；作者预计 20.9% 被低估；全基因组范围内与 bulk eQTLGen 的一致性降至 87.4%；仅限荷兰北部供体。

title: Single-cell RNA-sequencing of differentiating iPS cells reveals dynamic genetic effects on gene expression
key_claim_en: Pooled differentiation of iPSC lines from 125 donors (genotype-demultiplexed) toward endoderm, scRNA-seq at 4 time points (36,044 cells): 899 time-dynamic eQTLs among 4422; over 30% of eQTLs stage-specific; 668 eQTLs interact with cell-state factors; genetic-effect dynamics differ from expression dynamics.
key_claim_zh: 125 名供体的 iPSC 系混合向内胚层分化（按基因型解复用），4 个时间点的 scRNA-seq（36,044 个细胞）：4422 个 eQTL 中有 899 个随时间动态变化；超过 30% 的 eQTL 为阶段特异；668 个 eQTL 与细胞状态因子存在交互；遗传效应的动态与表达动态不同。
so_what_en: Genotype effects depend on cell state beyond clock time, and are not tied to expression level; pseudotime-defined stages beat collection days, and pooled genotype-demultiplexed designs scale donors.
so_what_zh: 基因型效应取决于时钟时间之外的细胞状态，且与表达水平无关；伪时间定义的阶段优于采样日，而混合并按基因型解复用的设计可扩大供体规模。
caveat_en: Published Nature Communications text read (PMC7010688); the bioRxiv preprint in the row was not. Not a drug study. The paper gives 899, 785 and 872 for dynamic eQTLs in different places; one line per donor.
caveat_zh: 读的是已发表的 Nature Communications 文本（PMC7010688），未读行中的 bioRxiv 预印本。不是药物研究。文中不同位置给出的动态 eQTL 数分别为 899、785 和 872；每名供体只有一个细胞系。

title: Single-cell allele-specific expression analysis reveals dynamic and cell-type-specific regulatory effects
key_claim_en: DAESC tests differential allele-specific expression in single-cell data from many donors (beta-binomial, donor random effects, implicit haplotype phasing). On 30,474 cells from 105 iPSC lines (GD18 data) it finds 657 dynamic genes, 27.5% previously reported as dynamic eGenes; without phasing, 324 genes.
key_claim_zh: DAESC 在来自多名供体的单细胞数据中检验差异等位基因特异表达（beta-binomial 模型，供体随机效应，隐式单倍型定相）。在 105 个 iPSC 系的 30,474 个细胞（GD18 的数据）上，它找到 657 个动态基因，其中 27.5% 此前已被报告为动态 eGene；不做定相时为 324 个基因。
so_what_en: ASE offers an internal control for genotype-by-state effects at single-cell level, but power relies on implicit phasing and the mixture model inflates type I error (8.5% at nominal 5%).
so_what_zh: ASE 为单细胞水平的基因型×状态效应提供内部对照，但功效依赖隐式定相，且混合模型会使 I 类错误率偏高（名义 5% 时为 8.5%）。
caveat_en: Nature Communications full text read (PMC10562474). Performance numbers are the authors' own simulations and an overlap check against GD18; not a drug dataset; DAESC-Mix is meant for 20 or more donors.
caveat_zh: 已阅读 Nature Communications 全文（PMC10562474）。性能数字来自作者自己的模拟以及与 GD18 的重叠检查；并非药物数据集；DAESC-Mix 适用于 20 名或更多供体。

title: Single-cell eQTL models reveal dynamic T cell state dependence of disease loci
key_claim_en: Single-cell eQTL modelling in unstimulated memory T cells (over 500,000 cells, 259 Peruvian individuals): about one third of 6,511 cis-eQTLs have effects mediated by continuous cell states such as cytotoxicity; continuous states explain more eQTL variation than discrete categories (CD4 versus CD8); genotypes are controlled-access.
key_claim_zh: 未刺激的记忆 T 细胞的单细胞 eQTL 建模（超过 500,000 个细胞，259 名秘鲁个体）：6,511 个 cis-eQTL 中约三分之一的效应由细胞毒性等连续细胞状态介导；连续状态比离散类别（CD4 对 CD8）解释更多的 eQTL 变异；基因型为受控访问。
so_what_en: Cell state, not only cell type, mediates genotype effects even without treatment (about one third of 6,511 eQTLs), so a genotype-aware model should condition on a continuous state.
so_what_zh: 即使没有处理，细胞状态而不仅是细胞类型也在介导基因型效应（6,511 个 eQTL 中约三分之一），因此感知基因型的模型应以连续状态为条件。
caveat_en: Abstract, figure titles and data statements only (paywalled Nature page preview); methods and results were not read. Cells are unstimulated, so this is not a drug dataset.
caveat_zh: 仅读到摘要、图标题和数据说明（Nature 页面的付费墙预览）；未读方法和结果。细胞未经刺激，因此这不是药物数据集。

title: Single-cell sequencing reveals lineage-specific dynamic genetic regulation of gene expression during human cardiomyocyte differentiation
key_claim_en: iPSC-to-cardiomyocyte time course, 19 cell lines, 7 days, Drop-seq (131 samples): pseudotime plus lineage split found 357 cardiomyocyte and 903 cardiac-fibroblast genes with dynamic eQTLs, versus 142 and 29 using collection day, and 5 with lineages pooled.
key_claim_zh: iPSC 到心肌细胞的时间进程，19 个细胞系，7 个采样日，Drop-seq（131 个样本）：伪时间加谱系拆分发现心肌谱系 357 个、心脏成纤维谱系 903 个基因有动态 eQTL，而用采样日只有 142 和 29 个，谱系合并时仅 5 个。
so_what_en: Genotype-by-time effects are missed unless inferred state replaces collection day and lineages are separated; for drug response, a per-cell response pseudotime may be needed because line-specific pace confounds clock time.
so_what_zh: 除非用推断的状态取代采样日并拆分谱系，否则基因型×时间效应会被漏掉；对药物响应，可能需要逐细胞的响应伪时间，因为各细胞系的速度差异会混淆时钟时间。
caveat_en: PLOS Genetics full text read (PMC). Developmental differentiation, not drug exposure; only 19 lines; counts are the authors' own at q < 0.05.
caveat_zh: 已阅读 PLOS Genetics 全文（PMC）。是发育分化而非药物暴露；仅 19 个细胞系；计数为作者自己在 q < 0.05 下得到。

title: Base editing screens define the genetic landscape of cancer drug resistance mechanisms
key_claim_en: Base editing (11 cancer genes, 32,476 variants, ten drugs, four lines) defines four variant classes: drug addiction, canonical resistance, driver, sensitizing. Perturb-seq in HT-29 under dabrafenib plus cetuximab (27,823 cells): 22 of 35 resistance gRNAs change transcriptomes; addiction variants most.
key_claim_zh: 碱基编辑筛选（11 个癌症基因、32,476 个变异、十种药物、四个细胞系）定义了四类变异：药物成瘾、经典耐药、驱动、增敏。在 dabrafenib 加 cetuximab 处理的 HT-29 中做 Perturb-seq（27,823 个细胞）：35 个耐药 gRNA 中 22 个改变转录组，其中成瘾变异影响最大。
so_what_en: The four classes (advantage only with drug, only without drug, always, or sensitizing) map onto baseline-shift versus drug-operator effects, and Perturb-seq shows class-specific transcriptional states.
so_what_zh: 四类变异（仅在有药时有优势、仅在无药时有害、始终有优势、或增敏）对应基线平移与药物算子两类效应，且 Perturb-seq 显示各类有各自的转录状态。
caveat_en: Nature Genetics full text read (PMC). Cancer cell lines, not donors; base editing is not saturating; resistance map has 35.29% concordance with COSMIC and literature.
caveat_zh: 已阅读 Nature Genetics 全文（PMC）。是癌细胞系而非供体；碱基编辑不饱和；耐药图谱与 COSMIC 和文献的一致性为 35.29%。

title: Massively parallel phenotyping of coding variants in cancer with Perturb-seq
key_claim_en: Pooled Perturb-seq (sc-eVIP) of 200 TP53 and KRAS variants in over 300,000 lung cancer cells sorts variants into gain-of-function, loss-of-function and dominant-negative subsets; KRAS variants span a continuum, and impact is not predictable from patient-cohort frequency.
key_claim_zh: 对 200 个 TP53 和 KRAS 变异在超过 300,000 个肺癌细胞中做混合 Perturb-seq（sc-eVIP），把变异分为功能获得、功能丧失和显性负效应子集；KRAS 变异呈连续谱，其影响无法由患者队列频率预测。
so_what_en: Variant effects on transcriptomes are graded, not binary, supporting a continuous variant-effect covariate for coding variants. There is no drug arm in the Perturb-seq itself.
so_what_zh: 变异对转录组的效应是渐变而非二元的，支持为编码变异使用连续的变异效应协变量。Perturb-seq 本身没有药物处理组。
caveat_en: Abstract, figure titles, extended-data legends and data statements only (paywalled preview); main text not read. Nutlin-3 and etoposide appear only as orthogonal growth assays.
caveat_zh: 仅读到摘要、图标题、扩展数据图注和数据说明（付费墙预览），未读正文。Nutlin-3 和 etoposide 仅作为正交的生长实验出现。

title: Interface-guided phenotyping of coding variants in the transcription factor RUNX1
key_claim_en: SEUSS Perturb-seq of 115 RUNX1 variants in K562 cells: 40,522 single-variant cells (median 136 per variant with endogenous RUNX1 knocked down); variants fall into WT-like, LoF-like and hypomorphic groups; cancer recurrence does not predict impact; overexpression gives 1.6 to 3.5 times endogenous protein.
key_claim_zh: 在 K562 细胞中对 115 个 RUNX1 变异做 SEUSS Perturb-seq：40,522 个单变异细胞（内源 RUNX1 被敲低后每个变异中位数 136 个细胞）；变异分为 WT-like、LoF-like 和 hypomorphic 三组；癌症中的复发频率不能预测影响；过表达使蛋白量达内源的 1.6 至 3.5 倍。
so_what_en: A graded WT-like, hypomorphic, LoF-like label scheme for coding variants from transcriptome clustering. Authors note base editing keeps endogenous levels but edits incompletely.
so_what_zh: 从转录组聚类得到的、对编码变异分为 WT-like、hypomorphic、LoF-like 的渐变标签方案。作者指出碱基编辑可保持内源水平，但编辑不完全。
caveat_en: Full text read from a lab-hosted PDF of the published Cell Reports article. Single cell line (K562), overexpression constructs, no drug arm.
caveat_zh: 全文取自实验室网站托管的已发表 Cell Reports 文章 PDF。仅一个细胞系（K562）、使用过表达构建体、无药物处理组。

title: Joint genotypic and phenotypic outcome modeling improves base editing variant effect quantification
key_claim_en: BEAN, a Bayesian network, corrects base-editing screen effect sizes using per-guide editing outcomes from a reporter plus chromatin accessibility; editing preference depends on local sequence context and PAM; LDLR saturation editing is consistent with UK Biobank LDL-C (self-reported).
key_claim_zh: BEAN 是一个贝叶斯网络，利用报告基因测得的逐 gRNA 编辑结果和染色质可及性来校正碱基编辑筛选的效应量；编辑偏好取决于局部序列背景和 PAM；LDLR 饱和编辑与 UK Biobank 的 LDL-C 一致（自报）。
so_what_en: Realized genotype in editing screens is variable; modeling per-guide editing outcomes is a template for handling uncertain genotype labels in perturbation models.
so_what_zh: 编辑筛选中实际形成的基因型并不固定；对逐 gRNA 编辑结果建模，可作为在扰动模型中处理不确定基因型标签的模板。
caveat_en: Published Nature Genetics page read as a paywalled preview (abstract, figure titles, extended-data legends); the medRxiv preprint in the row was not. Performance claims are self-reported.
caveat_zh: 读的是已发表 Nature Genetics 页面的付费墙预览（摘要、图标题、扩展数据图注），未读行中的 medRxiv 预印本。性能结论为自报。

title: Genome-scale analysis of interactions between genetic perturbations and natural variation
key_claim_en: Yeast cross, 169 segregants, 8,046 CRISPRi gRNAs (1,721 genes), fitness readout: 460 genes had background-dependent effects; 234 interacting loci mapped, 157 (67.1%) in four hubs; 51.4% of the genetic basis of deviations attributed to higher-order epistasis.
key_claim_zh: 酵母杂交后代：169 个分离子、8,046 条 CRISPRi 向导 RNA（1,721 个基因），以适合度为读出：460 个基因的扰动效应依赖遗传背景；定位到 234 个互作位点，其中 157 个（67.1%）落在四个枢纽位点；偏差的遗传基础中有 51.4% 归因于高阶上位性。
so_what_en: Four hubs hold 67.1% of mapped loci, so genotype-by-perturbation interaction looks concentrated, a sparsity prior; but the readout is fitness, not expression.
so_what_zh: 四个枢纽位点占已定位位点的 67.1%，说明基因型与扰动的互作较为集中，可作稀疏性先验；但读出是适合度而非表达。
caveat_en: Published Nature Communications version read in full (Europe PMC). Readout is yeast growth fitness under CRISPRi knockdown, not expression or drug; 169 segregants limited power to map loci.
caveat_zh: 已完整阅读 Nature Communications 发表版（Europe PMC）。读出是 CRISPRi 敲低下的酵母生长适合度，不是表达或药物；169 个分离子限制了位点定位的统计效力。

title: Responsiveness to perturbations is a hallmark of transcription factors that maintain cell identity in vitro
key_claim_en: Perturbation panel profiling (P3) perturbs cells across many conditions and reads out transcriptome-wide responsiveness; in human iPSC-derived cardiac myocytes, differentiation- and maintenance-related transcription factors were among the most frequently upregulated genes, and suppressing responsive TFs in fibroblasts enhanced reprogramming.
key_claim_zh: 扰动面板谱分析（P3）在多种条件下扰动细胞并读出全转录组响应性；在人 iPSC 来源的心肌细胞中，与分化和维持相关的转录因子属于上调最频繁的基因，在成纤维细胞中抑制响应性转录因子可增强重编程。
so_what_en: Gene-level responsiveness across a perturbation panel is a candidate prior for which genes a predictor should expect to move, and it ties responsiveness to cell identity.
so_what_zh: 跨扰动面板的基因级响应性可作为预测器预期哪些基因会变动的候选先验，并把响应性与细胞身份联系起来。
caveat_en: Abstract only; full text not retrieved, so panel size, perturbation types and donor design are unverified.
caveat_zh: 仅有摘要；未取得全文，因此面板规模、扰动类型和供体设计均未核实。

title: A reversible SRC-relayed COX2 inflammatory program drives resistance to BRAF and EGFR inhibition in BRAFV600E colorectal tumors
key_claim_en: BRAFV600E colorectal lines: BRAF ± EGFR inhibition raises SRC activity through an autocrine PGE2-GNAS loop, independent of ERK rebound; SRC inhibition lowered all 7 tested β-catenin target mRNAs (qRT-PCR); adding celecoxib to a BRAF/MEK/EGFR triplet raised PDX tumor regression from 30% to 78%.
key_claim_zh: BRAFV600E 结直肠癌细胞系：BRAF ± EGFR 抑制通过自分泌 PGE2-GNAS 环路提高 SRC 活性，且独立于 ERK 反弹；抑制 SRC 使检测的全部 7 个 β-catenin 靶基因 mRNA 下降（qRT-PCR）；在 BRAF/MEK/EGFR 三药方案上加用 celecoxib，使 PDX 肿瘤消退比例由 30% 升至 78%。
so_what_en: Same BRAFV600E mutation triggers a lineage-specific bypass program absent in melanoma, so predictors need tissue and pathway-state context beyond genotype; transcripts were measured only for 7 genes.
so_what_zh: 同一 BRAFV600E 突变在结直肠癌中触发黑色素瘤中没有的谱系特异性旁路程序，因此预测器需要基因型之外的组织与通路状态背景；转录水平仅测了 7 个基因。
caveat_en: Published Nature Cancer version read in full. Transcription was assayed only by qRT-PCR of 7 targets in 8 cell lines; efficacy rests on 2-3 mouse PDX models lacking an immune system.
caveat_zh: 已完整阅读 Nature Cancer 发表版。转录仅用 qRT-PCR 检测 8 个细胞系中的 7 个靶基因；疗效依赖 2-3 个缺乏免疫系统的小鼠 PDX 模型。

title: Signaling and transcriptional dynamics underlying early adaptation to oncogenic BRAF inhibition
key_claim_en: BRAF-mutant melanoma model under BRAF inhibitor, phosphoproteomics plus RNA-seq from minutes to days: three reversible phase transitions toward quiescence; compensatory SRC-family kinase induction, partly via reactive oxygen species; SFK inhibitor co-treatment sensitized patient-derived lines and a xenograft.
key_claim_zh: BRAF 突变黑色素瘤模型在 BRAF 抑制剂处理下，用磷酸化蛋白质组加 RNA-seq 覆盖从分钟到数天：向静止状态有三个可逆的相变；SRC 家族激酶发生代偿性诱导，部分经由活性氧；联用 SFK 抑制剂使患者来源细胞系和一个异种移植模型致敏。
so_what_en: Shows BRAF-inhibitor adaptation unfolding from minutes to days, with a ROS-linked SFK bypass; a response model needs a time axis. Data access is unverified.
so_what_zh: 显示 BRAF 抑制剂适应从分钟延续到数天，并伴有与活性氧相关的 SFK 旁路；响应模型需要时间轴。数据可获得性未核实。
caveat_en: Abstract only (preprint metadata); full text not retrieved. Published later as Cell Systems 2025 (DOI 10.1016/j.cels.2025.101239), which was not read; claims may differ.
caveat_zh: 仅有摘要（预印本元数据）；未取得全文。后来以 Cell Systems 2025 发表（DOI 10.1016/j.cels.2025.101239），该版本未阅读；结论可能不同。

title: Adaptive chromatin remodeling and transcriptional changes of the functional kinome in tumor cells in response to targeted kinase inhibition
key_claim_en: Review: 7 days of trametinib changed up to 22% of the transcriptome in five basal-like and one claudin-low TNBC tumors; SUM229PE subpopulations with similar genomes responded differently; dabrafenib and vemurafenib upregulated different tyrosine kinases in M14 melanoma cells, sharing only PTK7.
key_claim_zh: 综述：曲美替尼治疗 7 天使 5 例基底样和 1 例 claudin-low 三阴性乳腺癌（TNBC）肿瘤中多达 22% 的转录组发生变化；基因组相近的 SUM229PE 亚群反应不同；达拉非尼与维莫非尼在 M14 黑色素瘤细胞中上调不同的酪氨酸激酶，仅共有 PTK7。
so_what_en: Similar-genome subpopulations and same-target drugs give different transcriptional responses, so a genotype-aware model should condition on cell state and drug identity, not on target genotype alone.
so_what_zh: 基因组相近的亚群和靶点相同的药物给出不同的转录响应，因此基因型感知模型应以细胞状态和药物身份为条件，而不只依赖靶点基因型。
caveat_en: Full text of a review read; figures are relayed from cited primary studies, not checked. The abstract's BRAF-MEK-ERK versus PI3K-AKT contrast has no side-by-side data in the body.
caveat_zh: 已阅读一篇综述的全文；数字转引自所引用的一手研究，未核查。摘要中 BRAF-MEK-ERK 与 PI3K-AKT 的对比在正文中没有并列数据。

title: Mechanistic model of MAPK signaling reveals how allostery and rewiring contribute to drug resistance
key_claim_en: ODE model (MARM2.0) fitted to proteomic, transcriptomic and imaging data from BRAFV600E melanoma cells: two parallel MAPK channels (BRAFV600E- and RAS-driven) with different RAF/MEK inhibitor sensitivity, plus slow transcriptional feedback, create a drug-adapted state; extended to NRASQ61K melanoma and colorectal cells.
key_claim_zh: ODE 模型（MARM2.0）拟合 BRAFV600E 黑色素瘤细胞的蛋白质组、转录组和成像数据：两条并行的 MAPK 通道（BRAFV600E 驱动与 RAS 驱动）对 RAF/MEK 抑制剂的敏感性不同，加上缓慢的转录反馈，形成药物适应状态；并扩展到 NRASQ61K 黑色素瘤和结直肠细胞。
so_what_en: Mechanistic reference for class-4 adaptation with signaling over seconds to minutes and transcriptional feedback over hours; but only three mRNAs are modeled and BRAFV600E zygosity cannot be distinguished.
so_what_zh: 为 4 类适应提供机理参照：信号传导发生在秒到分钟，转录反馈发生在数小时；但只建模了三种 mRNA，且无法区分 BRAFV600E 的纯合与杂合。
caveat_en: Published Molecular Systems Biology 2023 version read, not the 2022 bioRxiv preprint; the preprint abstract claims a unified explanation across BRAF cancers, which the published abstract reduces to expected future development.
caveat_zh: 已阅读 Molecular Systems Biology 2023 年发表版，而非 2022 年的 bioRxiv 预印本；预印本摘要声称对 BRAF 癌症给出统一解释，发表版摘要则降为预期的后续发展。

title: The Inhibition of CDK8/19 Mediator Kinases Prevents the Development of Resistance to EGFR-Targeting Drugs
key_claim_en: Breast (BT474, SKBR3) and colon (SW48) cancer cells adapted to gefitinib, erlotinib or cetuximab within 10 weeks (81-day cetuximab run); selective CDK8/19 inhibitors senexin B and 15w prevented adaptation without synergy in most tests; no transcriptome was measured.
key_claim_zh: 乳腺癌（BT474、SKBR3）和结肠癌（SW48）细胞在 10 周内适应了吉非替尼、厄洛替尼或西妥昔单抗（西妥昔单抗实验为 81 天）；选择性 CDK8/19 抑制剂 senexin B 和 15w 阻止了适应，且多数检验中无协同；未测转录组。
so_what_en: Adaptation arose within weeks from small cell populations, too fast for selected mutations (authors' argument), so long-horizon response labels mix genotype with non-genetic state.
so_what_zh: 适应在数周内由少量细胞群体产生，快得不像是选择出的突变（作者的论证），因此长时程响应标签混合了基因型与非遗传状态。
caveat_en: Full text of the published Cells 2021 article read. Only growth assays in 3 cell lines; no RNA data, so the CDK8/19 transcriptional-reprogramming mechanism is inferred, not shown.
caveat_zh: 已阅读 Cells 2021 发表版全文。仅有 3 个细胞系的生长实验，没有 RNA 数据，因此 CDK8/19 的转录重编程机理只是推断，并未证实。

title: Common and cell-type specific responses to anti-cancer drugs revealed by high throughput transcript profiling
key_claim_en: L1000 profiles at 3 and 24 h for 109 drugs at six doses in six breast-derived cell lines (~600 drug-line pairs), paired with growth-rate phenotypes: chaperone and cell-cycle kinase inhibitors give similar signatures across lines; signaling-kinase inhibitors give cell-type-specific ones.
key_claim_zh: 在 6 个乳腺来源细胞系中，对 109 种药物、6 个剂量在 3 和 24 小时测 L1000 谱（约 600 个药物-细胞系对），并配以生长速率表型：伴侣蛋白和细胞周期激酶抑制剂在各细胞系中给出相似特征；信号激酶抑制剂给出细胞类型特异的特征。
so_what_en: Open dose- and time-resolved transcript-plus-growth data show pathway-drug responses are cell-type specific, but six lines cannot separate genotype from lineage.
so_what_zh: 开放的、剂量与时间分辨的转录加生长数据显示，通路类药物的响应具有细胞类型特异性，但 6 个细胞系无法区分基因型与谱系。
caveat_en: Published Nature Communications 2017 full text read. Only six lines; 37% of 7,825 conditions passed the consistency filter (SCS > 1.3); the abstract's ~600 pairs and the text's 7,825 'pairs' count different units.
caveat_zh: 已阅读 Nature Communications 2017 年发表版全文。仅有 6 个细胞系；7,825 个条件中仅 37% 通过一致性过滤（SCS > 1.3）；摘要中的约 600 个对与正文中的 7,825 个“对”计数单位不同。

title: Systems Analysis of Adaptive Responses to MAP Kinase Pathway Blockade in BRAF Mutant Melanoma
key_claim_en: 12 BRAF V600E melanoma lines (exome plus 8-hour PLX4720 microarray): homozygous V600E trended more sensitive (p = 0.049); ErbB family up-regulation was broad only in the 4-line group needing lapatinib plus PLX4720, ERBB2 alone in two groups, none in one.
key_claim_zh: 12 个 BRAF V600E 黑色素瘤细胞系（外显子组加 PLX4720 处理 8 小时的微阵列）：纯合 V600E 倾向更敏感（p = 0.049）；ErbB 家族上调仅在需要 lapatinib 联合 PLX4720 的 4 个细胞系组中广泛出现，两个组仅 ERBB2 上调，一个组无上调。
so_what_en: Same driver mutation, different adaptive transcriptional programs by line group, so predictors need cell-state or genotype context beyond the driver; group tests rest on 2-4 lines.
so_what_zh: 同一驱动突变下，不同细胞系组的适应性转录程序不同，因此预测器需要驱动突变之外的细胞状态或基因型背景；分组检验各只基于 2-4 个细胞系。
caveat_en: Full text of the 2015 PLoS ONE article read. One 8-hour time point on 12 lines (microarray); the zygosity link is a trend (p = 0.049) and the panel is enriched for homozygous V600E lines.
caveat_zh: 已阅读 2015 年 PLoS ONE 文章全文。12 个细胞系仅有一个 8 小时时间点（微阵列）；纯合性关联只是趋势（p = 0.049），且该组细胞系中纯合 V600E 比例偏高。

title: p53 mutations define the chromatin landscape to confer drug tolerance in pancreatic cancer
key_claim_en: Mouse PDAC cells with p53 R270H (human R273H): silencing the mutant changed about 3000 mRNAs and about 1300 ATAC sites, about 500 sites coupled to nearby expression change; the target MST1r was positively regulated, and its knockdown raised gemcitabine-induced caspase-3/7 activation.
key_claim_zh: 携带 p53 R270H（人 R273H）的小鼠胰腺导管腺癌细胞：沉默该突变体使约 3000 个 mRNA 和约 1300 个 ATAC 位点改变，其中约 500 个位点与邻近基因表达变化相耦合；靶基因 MST1r 受其正向调控，敲低 MST1r 使吉西他滨诱导的 caspase-3/7 激活增加。
so_what_en: Hotspot TP53 variant reshapes the baseline regulatory state, and drug tolerance is linked to a downstream target (MST1r); drug-induced transcription itself was not profiled.
so_what_zh: 热点 TP53 变异重塑基线调控状态，药物耐受与下游靶点（MST1r）相关；药物诱导的转录本身没有被检测。
caveat_en: Full text read. Text says about 1300 sites changed, legend over 1700; RNA-seq n = 3, ATAC-seq n = 2; profiling followed p53 silencing with no drug treatment stated; data only on request.
caveat_zh: 已阅读全文。正文称约 1300 个位点改变，图注称超过 1700 个；RNA-seq n = 3，ATAC-seq n = 2；检测在 p53 沉默后进行，未说明药物处理；数据仅应要求提供。

title: BRAF V600E-induced distinct DNA damage response defines the therapeutic potential of p53 activation for TP53 wild-type colorectal cancer
key_claim_en: Introducing BRAFV600E into two TP53 wild-type colorectal lines (SW48, LIM1215) gave opposite proliferation phenotypes (SW48 decreased, LIM1215 increased); oncogene-induced DNA damage response occurred in SW48 only, and LIM1215 was synergistically inhibited by MDM2 inhibitor plus MEK inhibitor.
key_claim_zh: 将 BRAFV600E 导入两个 TP53 野生型结直肠癌细胞系（SW48、LIM1215）产生相反的增殖表型（SW48 下降，LIM1215 上升）；癌基因诱导的 DNA 损伤反应仅在 SW48 中出现，而 LIM1215 被 MDM2 抑制剂加 MEK 抑制剂协同抑制。
so_what_en: One oncogenic variant moved proliferation of two TP53 wild-type lines in opposite directions, so a predictor needs background or cell-state inputs beyond the variant.
so_what_zh: 同一个癌基因变异使两个 TP53 野生型细胞系的增殖朝相反方向变化，因此预测器需要变异之外的背景或细胞状态输入。
caveat_en: Abstract only; the DOI fetch returned 403, so no full text. The abstract reports proliferation and DNA damage signaling, not transcription profiles.
caveat_zh: 仅有摘要；DOI 抓取返回 403，因此没有全文。摘要报告的是增殖与 DNA 损伤信号，而非转录谱。

title: Multiplexed single-cell transcriptional response profiling to define cancer vulnerabilities and therapeutic mechanism of action
key_claim_en: Pooled, SNP-demultiplexed scRNA-seq (24-99 lines, 13 drugs): nutlin moved all 7 TP53 wild-type lines, little in 17 TP53-mutant lines; BRAF-mutant lines' dabrafenib responses clustered with trametinib; trametinib MAPK genes fell by 3 h, cell-cycle genes at 12-24 h.
key_claim_zh: 合并 SNP 解复用的 scRNA-seq（24-99 个细胞系，13 种药物）：nutlin 使全部 7 个 TP53 野生型细胞系发生变化，而 17 个 TP53 突变细胞系变化很小；BRAF 突变细胞系对 dabrafenib 的响应与 trametinib 聚在一起；trametinib 的 MAPK 基因在 3 小时下降，细胞周期基因在 12-24 小时下降。
so_what_en: TP53 status switches nutlin's response on or off, an operator change rather than a baseline shift. Response-component estimates were more robust with 50 or more lines.
so_what_zh: TP53 状态使 nutlin 的响应开或关，是算子变化而非基线偏移。使用 50 个或更多细胞系时，响应成分的估计更稳健。
caveat_en: Published Nature Communications version read; the cited preprint was not. The TP53 contrast is across different lines (7 versus 17), not isogenic pairs; pooling could allow paracrine effects, which the authors judge modest.
caveat_zh: 已阅读 Nature Communications 发表版；所引预印本未读。TP53 的对比是在不同细胞系之间（7 个对 17 个），而非同源配对；混合培养可能带来旁分泌效应，作者认为影响不大。

title: Linking tumor mutations to drug responses via a quantitative chemical-genetic interaction map
key_claim_en: Isogenic-cell chemical-genetic map of the influence of 51 aberrant cancer genes on 90 drug responses; the map predicts drug responses in cancer cell line collections; in triple-negative breast cancer, MYC confers resistance to AKT-PI3K inhibitors and sensitivity to dasatinib through LYN (abstract).
key_claim_zh: 同基因细胞的化学-遗传相互作用图谱，描绘 51 个异常癌基因对 90 种药物响应的影响；该图谱可预测癌症细胞系集合中的药物响应；在三阴性乳腺癌中，MYC 带来对 AKT-PI3K 抑制剂的耐药和经由 LYN 对 dasatinib 的敏感性（摘要）。
so_what_en: Gene-by-drug labels in a controlled background without lineage confounding, usable to validate predicted genotype-by-drug interactions; the abstract reports no transcriptome readout.
so_what_zh: 在受控背景下、没有谱系混杂的基因×药物标签，可用于验证预测的基因型×药物交互；摘要没有报告转录组读出。
caveat_en: Abstract read through PubMed (PMID 25501949); the full text was not read, so the cell background and the assay readout are unchecked.
caveat_zh: 摘要通过 PubMed 阅读（PMID 25501949）；全文未读，因此细胞背景和检测读出未经核对。

title: A village in a dish model system for population-scale hiPSC studies
key_claim_en: Villages of 3 and 18 hiPSC lines, SNP-demultiplexed from scRNA-seq (88,927 and 29,055 cells after QC): in fresh samples village status explained 0.22% of expression variance versus 0.71% for line; line proportions drifted with growth rate (5 of 18 lines lost in 15 days).
key_claim_zh: 3 个和 18 个 hiPSC 细胞系的 village，经 scRNA-seq 的 SNP 解复用（质控后分别为 88,927 和 29,055 个细胞）：在新鲜样本中 village 状态解释表达方差的 0.22%，细胞系解释 0.71%；细胞系比例随生长速率漂移（18 个细胞系中 15 天内丢失 5 个）。
so_what_en: Villages preserved line-specific expression in fresh samples, but composition drifts with growth rate, so drug-perturbed villages need composition tracking; cryopreserved samples showed larger village effects.
so_what_zh: 混合培养（village）在新鲜样本中保留了细胞系特异的表达，但组成会随生长速率漂移，因此药物扰动的 village 需要追踪组成；冷冻保存样本显示出更大的 village 效应。
caveat_en: Full text read. Unperturbed hiPSC cultures only, no drug exposure; in cryopreserved samples village status explained more variance (2.19%) than line (1.13%).
caveat_zh: 已阅读全文。仅有未经扰动的 hiPSC 培养，没有药物暴露；在冷冻保存样本中，village 状态解释的方差（2.19%）多于细胞系（1.13%）。

title: Natural variation in gene expression and viral susceptibility revealed by neural progenitor cell villages
key_claim_en: Village of neural progenitor cells from 44 donors in a shared culture; donors assigned by Dropulation and Census-seq; a common variant regulating IFITM3 explains most inter-individual variation in Zika virus susceptibility; eQTLs at brain-trait GWAS loci detected.
key_claim_zh: 来自 44 名供体的神经祖细胞在共享培养中组成 village；用 Dropulation 和 Census-seq 将细胞分配到供体；一个调控 IFITM3 的常见变异解释了寨卡病毒易感性个体间差异的大部分；检出与脑性状 GWAS 位点对应的 eQTL。
so_what_en: Pooled-donor design gave a genotype-by-perturbation readout in which one common variant explains most inter-donor variation in virus susceptibility; the same design could carry drugs.
so_what_zh: 混合供体设计给出了基因型与扰动的读出：一个常见变异解释了病毒易感性供体间差异的大部分；同一设计可用于药物。
caveat_en: Abstract only; full-text retrieval failed, so donor-level data, effect sizes and the virus-exposure design are unverified.
caveat_zh: 仅有摘要；全文获取失败，因此供体层面的数据、效应大小和病毒暴露设计均未核实。

title: Genetic ancestry effects on the response to viral infection are pervasive but cell type specific
key_claim_en: scRNA-seq of influenza-infected PBMCs from European- and African-ancestry males: ancestry effects on response are common but highly cell-type specific; higher European ancestry goes with stronger early type I interferon activity; cis-eQTLs explain substantial population-associated variation.
key_claim_zh: 感染流感病毒的 PBMC 的 scRNA-seq，来自欧洲和非洲血统男性：血统对响应的影响很常见但高度细胞类型特异；欧洲血统比例越高，早期 I 型干扰素活性越强；cis-eQTL 解释了大量与群体相关的变异。
so_what_en: Ancestry-by-infection effects at single-cell resolution are cell-type specific and substantially cis-regulatory, so a predictor needs cell-type-resolved genotype inputs and ancestry-aware splits.
so_what_zh: 单细胞分辨率下的血统乘感染效应具有细胞类型特异性且在很大程度上由顺式调控，因此预测器需要细胞类型分辨的基因型输入和考虑血统的数据划分。
caveat_en: Abstract only; the publisher page returned 403 and no full text was retrieved, so sample size, infection duration and effect sizes are unverified.
caveat_zh: 仅有摘要；出版商页面返回 403，未取得全文，因此样本量、感染时长和效应大小均未核实。

title: Characterization of caffeine response regulatory variants in vascular endothelial cells
key_claim_en: BiT-STARR-seq reporter assay in HUVECs with 1.16 mM caffeine for 24 h (6 replicates per condition): over 43,000 variants designed; 665 SNPs with allelic effects (FDR < 10%, 30,680 tested); 6 conditional allele-specific effects (FDR < 5%, 15,927 tested).
key_claim_zh: 在 HUVEC 中用 1.16 mM 咖啡因处理 24 小时的 BiT-STARR-seq 报告基因实验（每个条件 6 个重复）：设计了 43,000 多个变异；665 个 SNP 有等位基因效应（FDR < 10%，检测 30,680 个）；6 个条件性等位基因特异效应（FDR < 5%，检测 15,927 个）。
so_what_en: Count of regulatory-variant-by-drug interaction: 6 of 15,927 tested variants at FDR < 5%, a sparsity anchor for the interaction term; reporter context with one dose and one cell type.
so_what_zh: 调控变异与药物互作的计数：15,927 个被检变异中有 6 个（FDR < 5%），为互作项的稀疏性提供锚点；报告基因背景，仅一个剂量和一种细胞类型。
caveat_en: Published eLife version read. Its Discussion still says 'several thousand instances of GxE', inconsistent with 6 variants; the 665 allelic effects use FDR < 10% versus 5% for the 6; earlier-version counts unverified.
caveat_zh: 已阅读 eLife 发表版。其讨论部分仍写有“数千个 GxE 实例”，与 6 个变异不一致；665 个等位基因效应使用 FDR < 10%，而 6 个使用 5%；早期版本的计数未核实。

title: Rare cell variability and drug-induced reprogramming as a mode of cancer drug resistance
key_claim_en: Vemurafenib, patient-derived melanoma lines: rare pre-resistant cells (1:50 to 1:500) express resistance markers; EGFR-high cells gave 7.9-fold more resistant colonies; the transient state is then reprogrammed by drug (966 of 1456 resistance genes >80% activated by week 4; 1787 accessible sites lost, 9143 gained).
key_claim_zh: 维莫非尼处理患者来源的黑色素瘤细胞系：罕见的预耐药细胞（1:50 至 1:500）高表达耐药标志基因；EGFR 高表达细胞产生的耐药集落多 7.9 倍；该瞬时状态随后被药物重编程（第 4 周 1456 个耐药基因中有 966 个激活超过 80%；1787 个可及位点丢失，9143 个获得）。
so_what_en: Pre-treatment cell-state heterogeneity predisposes the response within one genotype, and drug then reprograms chromatin; a predictor should output a distribution over cell states, not a population mean.
so_what_zh: 处理前的细胞状态异质性在同一基因型内就决定了响应倾向，药物随后重编程染色质；预测器应输出细胞状态的分布，而不是群体均值。
caveat_en: Full text read (Europe PMC copy). Main results come from two patient-derived lines, with 2-3 biological replicates; the authors note selection could mimic reprogramming and argue against it using APCDD1.
caveat_zh: 已阅读全文（Europe PMC 副本）。主要结果来自两个患者来源细胞系，生物学重复 2-3 个；作者指出选择效应可能模拟重编程，并用 APCDD1 加以反驳。

title: A CRISPR-drug perturbational map for identifying compounds to combine with commonly used chemotherapeutics
key_claim_en: CRISPR knockout screens of 655 druggable genes in 18 cell lines (10 neuroblastoma) with 8 drugs (94,320 combinations; pooled readout, gRNA abundance drug versus vehicle): known drug targets ranked among top resistance hits; signal clustered by cell line; PRKDC knockout was top doxorubicin sensitizer.
key_claim_zh: 针对 655 个可成药基因的 CRISPR 敲除筛选，覆盖 18 个细胞系（其中 10 个神经母细胞瘤）和 8 种药物（94,320 个组合；混合培养读出，即药物组与溶剂组的 gRNA 丰度比）：已知药物靶点位居耐药命中前列；信号按细胞系聚类；PRKDC 敲除是最强的多柔比星增敏因子。
so_what_en: Ground-truth-style gene-by-drug sensitization labels for 144 screens, strongly cell-line specific (no knockout sensitized more than 7 of 10 neuroblastoma lines to a drug); growth readout, no transcriptome.
so_what_zh: 为 144 个筛选提供类似真值的基因×药物增敏标签，细胞系特异性很强（没有任何敲除能在 10 个神经母细胞瘤细胞系中使超过 7 个对某药增敏）；读出是生长，没有转录组。
caveat_en: Published Nature Communications version read in full. Gene knockouts at IC20-IC30 doses with growth readout, not variants or transcripts; authors say the screen is not large enough to resolve context specificity of many hits.
caveat_zh: 已完整阅读 Nature Communications 发表版。基因敲除，IC20-IC30 剂量，生长读出，不是变异也不是转录本；作者称该筛选规模不足以解析许多命中的情境特异性。

title: A Next Generation Connectivity Map: L1000 Platform and the First 1,000,000 Profiles
key_claim_en: Abstract: the L1000 reduced-representation assay underlies a more than 1,000-fold scale-up of the Connectivity Map; 1.3 million profiles are released (clue.io), and L1000 supports computational inference of 81% of non-measured transcripts (self-reported).
key_claim_zh: 摘要：L1000 简化表征检测支撑了 Connectivity Map 超过 1,000 倍的扩容；发布了 1.3 百万条谱（clue.io），且 L1000 支持对 81% 的未测转录本进行计算推断（自报）。
so_what_en: Public pool of 1.3 million perturbational L1000 profiles, a candidate pretraining set; its stated use for annotating disease-gene variants suggests expression signatures can read out variant function (self-reported).
so_what_zh: 1.3 百万条扰动 L1000 谱的公开数据池，可作预训练候选；其声称可用于注释疾病基因变异，提示表达特征可读出变异功能（自报）。
caveat_en: Preprint abstract only; full text not on disk. The Cell version (2017) was not read.
caveat_zh: 仅有预印本摘要，磁盘上没有全文；未读 Cell 版本（2017）。
