title: GEO series GSE92742: L1000 Connectivity Map perturbational profiles (LINCS Phase I)
key_claim_en: GEO series GSE92742 (LINCS L1000 Phase I, updated 2017-03-03): n=1,319,138 perturbational profiles on platform GPL20573; related series GSE92743 and GSE70138.
key_claim_zh: GEO 系列 GSE92742（LINCS L1000 第一阶段，2017-03-03 更新）：n=1,319,138 个扰动谱，平台 GPL20573；相关系列 GSE92743 和 GSE70138。
so_what_en: Identifies the accessions to pull for LINCS L1000 data; the record names no genotype or donor, so genotype labels need external annotation.
so_what_zh: 指明获取 LINCS L1000 数据所需的登录号；记录没有提到基因型或供体，基因型标签需要外部注释。
caveat_en: GEO SOFT record read; the data files were not downloaded.
caveat_zh: 已阅读 GEO SOFT 记录；数据文件未下载。

title: signatureSearchData: Reference Data for Gene Expression Signature Searching
key_claim_en: LINCS 2017: 19,811 small molecules on ~70 cell lines (default uniform subset at 10 uM and 24 h: 45,956 signatures, 30 lines); LINCS2 beta: >80k perturbations, >200 cell lines, over 3M profiles, packaged as 136,460 exemplar signatures over 58 lines.
key_claim_zh: LINCS 2017：19,811 种小分子，约 70 个细胞系（默认的统一条件子集为 10 uM、24 h：45,956 个特征、30 个细胞系）；LINCS2 beta：>80k 个扰动、>200 个细胞系、超过 3M 条谱，打包为 58 个细胞系上的 136,460 个代表性特征。
so_what_en: Ready-made signature reference with dose and time collapsed to 10 uM and 24 h; LINCS2 exemplar signatures are generally picked by highest transcriptional activity, which likely biases toward strong responders.
so_what_zh: 现成的特征参考库，剂量和时间被固定为 10 uM 与 24 h；LINCS2 的代表性特征一般按最高转录活性挑选，很可能偏向强响应者。
caveat_en: Bioconductor package vignette (build of 05 May 2026) read in full, not the gitlink mirror recorded in the URL; the vignette is internally inconsistent (8,104 vs 8,140 compounds; five vs eight CMap2 cell lines).
caveat_zh: 已完整读取 Bioconductor 包的 vignette（2026 年 05 月 05 日构建），而非 URL 中记录的 gitlink 镜像；该 vignette 内部不一致（8,104 与 8,140 种化合物；CMap2 细胞系五个与八个）。

title: Tahoe-100M: A Giga-Scale Single-Cell Perturbation Atlas for Context-Dependent Gene Function and Cellular Modeling
key_claim_en: Preprint abstract (v3): 100 million single-cell transcriptomes from 50 cancer cell lines under 1,100 small-molecule perturbations, profiled in a 'cell village' (Mosaic platform) that reduces batch effects; line assignment and doses are not described in the abstract.
key_claim_zh: 预印本摘要（v3）：来自 50 个癌细胞系、在 1,100 种小分子扰动下的 100 million 个单细胞转录组，采用可减少批次效应的“cell village”（Mosaic 平台）进行检测；摘要未说明细胞如何归属到细胞系，也未说明剂量。
so_what_en: Self-described largest single-cell dataset; the genotype axis is limited to 50 cell lines, so genotype effects are confounded with line identity unless line-level driver annotations are used (DS07).
so_what_zh: 自称是迄今最大的单细胞数据集；基因型维度仅限于 50 个细胞系，除非使用细胞系层面的驱动突变注释（DS07），否则基因型效应与细胞系身份混杂。
caveat_en: Abstract of preprint v3 only; no full text. This abstract says 1,100 perturbations; the Cell version (DS06) says 1,100 drug-dose conditions.
caveat_zh: 仅有预印本 v3 的摘要，无全文。本摘要称 1,100 种扰动；Cell 版本（DS06）称 1,100 个药物-剂量条件。

title: Tahoe-100M: Mapping drug-induced molecular phenotypes at single-cell resolution
key_claim_en: Cell version abstract: 100 million transcriptomes, 50 cancer cell lines (genetically distinct lines multiplexed in 'cell villages'), 1,100 drug-dose conditions; atlas quantifies proliferation, cytotoxicity and cell-cycle change, and whether responses diverge or converge across cells (self-reported).
key_claim_zh: Cell 版本摘要：100 million 个转录组，50 个癌细胞系（遗传背景不同的细胞系复用于“cell village”），1,100 个药物-剂量条件；图谱量化增殖、细胞毒性和细胞周期变化，以及细胞响应是发散还是收敛（自报）。
so_what_en: Reported divergent-versus-convergent drug responses imply that single-cell distributions, not means, are the prediction target; genetically distinct lines make line identity the available genotype handle.
so_what_zh: 所报告的发散与收敛药物响应意味着预测目标应是单细胞分布而非均值；遗传背景不同的细胞系使细胞系身份成为可用的基因型抓手。
caveat_en: EuropePMC abstract only; full text not on disk; counts self-reported. Differences versus the preprint (DS05) cannot be assessed beyond the abstracts.
caveat_zh: 仅有 EuropePMC 摘要，磁盘上没有全文；数字为自报。除摘要外无法评估与预印本（DS05）的差异。

title: tahoebio/Tahoe-100M (Hugging Face dataset page)
key_claim_en: Hugging Face card: over 100 million profiles, 50 cancer cell lines, 1,100 small-molecule perturbations, raw counts in sparse form; tables for samples (with concentration), 379 drugs, and per-line driver mutations (gene, zygosity, variant type, loss- or gain-of-function); CC0 licence.
key_claim_zh: Hugging Face 数据卡：超过 100 million 条谱，来自 50 个癌细胞系、1,100 种小分子扰动，以稀疏形式存储原始计数；另有样本表（含浓度）、379 种药物表，以及按细胞系的驱动突变表（基因、纯合/杂合、变异类型、功能缺失或获得）；CC0 许可。
so_what_en: Per-line driver-mutation labels (zygosity, loss/gain of function) give a ready genotype conditioning input for drug response, but with only 50 lines, driver effects are confounded with each line's background.
so_what_zh: 按细胞系的驱动突变标签（纯合/杂合、功能缺失/获得）可直接作为药物响应的基因型条件输入，但仅有 50 个细胞系，驱动突变效应与各细胞系的背景相混杂。
caveat_en: Dataset card read as rendered text; viewer lists 95.6M expression rows but 101M obs_metadata rows; drug target and mechanism labels are model-proposed then vendor-validated, not measured.
caveat_zh: 数据卡以渲染文本读取；查看器列出 95.6M 行表达数据，但 obs_metadata 有 101M 行；药物靶点与作用机制标签由模型提出再经厂商目录验证，并非实测。

title: Genome-scale perturb-seq in primary human CD4+ T cells maps context-specific regulators of T cell programs and human immune traits
key_claim_en: Abstract: all expressed genes perturbed across 22 million primary CD4+ T cells from four donors, profiled at rest and after stimulation; active regulators and the programs they control change dramatically with stimulation (self-reported).
key_claim_zh: 摘要：在来自四名供体的 22 million 个原代 CD4+ T 细胞中扰动所有表达基因，并在静息和刺激后检测；活跃调控因子及其控制的程序随刺激而显著变化（自报）。
so_what_en: Rest-versus-stimulation changes in regulators are a qualitative anchor for context-dependent action effects; with only four donors, germline-by-perturbation effects are probably underpowered.
so_what_zh: 静息与刺激之间调控因子的变化是情境依赖作用效应的定性锚点；仅有四名供体时，种系与扰动的交互效应很可能把握度不足。
caveat_en: Abstract only; the full text of neither the 2025 preprint nor the 2026 Cell version is on disk; the abstract does not mention donor-level effects.
caveat_zh: 仅有摘要；2025 年预印本和 2026 年 Cell 版本的全文均不在磁盘上；摘要未提及供体层面的效应。

title: A Perturbation Cell Atlas of Human Induced Pluripotent Stem Cells
key_claim_en: Preprint abstract: expressed-genome-scale CRISPRi Perturbation Cell Atlas in KOLF2.1J hiPSCs covering 11,739 targeted genes, with transcriptional and fitness phenotypes; a contrastive machine-learning framework (CHEF) learns from perturbation atlases to predict perturbation recipes for desired transcriptional states.
key_claim_zh: 预印本摘要：在 KOLF2.1J hiPSC 中构建的“表达基因的基因组规模”CRISPRi 扰动细胞图谱，覆盖 11,739 个靶向基因，含转录和适应度表型；对比式机器学习框架 CHEF 从扰动图谱学习，预测达成目标转录状态的扰动配方。
so_what_en: Single-line expressed-genome-scale CRISPRi reference (one genetic background), plus CHEF as a precedent for inverse design from perturbation atlases; reported as a proposal, with no performance numbers in the abstract.
so_what_zh: 单一细胞系（单一遗传背景）的表达基因规模 CRISPRi 参考，加上 CHEF 作为从扰动图谱做逆向设计的先例；摘要中仅为提议，没有性能数字。
caveat_en: Abstract of bioRxiv v2 only; no full text. It says 'expressed genome-scale' with 11,739 targeted genes, not genome-wide.
caveat_zh: 仅有 bioRxiv v2 的摘要，无全文。摘要称“表达基因的基因组规模”并靶向 11,739 个基因，而不是全基因组。

title: Benchmarking and optimizing Perturb-seq in differentiating human pluripotent stem cells
key_claim_en: CRISPRi Perturb-seq benchmark (1,996,260 sequenced cells) in H9 ESC and WTC11 iPSC lines during cardiomyocyte and neural-progenitor differentiation; promoter knockdown about 70% (WTC11) versus 60% (H9); NKX2-5 and TBX20 perturbation effects were consistent between lines; data on the IGVF Data Portal.
key_claim_zh: CRISPRi Perturb-seq 基准（1,996,260 个测序细胞），在 H9 ESC 与 WTC11 iPSC 细胞系中，覆盖心肌细胞和神经祖细胞分化；启动子敲低效率 WTC11 约 70%、H9 约 60%；NKX2-5 与 TBX20 的扰动效应在两个细胞系间一致；数据在 IGVF Data Portal。
so_what_en: Core cardiac TF perturbation programs agreed between an ESC and an iPSC line despite different knockdown strength, hinting at small background-by-perturbation interaction; only two lines, agreement shown in figures.
so_what_zh: 核心心脏转录因子的扰动程序在一个 ESC 与一个 iPSC 细胞系之间一致，尽管敲低强度不同，提示背景与扰动的交互可能较小；仅有两个细胞系，一致性只在图中展示。
caveat_en: EuropePMC full text of the published article read; agreement is qualitative (no correlation value in text); proliferative TP53 knockdown skewed coverage, so only TP53 was analysed in the 64-TF screen.
caveat_zh: 读取的是 EuropePMC 上已发表文章的全文；一致性是定性的（正文没有相关系数）；促增殖的 TP53 敲低使覆盖度偏斜，所以在 64 个转录因子的筛选中只分析了 TP53。

title: Perturb-Seq: Dissecting Molecular Circuits with Scalable Single-Cell RNA Profiling of Pooled Genetic Screens
key_claim_en: Perturb-seq combines single-cell RNA-seq with CRISPR perturbations in a pool; demonstrated on 200,000 cells in immune cells and cell lines, focusing on transcription factors regulating dendritic-cell response to LPS; it decomposes measurements into effects of perturbations, their interactions and cell metadata (self-reported).
key_claim_zh: Perturb-seq 把单细胞 RNA-seq 与 CRISPR 扰动合并在一个混合池中；在免疫细胞和细胞系的 200,000 个细胞上演示，聚焦调控树突状细胞对 LPS 响应的转录因子；它把测量分解为扰动、扰动间交互和细胞元数据的效应（自报）。
so_what_en: Original pooled design that decomposes measurements into effects of perturbations, their interactions and cell metadata: the additive-plus-interaction structure a genotype-by-drug model needs.
so_what_zh: 最初的混合池设计把测量分解为扰动、扰动间交互和细胞元数据的效应：这正是基因型与药物交互模型所需的加和加交互结构。
caveat_en: Abstract only (EuropePMC record); the Cell paper's full text is not on disk; accuracy claims are the authors' own.
caveat_zh: 仅有摘要（EuropePMC 记录）；Cell 论文全文不在磁盘上；准确性结论为作者自报。

title: Exploring genetic interaction manifolds constructed from rich single-cell phenotypes
key_claim_en: Framework to interpret high-dimensional cell-state manifolds from Perturb-seq of strong genetic interactions mined from a growth-based gain-of-function map: orders pathways, classifies interactions (for example suppressors), finds CBL-CNN1 synergy driving erythroid differentiation, and uses recommender-system machine learning to predict interactions (self-reported).
key_claim_zh: 用于解读 Perturb-seq 细胞状态高维流形的分析框架，数据来自从基于生长的功能获得型图谱中挖掘出的强遗传互作：可排序调控通路、对互作分类（例如抑制因子）、发现 CBL-CNN1 协同驱动红系分化，并用推荐系统机器学习预测互作（自报）。
so_what_en: Precedent for classifying non-additive effects (synergy, suppression) from transcriptional phenotypes and for predicting unmeasured interactions, a template for a genotype-by-drug interaction term.
so_what_zh: 为从转录表型中区分非加和效应（协同、抑制）并预测未测互作提供了先例，可作为基因型与药物交互项的模板。
caveat_en: Abstract only (EuropePMC record); the full text and any prediction accuracy are not on disk.
caveat_zh: 仅有摘要（EuropePMC 记录）；全文及预测准确度均不在磁盘上。

title: Data from: Determining the genetic basis of anthracycline-cardiotoxicity by response QTL mapping in induced cardiomyocytes
key_claim_en: Open Zenodo record (v1, 2019): RNA-seq of iPSC-derived cardiomyocytes from 45 individuals, five treatments each at increasing doxorubicin concentrations for 24 h; expression for 217 samples plus all-tested-pair eQTL and splicing-QTL tables (447 response-eQTLs, 42 response-splicing QTLs); CC0 licence.
key_claim_zh: 开放的 Zenodo 记录（v1，2019）：45 名个体的 iPSC 来源心肌细胞 RNA-seq，每人五种处理，doxorubicin 浓度递增、处理 24 h；含 217 个样本的表达量，以及全部检验对的 eQTL 与剪接 QTL 表（447 个响应型 eQTL、42 个响应型剪接 QTL）；CC0 许可。
so_what_en: Dose-by-genotype transcriptome data (45 individuals, five treatments each): a positive control for germline-by-drug effects with 447 response-eQTLs; genotypes are matched by dbGaP-anonymized IDs and no genotype file is listed.
so_what_zh: 剂量×基因型转录组数据（45 名个体，每人五种处理）：可作为种系与药物效应的阳性对照，含 447 个响应型 eQTL；基因型通过 dbGaP 匿名 ID 匹配，列表中没有基因型文件。
caveat_en: Zenodo API record and page text read; files not downloaded. Counts are from the record description; the related eLife paper (10.7554/elife.33480) was not read.
caveat_zh: 已读取 Zenodo API 记录和页面文字，未下载文件。数字来自记录描述；相关 eLife 论文（10.7554/elife.33480）未读。

title: AI virtual cells for drug discovery and pharmacology
key_claim_en: review
key_claim_zh: 综述
so_what_en: NA
so_what_zh: NA
caveat_en: Retired 2026-10-16 (R2): review, perspective, news or blog item, never cited.
caveat_zh: 已于 2026-10-16 退役（R2）：综述、观点、新闻或博客条目，从未被引用。

title: Massively multiplex chemical transcriptomics at single-cell resolution
key_claim_en: sci-Plex nuclear hashing profiled 649,340 cells from A549, K562 and MCF7 exposed to 188 compounds at four doses (10 nM to 10 μM, 24 h); of 4,308 HDAC-inhibitor pseudodose genes, 48% responded cell-type-dependently and 22% identically in all three lines.
key_claim_zh: sci-Plex 核杂交标记共检测 649,340 个细胞，来自 A549、K562 和 MCF7 在四个剂量（10 nM 至 10 μM，24 h）下暴露于 188 种化合物；在 4,308 个 HDAC 抑制剂 pseudodose 基因中，48% 的响应依赖细胞类型，22% 在三个细胞系中一致。
so_what_en: Shared and cell-line-specific drug responses coexist (48% versus 22% of HDAC-trajectory genes); trametinib's strong effect in KRAS- and ABL-mutant lines but weak effect in MCF7 suggests driver-genotype dependence.
so_what_zh: 共有的和细胞系特异的药物响应并存（HDAC 轨迹基因中分别为 48% 与 22%）；trametinib 在 KRAS 和 ABL 突变的细胞系中作用强、在 MCF7 中作用弱，提示依赖驱动基因型。
caveat_en: Author manuscript (PMC) of the Science paper read in full; supplementary tables and methods are not on disk; the main screen uses three cancer lines at 24 h; effects are the authors' own.
caveat_zh: 已完整读取 Science 论文的 PMC 作者稿；补充表格和方法不在磁盘上；主筛选只用三个癌细胞系、24 h；效应为作者自报。

title: 10 Million Human PBMCs in a Single Experiment
key_claim_en: Parse page: 9,697,974 PBMCs in 18 immune cell types from 12 healthy donors, each treated for 24 h with 90 cytokines or PBS (1,092 conditions, median 7,400 cells each); differential expression computed per donor and cell type.
key_claim_zh: Parse 页面：来自 12 名健康供体的 9,697,974 个 PBMC，分属 18 种免疫细胞类型，每名供体用 90 种细胞因子或 PBS 处理 24 h（1,092 个条件，每个条件细胞数中位数为 7,400）；差异表达按供体和细胞类型计算。
so_what_en: Full donor-by-cytokine grid with 12 donors permits held-out-donor and per-donor response-variance tests; page gives no genotype, so germline effects cannot be linked to variants from this record alone.
so_what_zh: 完整的供体×细胞因子网格含 12 名供体，可做留出供体和逐供体响应方差检验；页面未给出基因型，因此仅凭该记录无法把种系效应关联到变异。
caveat_en: Vendor page text read, figures and files not inspected; counts self-reported; CC BY-NC 4.0 licence, commercial use needs separate licensing; page gives no donor genotype or cytokine concentrations.
caveat_zh: 已读取厂商页面文字，未检查图和文件；数字为自报；CC BY-NC 4.0 许可，商业使用需另行授权；页面未给出供体基因型或细胞因子浓度。

title: OP3: single-cell multimodal dataset in PBMCs for perturbation prediction benchmarking
key_claim_en: GEO GSE279945 (OP3, public 22 Oct 2024): scRNA-seq of 146 small molecules on PBMCs, each dosed in triplicate across three donors (two male, one female), plus baseline multiome of the same donors; effects in four cell populations; benchmark task is extrapolation to unseen cell types.
key_claim_zh: GEO GSE279945（OP3，2024 年 10 月 22 日公开）：146 种小分子作用于 PBMC 的 scRNA-seq，每种化合物在三名供体（两男一女）中重复三次，另有同三名供体的基线多组学；在四个细胞群中计算效应；基准任务是外推到未见过的细胞类型。
so_what_en: Only three donors, so donor-held-out or genotype-aware evaluation has little power; the stated benchmark holds out cell types instead.
so_what_zh: 仅有三名供体，留出供体或基因型感知的评估把握度很低；所述基准留出的是细胞类型。
caveat_en: GEO SOFT record and OmicsDI copy read; doses, genotypes and the NeurIPS 2024 paper were not; 'largest' is the submitters' claim.
caveat_zh: 已读取 GEO SOFT 记录和 OmicsDI 副本；剂量、基因型和 NeurIPS 2024 论文未读；“最大”是提交者的说法。

title: X-Atlas/Orion: Genome-wide Perturb-seq Datasets via a Scalable Fix-Cryopreserve Platform for Training Dose-Dependent Biological Foundation Models
key_claim_en: Dataset card: two genome-wide FiCS Perturb-seq screens (n = 18,903 target genes), eight million HCT116 and HEK293T cells, median 16,000 UMIs per cell; median on-target knockdown 75.4% (HCT116) and 51.5% (HEK293T); median at least 140 cells per perturbation; CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
key_claim_zh: 数据卡：两个全基因组 FiCS Perturb-seq 筛选（n = 18,903 个靶基因），八百万个 HCT116 和 HEK293T 细胞，每个细胞 UMI 中位数 16,000；靶基因敲低效率中位数 HCT116 为 75.4%、HEK293T 为 51.5%；每个扰动的细胞数中位数至少 140；CC BY-NC-SA 4.0。
so_what_en: Two lines with very different median knockdown (75.4% versus 51.5%) give a graded-strength contrast, confounded with line; the preprint's sgRNA-abundance dose stratification is not described on the card.
so_what_zh: 两个中位敲低水平差异很大的细胞系（75.4% 对 51.5%）提供了分级强度的对比，但与细胞系混杂；预印本中按 sgRNA 丰度做剂量分层的做法数据卡未描述。
caveat_en: Preprint full text not read; the numbers are confirmed on the dataset card (DS24) and are the owner's own.
caveat_zh: 预印本全文未读；数字已在数据集卡片（DS24）上得到确认，且为所有者自己的。

title: Mapping information-rich genotype-phenotype landscapes with genome-scale Perturb-seq
key_claim_en: Genome-scale CRISPRi Perturb-seq, more than 2.5 million cells: K562 (all expressed genes; essential genes) and RPE1 (essential genes); median knockdown 85.5% (K562) and 91.6% (RPE1); 31.1% of K562 knockdowns gave a significant transcriptional phenotype; raw data on SRA, processed data at gwps.wi.mit.edu.
key_claim_zh: 基因组规模 CRISPRi Perturb-seq，超过 2.5 million 个细胞：K562（全部表达基因；必需基因）和 RPE1（必需基因）；靶基因敲低效率中位数 K562 为 85.5%、RPE1 为 91.6%；K562 中 31.1% 的敲低产生显著转录表型；原始数据在 SRA，处理后数据在 gwps.wi.mit.edu。
so_what_en: Sparsity anchor: about 31% of expressed-gene knockdowns change the transcriptome; context anchor: K562-versus-RPE1 phenotype similarity is low (median r 0.23, versus 0.50 across K562 timepoints).
so_what_zh: 稀疏性锚点：约 31% 的表达基因敲低会改变转录组；情境锚点：K562 与 RPE1 之间的表型相似度低（中位 r 为 0.23，而 K562 不同时间点之间为 0.50）。
caveat_en: Full text read. The 31.1% phenotype rate is likely a lower bound (some knockdowns were weak); authors' limits: one library element for most genes, limited cells per perturbation, few time points and cell types.
caveat_zh: 已读全文。31.1% 的表型比例很可能是下限（部分敲低较弱）；作者列出的局限：多数基因只有一个文库元件、每个扰动的细胞数有限、时间点和细胞类型很少。

title: scPerturb: harmonized single-cell perturbation data
key_claim_en: scPerturb harmonizes 44 public single-cell perturbation-response datasets (transcriptomics, proteomics, epigenomics) with uniform quality control; describes E-statistics (E-distance, E-test) for perturbation effects and significance testing; data at scperturb.org, Python package scperturb on PyPI.
key_claim_zh: scPerturb 统一整理 44 个公开的单细胞扰动响应数据集（转录组、蛋白质组、表观基因组），采用统一的质量控制；描述了用于量化扰动效应和显著性检验的 E-statistics（E-distance、E-test）；数据在 scperturb.org，Python 包 scperturb 发布于 PyPI。
so_what_en: One entry point to 44 datasets, including sci-Plex (DS15) and genome-scale K562 data (DS19), plus a distribution-level distance with a test; a candidate metric for a genotype-by-drug interaction score.
so_what_zh: 单一入口可访问 44 个数据集，包括 sci-Plex（DS15）和基因组规模的 K562 数据（DS19），另有带检验的分布层面距离；可作为基因型×药物交互评分的候选度量。
caveat_en: Nature page is a paywalled preview: abstract, data and code availability, figure titles and extended-data legends read; the results text and E-statistics performance were not read.
caveat_zh: Nature 页面是付费预览：已读摘要、数据和代码可用性、图标题与扩展数据图注；未读结果正文和 E-statistics 的性能。

title: Massively parallel, time-resolved single-cell RNA sequencing with scNT-Seq
key_claim_en: Metabolic labeling (4sU) with on-bead chemical recoding separates new from old mRNA per cell (~55,000 cells); labeling-based RNA velocity resolved brief (15 and 30 min) versus sustained (60 and 120 min) KCl stimulation of mouse neurons, where splicing-based velocity showed no consistent direction.
key_claim_zh: 4sU 代谢标记加微珠上化学重编码，可在每个细胞中区分新生与既有 mRNA（约 55,000 个细胞）；基于标记的 RNA 速度分辨出小鼠神经元在 KCl 短时（15 和 30 分钟）与持续（60 和 120 分钟）刺激下的差异，而基于剪接的速度没有一致的方向。
so_what_en: Measured new-versus-old RNA gives within-cell time derivatives, a direct signal for state-transition dynamics; labeling-based velocity worked where splicing-based velocity failed for fast-induced genes (mouse neurons, KCl).
so_what_zh: 实测的新生与既有 RNA 提供细胞内的时间导数，是状态转移动态的直接信号；对快速诱导的基因，基于标记的速度有效，而基于剪接的速度失败（小鼠神经元，KCl）。
caveat_en: Published Nature Methods text read, not the preprint; the preprint abstract lacks the ~55,000-cell count. Systems are mouse cortical neurons and mouse ESCs with KCl depolarization, not drugs.
caveat_zh: 读取的是已发表的 Nature Methods 文本，而非预印本；预印本摘要没有约 55,000 个细胞的数字。研究体系是小鼠皮层神经元和小鼠 ESC，刺激为 KCl 去极化，而非药物。

title: Well-TEMP-seq as a microwell-based strategy for massively parallel profiling of single-cell temporal RNA dynamics
key_claim_en: Well-TEMP-seq (microwell metabolic labeling): about 16,000 HCT116 cells after 0, 1, 2 or 3 days of 300 nM 5-AZA-CdR, with paired new and old RNA; 18 genes up and 3 down (fold change >1.5); labeling-based velocity gave coherent flow, splicing-based velocity did not.
key_claim_zh: Well-TEMP-seq（微孔代谢标记）：在 300 nM 5-AZA-CdR 处理 0、1、2 或 3 天后检测约 16,000 个 HCT116 细胞，含配对的新生与既有 RNA；18 个基因上调、3 个下调（倍数变化 >1.5）；基于标记的速度给出连贯的流向，基于剪接的速度则没有。
so_what_en: A drug time-course where measured new-versus-old RNA gives direct state-transition supervision; a single cell line, dose and 4 time points, so it anchors dynamics rather than genotype dependence.
so_what_zh: 一个药物时间进程：实测的新生与既有 RNA 直接提供状态转移的监督信号；只有单一细胞系、单一剂量和 4 个时间点，因此它锚定的是动态而非基因型依赖。
caveat_en: PMC full text of the Nature Communications paper read; supplementary data not on disk; method and velocity claims are the authors' own.
caveat_zh: 已读取 Nature Communications 论文的 PMC 全文；补充数据不在磁盘上；方法与速度方面的结论为作者自报。

title: LabCompass — Spectral Flow Cytometry haematopoiesis dataset
key_claim_en: Dataset card: spectral flow cytometry profiles of in vitro haematopoietic cultures over closed-loop design rounds (loops 0 to 5, about 60 GB, CC-BY-4.0), with inference-only forward flow-matching models, a protocol prior, and about 1.07 million unfiltered designed protocols.
key_claim_zh: 数据卡：体外造血培养在闭环设计各轮（loop 0 至 5，约 60 GB，CC-BY-4.0）中的光谱流式细胞术谱，附仅用于推理的前向 flow-matching 模型、协议先验，以及约 1.07 million 条未过滤的设计协议。
so_what_en: Later loops add protocol axes that earlier loops held at zero, so a naive concatenation silently drops them; an action space can widen across rounds. Readouts are cytometry, not transcriptomes.
so_what_zh: 后续轮次加入了前面各轮保持为零的方案轴，因此简单拼接会悄悄丢掉它们；动作空间可以在各轮之间变宽。读出是细胞术，不是转录组。
caveat_en: Dataset card read in full; its citation fields are still TODO, so the accompanying paper could not be identified; checkpoints are inference-only; the _500k suffix is a naming convention, not a guaranteed cell count.
caveat_zh: 已完整读取数据卡；其引用字段仍为 TODO，因此无法确认配套论文；检查点仅用于推理；_500k 后缀只是命名约定，不保证细胞数。

title: OmniPath: integrated knowledgebase for multi-omics analysis
key_claim_en: Merges 168 resources; interactions domain has 1,419,006 records from 115 resources (signaling, TF–target, miRNA–gene, a limited set of drug–target), each with direction and sign (putative causality); 22% of records are single-resource; enzyme–PTM has 115,215 records.
key_claim_zh: 整合 168 个资源；interactions 域含来自 115 个资源的 1,419,006 条记录（信号通路、TF–target、miRNA–基因，以及有限的药物–靶点），每条带方向和符号（推定因果）；22% 的记录仅来自单一资源；enzyme–PTM 含 115,215 条记录。
so_what_en: Ready-made signed, directed signaling and TF–target prior for propagating a target or pathway variant toward transcription; drug–target coverage is limited, so a separate drug-target source is needed.
so_what_zh: 现成的带符号、有方向的信号通路与 TF–target 先验，可把靶点或通路变异向转录层面传导；药物–靶点覆盖有限，需另配药物靶点来源。
caveat_en: Published NAR version (PMC12807778) read, not the cited preprint v1; only the abstracts were compared and agree in content. Counts are the authors' own.
caveat_zh: 读的是发表的 NAR 版本（PMC12807778），而非所引的预印本 v1；仅比较了摘要，内容一致。计数为作者自报。

title: Metadata about resources in OmniPath and pypath
key_claim_en: Per-resource metadata page for OmniPath and pypath (states above 100 resources): licence for each entry, plus curation category and quoted curation protocols where available; DrugBank is CC BY-NC 4.0; resources with no findable licence are assumed unlicensed.
key_claim_zh: OmniPath 与 pypath 的逐资源元数据页（页面称有 100 多个资源）：每个条目给出许可信息，并在可得时给出整理类别和引述的整理流程；DrugBank 为 CC BY-NC 4.0；找不到许可的资源按无许可处理。
so_what_en: Check licences resource by resource before redistributing any OmniPath-derived prior; non-commercial (DrugBank) and unlicensed resources need filtering, and curation category can tag edges for provenance ablation.
so_what_zh: 在分享任何源自 OmniPath 的先验之前，应逐个资源核对许可；DrugBank 这类非商业资源和无许可资源需要过滤，整理类别还可用来标记边的出处以便消融。
caveat_en: Page says release years and pypath methods are out of date and most licences were updated as of July 2020; default-included resources (green titles) are not visible in the text read.
caveat_zh: 页面自称发布年份和 pypath 方法已过时，多数许可更新于 2020 年 7 月；默认纳入的资源（绿色标题）在所读文本中不可见。

title: Integrating knowledge and omics to decipher mechanisms via large-scale models of signaling networks
key_claim_en: NA
key_claim_zh: NA
so_what_en: NA
so_what_zh: NA
caveat_en: Retired 2026-10-16 (R5): redundant inside a cluster that is already covered, no key point, never cited.
caveat_zh: 已于 2026-10-16 退役（R5）：位于已被覆盖的簇内而冗余，无要点，从未被引用。

title: SIGNOR 4.0: the 2025 update with focus on phosphorylation data
key_claim_en: SIGNOR 4.0 (August 2025): 40,940 curated signed causal edges among 13,768 entities, each with mechanism and up/down effect; 38% of the human proteome (7820 proteins) covered; 76% of phosphorylations have a residue; interactions are binary.
key_claim_zh: SIGNOR 4.0（2025 年 8 月）：13,768 个实体之间有 40,940 条人工整理的带符号因果边，每条带机制和上调或下调效应；覆盖 38% 的人类蛋白组（7820 个蛋白）；76% 的磷酸化反应标注到具体残基；相互作用为二元关系。
so_what_en: Residue-level phosphosite nodes let a coding variant at a mapped site be placed in a signed graph; with only 38% proteome coverage and binary edges, expect gaps.
so_what_zh: 残基层面的磷酸化位点节点使位于已映射位点的编码变异可以放进带符号的图中；蛋白组覆盖率仅 38%且边为二元关系，应预期存在缺口。
caveat_en: Published NAR paper read in full; counts are the authors' own and dated August 2025.
caveat_zh: 已通读发表的 NAR 论文；计数为作者自报，截至 2025 年 8 月。

title: SIGNOR 3.0, the SIGnaling network open resource 3.0: 2022 update
key_claim_en: SIGNOR 3.0: about 33,000 manually annotated causal relationships; 33% of the human proteome (6750 proteins) covered, about 70% of proteins lack causal links; 90% of interactions have a mechanism, about one third a cell-type or tissue annotation; the network models one abstract cell.
key_claim_zh: SIGNOR 3.0：约 33,000 条人工标注的因果关系；覆盖 33% 的人类蛋白组（6750 个蛋白），约 70% 的蛋白缺少因果连接；90% 的相互作用带有机制，约三分之一带有细胞类型或组织注释；该网络只刻画一个抽象的细胞。
so_what_en: Sparsity anchor for a signed-edge prior: about 70% of proteins lack causal links and the graph is context-free by default, so cell-type context must come from the expression data.
so_what_zh: 带符号边先验的稀疏性锚点：约 70% 的蛋白缺少因果连接，且该图默认不含细胞背景，因此细胞类型背景必须来自表达数据。
caveat_en: Published NAR paper read in full; counts are the authors' own and superseded by KB04, which reports 38% coverage.
caveat_zh: 已通读发表的 NAR 论文；计数为作者自报，已被 KB04 取代，后者报告覆盖率为 38%。

title: Open Targets Platform: supporting systematic drug–target identification and prioritisation
key_claim_en: Open Targets Platform: 20 evidence sources (germline genetics, somatic mutations, drugs, pathways, expression) scored 0 to 1, combined by weighted harmonic sum into 7,282,832 target–disease associations; 6515 ChEMBL-based drug entries; L2G score links GWAS loci to causal genes.
key_claim_zh: Open Targets Platform：20 个证据来源（种系遗传学、体细胞突变、药物、通路、表达）按 0 到 1 打分，用加权调和和（weighted harmonic sum）合并为 7,282,832 条靶点-疾病关联；6515 个基于 ChEMBL 的药物条目；L2G 分数把 GWAS 位点连接到因果基因。
so_what_en: Open source of drug mechanisms and variant-to-gene links for the action prior and germline track; evidence scores are not ground truth, as the authors report no adequate gold standards.
so_what_zh: 可作为药物机制和变异到基因连接的开放来源，用于动作先验和种系轨道；证据分数不是真值，因为作者承认缺少合适的金标准。
caveat_en: Published NAR paper read in full; counts are the authors' own and predate the platform redesign that the paper describes as under way.
caveat_zh: 已通读发表的 NAR 论文；计数为作者自报，早于论文所述正在进行的平台重新设计。

title: Molecular interactions | Open Targets Platform Documentation
key_claim_en: Open Targets interaction network merges IntAct, Reactome, SIGNOR and STRING; Reactome (human–human only) and SIGNOR (human only) edges are directional and signed, most IntAct edges are not; IntAct MI score above 0.4 means medium-to-high confidence, though study bias can inflate it.
key_claim_zh: Open Targets 的相互作用网络合并了 IntAct、Reactome、SIGNOR 和 STRING；Reactome（仅人-人）和 SIGNOR（仅人类）的边有方向且带符号，多数 IntAct 的边则没有；IntAct 的 MI 分数高于 0.4 表示中到高置信度，但研究偏倚可能推高分数。
so_what_en: Reactome and SIGNOR edges here are signed and directional, which suits a signed action mask; most IntAct edges are neither, and their scores can reflect study bias.
so_what_zh: 这里 Reactome 和 SIGNOR 的边带符号且有方向，适合作为带符号的动作掩码；多数 IntAct 的边两者皆无，其分数还可能反映研究偏倚。
caveat_en: Documentation page read in full (short HTML text); undated, shown as last updated 1 year ago, so the source list may have changed.
caveat_zh: 已通读该文档页面（HTML 文本较短）；页面未标日期，仅显示“1 年前更新”，因此来源列表可能已变化。

title: Large-scale regulatory and signaling network assembly through linked open data
key_claim_en: pyBRAvo: a Semantic Web framework that automates reconstruction of large-scale regulatory and signaling networks from linked open databases for tumor-cell modeling and drug screening; applied to 910 liver-cancer patient expression measurements.
key_claim_zh: pyBRAvo：基于 Semantic Web 的框架，可从关联开放数据库自动重建大规模调控与信号网络，用于肿瘤细胞建模和药物筛选；已应用于 910 个肝癌患者的表达测量。
so_what_en: Precedent for automating prior-network assembly from linked open data; the abstract names the difficulty of recovering logical flows but not which sources or edge semantics are used.
so_what_zh: 自动从关联开放数据组装先验网络的先例；摘要提到恢复逻辑流的困难，但没有说明使用哪些来源或边的语义。
caveat_en: Abstract only (Europe PMC metadata); full text not on disk because the retrieval used a malformed DOI. Recorded STRING and SIGNOR direction claim unchecked.
caveat_zh: 仅有摘要（Europe PMC 元数据）；由于检索使用了格式错误的 DOI，全文不在磁盘上。所记录的 STRING 与 SIGNOR 方向性论断未核查。

title: Perturbation-response genes reveal signaling footprints in cancer gene expression
key_claim_en: PROGENy: 100 responsive genes for each of 11 pathways; footprint scores recover driver-mutation effects (TP53 mutation lowers the p53 score) and give 178 drug associations at 10% FDR versus 136 for driver mutations (self-reported); single-experiment signatures perform no better than random.
key_claim_zh: PROGENy：11 条通路各取 100 个响应基因；足迹分数能还原驱动突变的效应（TP53 突变使 p53 分数下降），在 10% FDR 下得到 178 个药物关联，而驱动突变为 136 个（自报）；单个实验得到的签名不比随机更好。
so_what_en: Candidate low-dimensional readout for scoring variant-driven pathway shifts: footprint genes barely overlap the pathway's own signaling genes, so the variant gene's expression is a poor proxy.
so_what_zh: 可作为低维读出来评分变异驱动的通路变化：足迹基因与该通路自身的信号基因几乎不重叠，因此变异基因自身的表达是较差的替代指标。
caveat_en: Published paper read in full; numbers are the authors' own (self-reported). Signatures cover 11 pathways, come from perturbations under 24 h, and were tested on basal expression of tumors and cell lines.
caveat_zh: 已通读发表的论文；数字为作者自报。签名覆盖 11 条通路，来自 24 小时内的扰动，并在肿瘤和细胞系的基础表达上做过检验。

title: A systematic comparison of pharmacogene star allele calling bioinformatics algorithms: a focus on CYP2D6 genotyping
key_claim_en: Astrolabe, Aldy, Stargazer on 4618 simulations and 75 GeT-RM genomes: real-data diplotype concordance 72%, 88%, 89%, 95% for a 2-of-3 ensemble (self-reported); hybrid alleles are hardest (simulated: Aldy 72 of 107, Astrolabe 3); simulation and real data rank callers differently.
key_claim_zh: 在 4618 个模拟样本和 75 个 GeT-RM 基因组上比较 Astrolabe、Aldy 和 Stargazer：真实数据的双倍型一致率分别为 72%、88%、89%，2-of-3 集成为 95%（自报）；杂合（hybrid）等位基因最难调用（模拟：Aldy 107 个中的 72 个，Astrolabe 仅 3 个）；模拟数据与真实数据对调用工具的排名不同。
so_what_en: Upstream genotype calls are noisy for structural variants and differ by caller and by benchmark; a genotype-aware model should carry call uncertainty or use a consensus call.
so_what_zh: 上游基因型调用在结构变异上噪声较大，且随调用工具和基准而异；感知基因型的模型应携带调用的不确定性，或使用共识调用。
caveat_en: Published paper read in full; numbers are the authors' own (self-reported) for Astrolabe v0.8.7.0, Aldy v2.2.3 and Stargazer v1.0.7; the 4618 simulations do not follow population frequencies.
caveat_zh: 已通读发表的论文；数字为作者自报，对应 Astrolabe v0.8.7.0、Aldy v2.2.3 和 Stargazer v1.0.7；4618 个模拟样本不遵循人群频率。

title: A Review of the Important Role of CYP2D6 in Pharmacogenomics
key_claim_en: CYP2D6 review: 133 star alleles on PharmVar; one or three gene copies in 12–23% of people by population, *5 deletion in 3–6%; activity score (poor 0, ultra-rapid above 2.25) sets metaboliser class; inhibitors cause phenoconversion; tumor-derived sequence can misclassify germline genotype.
key_claim_zh: CYP2D6 综述：PharmVar 上有 133 个星等位基因；一个或三个基因拷贝在不同人群中占 12–23%，*5 缺失占 3–6%；活性评分（弱代谢 0，超快代谢高于 2.25）决定代谢型；抑制剂会引起表型转换（phenoconversion）；源自肿瘤的序列可能误判种系基因型。
so_what_en: Encode PK genotype as activity score plus copy number, treat co-medication as a separate input, and avoid inferring germline PK genotype from tumor-derived sequence.
so_what_zh: 把药代动力学基因型编码为活性评分加拷贝数，把合并用药作为单独输入，并避免从源自肿瘤的序列推断种系药代基因型。
caveat_en: Published review read in full; figures are compiled from cited studies, not new data; the 133 star-allele count was current in 2020.
caveat_zh: 已通读发表的综述；数字汇编自所引研究，并非新数据；133 个星等位基因的计数是 2020 年的现状。

title: A frequent CYP2D6 variant promotes skipping of exon 3 and reduces CYP2D6 protein expression in human liver samples
key_claim_en: Liver (n = 244): rs1058164 G (MAF 27%–43%) raises the exon-3-skipped isoform 1.4–2.5-fold and cuts full-length CYP2D6 protein about 50% per allele; a 3-SNP-haplotype model fits protein best (59% variance versus 36% standard, abstract); copies beyond two give no significant protein increase.
key_claim_zh: 肝脏（n = 244）：rs1058164 G（MAF 27%–43%）使跳过外显子 3 的异构体增加 1.4–2.5 倍，并使全长 CYP2D6 蛋白每个等位基因降低约 50%；3-SNP 单倍型模型对蛋白拟合最好（摘要称解释 59% 的变异，标准模型为 36%）；超过两个拷贝不再带来显著的蛋白增加。
so_what_en: Splicing and enhancer SNPs in a PK gene reshape expression beyond star-allele scores, and extra copies saturate, so genotype encodings should not assume linear dosage.
so_what_zh: 药代基因中的剪接和增强子 SNP 在星等位基因评分之外还会改变表达，额外的拷贝会饱和，因此基因型编码不应假定线性剂量。
caveat_en: Published paper read in full (publisher EPUB); abstract gives 59% and 36% of variance but Results give R2 68.09% for the 3-SNP model. Liver protein, not drug response; 189 samples.
caveat_zh: 已通读发表的论文（出版商 EPUB）；摘要给出方差解释 59% 和 36%，但结果部分给出 3-SNP 模型的 R2 为 68.09%。检测的是肝脏蛋白而非药物响应；189 个样本。

title: Characterization of Novel CYP2D6 Alleles across Sub-Saharan African Populations
key_claim_en: 30 Coriell African samples: 14 novel CYP2D6 star alleles and 7 suballeles confirmed experimentally, but five predicted alleles in 11 samples were not; many novel alleles sit on decreased-function *17, *29 or *41 backbones, so default calling would report the backbone.
key_claim_zh: 30 个 Coriell 非洲样本：14 个新的 CYP2D6 星等位基因和 7 个亚等位基因经实验确认，但 11 个样本中预测的五个等位基因未得到确认；许多新等位基因位于功能降低的 *17、*29 或 *41 骨架上，因此默认调用会报告其骨架等位基因。
so_what_en: Rare alleles on decreased-function backbones can be missed by standard panels, and in-silico predictors underperform on pharmacogenetic variants, so genotype encodings should carry allele uncertainty, especially in under-represented ancestries.
so_what_zh: 位于功能降低骨架上的罕见等位基因可能被标准检测板漏掉，且计算机预测工具在药物遗传学变异上表现不佳，因此基因型编码应携带等位基因的不确定性，尤其是在代表性不足的祖源中。
caveat_en: Published paper read in full; counts are the authors' own. Alleles are rare and the 30 samples are all Niger–Congo-language speakers (1000 Genomes), so frequencies may not transfer to other African groups.
caveat_zh: 已通读发表的论文；计数为作者自报。这些等位基因罕见，30 个样本均为尼日尔-刚果语系使用者（1000 Genomes），因此频率未必适用于其他非洲人群。

title: Identification of CYP2D6 Haplotypes that Interfere with Commonly Used Assays for Copy Number Variation Characterization
key_claim_en: 16 clinical samples with inconsistent CYP2D6 copy-number calls (all but one of African descent): six novel suballeles with SNPs cause false copy-number-loss calls in introns 2 and 6; five exon 9 losses were *13 or *36 hybrids; one novel haplotype, *141.
key_claim_zh: 16 个 CYP2D6 拷贝数调用不一致的临床样本（除一例外均为非洲裔）：六个新的亚等位基因所含 SNP 会在内含子 2 和 6 造成假的拷贝数缺失调用；五例外显子 9 缺失为 *13 或 *36 杂合基因；另有一个新单倍型 *141。
so_what_en: Probe-based assays can give false copy-number-loss calls when rare SNPs sit under probe sites, here nearly all in people of African descent; treat copy number as an uncertain input.
so_what_zh: 当罕见 SNP 位于探针位点之下时，基于探针的检测可能给出假的拷贝数缺失调用，本研究中几乎都发生在非洲裔人群；应把拷贝数视为不确定的输入。
caveat_en: Abstract only (Europe PMC metadata; not open access, full-text request returned an error); a clinical series of 16 samples, not a population estimate.
caveat_zh: 仅有摘要（Europe PMC 元数据；非开放获取，全文请求返回错误）；这是 16 个样本的临床系列，而非人群估计。

title: FDA vs CPIC (March 2021 comparison PDF)
key_claim_en: CPIC slide deck (March 2021): 114 actionable (level A or B) drugs; FDA has two pharmacogenomic tables, CDER biomarkers (431 entries, includes somatic genes) and CDRH associations; CPIC actionability levels are not evidence levels and not identical to PharmGKB or FDA label categories.
key_claim_zh: CPIC 幻灯片（2021 年 3 月）：114 个可操作（A 或 B 级）药物；FDA 有两张药物基因组学表，即 CDER 生物标志物表（431 条，含体细胞基因）和 CDRH 关联表；CPIC 可操作性分级不是证据等级，也不等同于 PharmGKB 或 FDA 标签的类别。
so_what_en: Treat FDA, CPIC and PharmGKB labels as separate annotation layers with different meanings; scale anchors are 114 CPIC actionable drugs and 431 FDA biomarker entries.
so_what_zh: 把 FDA、CPIC 和 PharmGKB 的标签视为含义各异的独立注释层；规模锚点为 114 个 CPIC 可操作药物和 431 条 FDA 生物标志物条目。
caveat_en: Slide deck read in full (image-only slides viewed, not quotable); counts are CPIC's own and dated 2020–2021; it is a talk deck, not a peer-reviewed document.
caveat_zh: 已通读该幻灯片（仅含图像的幻灯片已查看，但无法引用）；计数为 CPIC 自报，日期为 2020–2021 年；这是演讲幻灯片，不是同行评议文件。

title: Clinical Practice Guideline Standard Operating Procedure
key_claim_en: CPIC SOP (revised 9 May 2025): only actionability levels A and B carry prescribing actions (provisional levels are tentative); allele function is assigned drug-agnostically and mapped to phenotype by diplotype tables; recommendations are assumed to hold across populations unless explicit data say otherwise.
key_claim_zh: CPIC SOP（2025 年 5 月 9 日修订）：只有可操作性等级 A 和 B 带有处方建议（临时等级仅为暂定）；等位基因功能与药物无关地赋值，并通过双倍型表映射到表型；除非有明确数据另有说明，建议被假定适用于所有人群。
so_what_en: Use level A and B pairs as the actionable subset and diplotype-to-phenotype groups as conditioning labels; the cross-population assumption is a default to test by ancestry, not a finding.
so_what_zh: 把 A 和 B 级配对用作可操作子集，把双倍型到表型的分组用作条件标签；跨人群假设只是需按祖源检验的默认设定，而不是发现。
caveat_en: Primary document (revised 9 May 2025) read in full; it describes the CPIC process, not variant effects, and does not itself contrast CPIC levels with PharmGKB levels (KB17 does).
caveat_zh: 已通读该一手文件（2025 年 5 月 9 日修订）；它描述 CPIC 的流程而非变异效应，自身并未对比 CPIC 等级与 PharmGKB 等级（KB17 做了对比）。

title: Establishing Best Practices for Clinical GWAS: Tackling Imputation and Data Quality Challenges
key_claim_en: Review: imputation is less accurate for rare variants (MAF < 1% versus > 5%) and for non-European ancestry; INFO > 0.8 is typical, > 0.9 suggested for high-impact variants; CNVs are poorly imputed; CYP2C19, DPYD and HLA alleles should be directly genotyped.
key_claim_zh: 综述：填补对罕见变异（MAF < 1%，相对于 > 5%）和非欧洲祖源的准确度较低；INFO > 0.8 为常用阈值，对高影响变异建议 > 0.9；CNV 很难被填补；CYP2C19、DPYD 和 HLA 等位基因应直接基因分型。
so_what_en: Take germline PK genotypes from direct genotyping or sequencing, not imputation; if imputed, carry INFO quality, and expect weak copy-number and non-European calls.
so_what_zh: 种系药代基因型应来自直接基因分型或测序而非填补；若为填补，应携带 INFO 质量，并预期拷贝数和非欧洲人群的调用较弱。
caveat_en: Published review read in full; thresholds and recommendations are the authors' proposals (self-reported), not tested benchmarks.
caveat_zh: 已通读发表的综述；阈值和建议是作者的提议（自报），而非经检验的基准。

title: Expanding the coverage of regulons from high-confidence prior knowledge for accurate estimation of transcription factor activities
key_claim_en: CollecTRI regulons: 43175 signed TF–gene interactions for 1186 TFs; on KnockTF perturbations median AUROC 0.73 and AUPRC 0.77, above DoRothEA, ChEA3, RegNetwork and Pathway Commons (self-reported); benchmark TFs are better-studied, with more targets than other TFs.
key_claim_zh: CollecTRI 调控子：1186 个 TF 共 43175 条带符号的 TF–基因相互作用；在 KnockTF 扰动数据上，AUROC 中位数 0.73、AUPRC 中位数 0.77，高于 DoRothEA、ChEA3、RegNetwork 和 Pathway Commons（自报）；基准中的 TF 研究更充分，靶基因比其他 TF 更多。
so_what_en: Signed TF regulons give an interpretable readout, validated on TF knockdown and knockout data, not drug-induced programmes; check it per TF, since perturbed-only comparisons were comparable across networks.
so_what_zh: 带符号的 TF 调控子提供可解释的读出，验证基于 TF 敲低和敲除数据，而非药物诱导的程序；应逐个 TF 检验，因为仅看被扰动 TF 时各网络表现相当。
caveat_en: Published NAR paper read in full; benchmark numbers are the authors' own (self-reported); in a 12-TF perturbed-only check all networks performed comparably.
caveat_zh: 已通读发表的 NAR 论文；基准数字为作者自报；在仅限 12 个 TF 的被扰动 TF 检查中，各网络表现相当。

title: Predicting Cellular Responses to Novel Drug Perturbations at a Single-Cell Resolution
key_claim_en: Additive latent: adversarially covariate-invariant basal state plus cell-line and dose-scaled drug shifts; frozen RDKit-feature drug encoder. On nine unseen sci-Plex3 drugs at 10 µM, DEG r2 is 0.29 (no-perturbation baseline), 0.32 (chemCPA), 0.54 (L1000-pretrained) (self-reported).
key_claim_zh: 加性潜空间：经对抗训练而与协变量无关的基础状态，加上细胞系项和按剂量缩放的药物项；药物编码器为冻结的 RDKit 特征。在 sci-Plex3 的九个未见药物、10 µM 下，DEG 的 r2 为 0.29（无扰动基线）、0.32（chemCPA）、0.54（L1000 预训练）（自报）。
so_what_en: Template for genotype conditioning: add covariates (the paper names patient) as extra additive latent terms; judge gains by DEG r2 against the no-perturbation baseline, since all-gene r2 is inflated.
so_what_zh: 基因型条件化的模板：把协变量（文中举例为 patient）作为额外的加性潜变量项加入；以 DEG 的 r2 对照无扰动基线来判断增益，因为全基因 r2 偏高。
caveat_en: Self-reported; the nine test drugs were reported among the most effective in the original sci-Plex3 publication. NeurIPS 2022 PDF main text read (12 pages); the appendix with the encoder benchmark is not on disk.
caveat_zh: 自报；九个测试药物在 sci-Plex3 原始论文中被报告为效果最强的药物之列。已读 NeurIPS 2022 PDF 正文（12 页）；含编码器基准的附录不在本地。

title: Predicting transcriptional responses to novel chemical perturbations using deep generative model for drug discovery
key_claim_en: Drug enters as a dosage-scaled RDKit fingerprint of its SMILES; cell state enters as a randomly paired unperturbed profile of the same cell line; Gaussian-likelihood encoder-decoder. On L1000 unseen compounds, average Pearson between true and predicted per-compound mean log(FC) is 0.8 (self-reported).
key_claim_zh: 药物以其 SMILES 的按剂量缩放 RDKit 指纹输入；细胞状态以同一细胞系随机配对的未扰动谱输入；采用高斯似然的编码器-解码器。在 L1000 未见化合物上，真实与预测的各化合物平均 log(FC) 之间的平均 Pearson 为 0.8（自报）。
so_what_en: Simple action-and-state encoder; a genotype-specific baseline profile could replace the paired profile. The 0.8 scores mean log(FC) profiles on a compound split, so it is not comparable with MD04.
so_what_zh: 简单的动作与状态编码器；可用基因型特异的基线谱替换配对的未扰动谱。0.8 针对平均 log(FC) 谱且为化合物划分，因此与 MD04 不可比。
caveat_en: Published Nature Communications text read via Europe PMC; metrics are self-reported; Methods describe a linear model and an MLP as baselines; figure values are not in the text.
caveat_zh: 已通过 Europe PMC 阅读 Nature Communications 正式发表版；指标为自报；方法部分描述的基线为线性模型和 MLP；图中数值不在正文中。

title: Deep representation learning of chemical-induced transcriptional profile for phenotype-based drug discovery
key_claim_en: Two VAEs (basal and perturbed profile) joined by a linear map from the basal latent plus a KPGT compound embedding predict the 978-gene delta; LINCS 2020 at 10 µM, 24 h: 78,569 pairs, 8316 compounds, 164 cell lines. Predicted-delta PCC 0.619 (self-reported).
key_claim_zh: 两个 VAE（基础谱与扰动谱）通过一个线性映射相连，输入为基础潜变量加 KPGT 化合物嵌入，预测 978 基因的差异谱；LINCS 2020，10 µM、24 h：78,569 对谱、8316 个化合物、164 个细胞系。预测差异谱的 PCC 为 0.619（自报）。
so_what_en: Basal-profile-conditioned delta prediction lets a genotype-specific baseline serve as context; held-out-line accuracy rose with 10, 50, 150 training lines, a cue for how many genotypes or donors are needed.
so_what_zh: 以基础谱为条件预测差异谱，可让基因型特异的基线作为背景；留出细胞系的准确度随训练细胞系数 10、50、150 上升，提示需要多少基因型或供体。
caveat_en: Published Nature Communications text read; metrics self-reported, figure values absent. The 10,174-gene extension uses an external L1000 weight matrix, only in the pancreatic repurposing task. Listed bioRxiv URL not read.
caveat_zh: 已读 Nature Communications 正式发表版全文；指标为自报，图中数值不在正文。10,174 基因的扩展使用外部 L1000 权重矩阵，且仅用于胰腺癌重定位任务。所列 bioRxiv 网址未读。

title: ExPO: an exposure-conditioned neural operator for L1000 signature prediction
key_claim_en: Scaffold-held-out L1000 split (640 test compounds): PRnet MAE 0.87, Spearman 0.50, R2 0.24; TranSiGen 0.88, 0.49, 0.23; ExPO, a dose-time DeepONet with learned cell embedding, 0.83, 0.52, 0.27 (R2 called modest by its authors; self-reported).
key_claim_zh: 骨架留出的 L1000 划分（640 个测试化合物）：PRnet 的 MAE 0.87、Spearman 0.50、R2 0.24；TranSiGen 为 0.88、0.49、0.23；ExPO（带学习细胞嵌入的剂量-时间 DeepONet）为 0.83、0.52、0.27（其作者称 R2 绝对值有限；自报）。
so_what_en: Sets the scale for gains: five models span only 0.46-0.52 Spearman and R2 0.20-0.27 on unseen scaffolds, so any genotype term must be judged against that spread.
so_what_zh: 给出增益的尺度：五个模型在未见骨架上 Spearman 仅 0.46-0.52、R2 仅 0.20-0.27，因此任何基因型项都要对照这一差距来评判。
caveat_en: Published J Cheminformatics text read via Europe PMC; baseline numbers come from the ExPO authors' own comparison, where their method wins; baseline settings are not described in the text. Self-reported.
caveat_zh: 已通过 Europe PMC 阅读 J Cheminformatics 正式发表版；基线数值来自 ExPO 作者自己的比较，且其方法胜出；正文未描述基线设置。自报。

title: CellFlow enables generative single-cell phenotype modeling with flow matching
key_claim_en: Class page: flow-matching model with optimal-transport solver ('otfm' or 'genot'); API index lists condition encoders with attention pooling and a donor-specific PBMC cytokine notebook. Preprint abstract (self-reported): cytokine, drug and knockout responses, plus a virtual organoid protocol screen.
key_claim_zh: 类页面：带最优传输求解器（'otfm' 或 'genot'）的流匹配模型；API 索引列出带注意力池化的条件编码器和按供体区分的 PBMC 细胞因子笔记本。预印本摘要（自报）：细胞因子、药物和基因敲除的响应，以及虚拟类器官方案筛选。
so_what_en: A candidate single-cell forward model with condition encoding and a donor-specific cytokine example; judge its genotype suitability only after the preprint's results and splits are read.
so_what_zh: 候选的单细胞前向模型，带条件编码和按供体区分的细胞因子示例；只有在读过预印本的结果与划分之后，才能判断它是否适合基因型任务。
caveat_en: Only the readthedocs class page and the bioRxiv abstract were read, not the preprint; pairing, set aggregation, pretrained embeddings and all results are unverified; self-reported.
caveat_zh: 仅读了 readthedocs 类页面和 bioRxiv 摘要，没有读预印本；配对、集合聚合、预训练嵌入及全部结果均未核实；自报。

title: Predicting cellular responses to perturbation across diverse contexts with State
key_claim_en: Set-level model predicting perturbation effects across cells within and across experiments; cell embeddings trained on observational data from 167 million cells; abstract reports over 30% better effect discrimination on large datasets and improved DE-gene accuracy versus baselines (self-reported); Cell-Eval evaluation framework.
key_claim_zh: 在实验内与实验间考虑细胞异质性、对细胞集合预测扰动效应的模型；细胞嵌入在 167 million 个观测细胞上训练；摘要称在大型数据集上效应区分度提高超过 30%，DE 基因准确度优于基线（自报）；并提出 Cell-Eval 评测框架。
so_what_en: Observational-data cell embeddings reportedly help in contexts never perturbed, like unseen donors or genotypes; Cell-Eval may offer an evaluation protocol. Both rest on the abstract only.
so_what_zh: 据称基于观测数据的细胞嵌入有助于从未被扰动过的情境，如未见供体或基因型；Cell-Eval 可能提供一套评测协议。两点都只依据摘要。
caveat_en: Only the Europe PMC abstract was read, not the Cell full text; module names, splits, baselines and effect sizes are unverified. Self-reported.
caveat_zh: 只读了 Europe PMC 摘要，没有读 Cell 全文；模块名称、划分、基线和效应大小均未核实。自报。

title: Arc Institute's first virtual cell model: State
key_claim_en: Optional embedding model (SE) plus a transformer with self-attention over sets of cells (ST); trained on nearly 170 million observational and over 100 million perturbed cells across 70 cell lines. Launch claim on Tahoe-100M: 50 percent better effect discrimination (self-reported).
key_claim_zh: 可选的嵌入模型（SE）加上对细胞集合做自注意力的 transformer（ST）；在近 170 百万个观测细胞和超过 100 百万个扰动细胞（70 个细胞系）上训练。发布声明称在 Tahoe-100M 上效应区分度提高 50%（自报）。
so_what_en: Design reference for a set-level transition model that starts from a transcriptome and, per its developers, beats simple linear baselines; the 50 percent figure is an unreviewed launch claim.
so_what_zh: 集合层面转移模型的设计参考：从转录组出发，据开发者称优于简单线性基线；50% 这一数字只是未经评审的发布声明。
caveat_en: Developer's launch page read (June 2025); statements are self-reported and not independently evaluated. The tools page was available only as metadata. The published Cell abstract (MD06) frames the gain as more than 30%.
caveat_zh: 已读开发者的发布页面（2025 年 6 月）；声明为自报，未经独立评估。工具页面仅有元数据。已发表的 Cell 摘要（MD06）把增益表述为超过 30%。

title: scPPDM: A Diffusion Model for Single-Cell Drug-Response Prediction
key_claim_en: Latent diffusion in a frozen SCimilarity VAE space, conditioned on a same-plate DMSO baseline state and a Morgan-fingerprint drug vector with FiLM dose; four-state dropout enables factorized classifier-free guidance. Tahoe-100M unseen drugs: DEG logFC-Spearman 0.49 versus 0.36 for the second-best model (self-reported).
key_claim_zh: 在冻结的 SCimilarity VAE 潜空间中做潜扩散，条件为同一板上匹配的 DMSO 基线状态，以及带 FiLM 剂量调制的 Morgan 指纹药物向量；四状态 dropout 使分解式 classifier-free guidance 成为可能。Tahoe-100M 未见药物：DEG logFC-Spearman 为 0.49，次优模型为 0.36（自报）。
so_what_en: Separate state and drug channels with classifier-free guidance give a template where a genotype channel could be added; note it trains on plate-matched condition means, not single cells.
so_what_zh: 状态通道与药物通道分离并配合 classifier-free guidance，可作为再加入基因型通道的模板；注意它训练用的是按板匹配的条件均值，而非单细胞。
caveat_en: arXiv v1 preprint read in full; self-reported, with gains relative to the second-best model; code release only promised upon acceptance; STATE and scGPT evaluated only on unseen combinations; a few baselines win single metrics.
caveat_zh: 已读 arXiv v1 预印本全文；自报，增益均相对于次优模型；代码仅承诺在论文被接收后发布；STATE 和 scGPT 只在未见组合上评估；少数基线在个别指标上更优。

title: scDFM: Distributional Flow Matching Model for Robust Single-Cell Perturbation Prediction
key_claim_en: Conditional flow matching from noise to perturbed expression, conditioned on a control cell and a multi-hot perturbation vector; PAD-Transformer with co-expression-masked differential attention plus MMD loss (weight 0.5). Norman additive split: MSE 0.00315 versus 0.00392 for CellFlow, -19.6% (self-reported).
key_claim_zh: 以噪声到扰动后表达的条件流匹配，条件为对照细胞和多热扰动向量；PAD-Transformer 使用共表达掩码的差分注意力，并加入 MMD 损失（权重 0.5）。Norman 加性划分：MSE 为 0.00315，CellFlow 为 0.00392，降低 19.6%（自报）。
so_what_en: Distribution-level objective and control-cell conditioning are reusable, but each dataset has one cell line and an Additive baseline stays competitive, so cross-context or genotype generalization is untested.
so_what_zh: 分布层面的目标和以对照细胞为条件的做法可复用，但每个数据集只有一个细胞系，且加性基线仍有竞争力，因此跨情境或基因型泛化尚未检验。
caveat_en: arXiv v1 read in full (header says ICLR 2026, venue not otherwise verified); self-reported over four random splits; STATE and scGPT were trained from scratch, not pretrained.
caveat_zh: 已读 arXiv v1 全文（页眉写明 ICLR 2026，会议发表未另行核实）；自报，基于四次随机划分；STATE 和 scGPT 从头训练，未经预训练。

title: pertTF: context-aware AI modeling for genome-scale and cross-system perturbation prediction
key_claim_en: Multi-task transformer (masked expression, cell type, genotype, composition-shift heads) trained on a knockout village of 79 hPSC clones targeting 30 genes (over 87,000 cells, 14 cell types). Genotype-loss weight tunes embedding emphasis; fine-tuning with 100–300 primary islet cells gave near-optimal cell-type F1 (self-reported).
key_claim_zh: 多任务 transformer（掩码表达、细胞类型、基因型、组成变化预测头），在由 79 个 hPSC 克隆靶向 30 个基因的敲除村（超过 87,000 个细胞、14 种细胞类型）上训练。基因型损失权重调节嵌入的侧重；用 100–300 个原代胰岛细胞微调即达到近最优的细胞类型 F1（自报）。
so_what_en: Design example of cell state and genotype in one embedding with a tunable loss weight; islet perturbation states are inferred from expression and only checked against known biology, not genotypes.
so_what_zh: 把细胞状态和基因型放在同一嵌入中并用损失权重调节的设计范例；胰岛中的扰动状态由表达推断，只对照已知生物学检验，而非基因型。
caveat_en: bioRxiv preprint read via PMC; self-reported. Genotype means engineered knockouts in hPSC-derived cells, and all methods did substantially worse in the CRISPRi validation than in the earlier benchmarks.
caveat_zh: 通过 PMC 阅读的 bioRxiv 预印本；自报。这里的基因型指 hPSC 来源细胞中人工构建的敲除，且在 CRISPRi 验证中所有方法的表现都明显差于此前的基准。

title: PertAdapt: Unlocking Single-Cell Foundation Models for Genetic Perturbation Prediction via Condition-Sensitive Adaptation
key_claim_en: Plug-in adapter with gene-similarity-masked attention encodes the perturbation condition together with unperturbed-cell representations from a pretrained single-cell foundation model; adaptive loss reweights perturbation-sensitive genes against global signal; seven datasets, single and double gene perturbations (self-reported, abstract only).
key_claim_zh: 带基因相似性掩码注意力的即插即用适配器，把扰动条件与预训练单细胞基础模型给出的未扰动细胞表征一起编码；自适应损失把扰动敏感基因相对于全局信号重新加权；七个数据集，含单基因与双基因扰动（自报，仅见摘要）。
so_what_en: Perturbation conditions are gene-level; the abstract does not mention donor genotype. It informs encoder and loss design (sensitive-gene reweighting), not genotype conditioning.
so_what_zh: 扰动条件是基因层面的；摘要没有提到供体基因型。它对编码器和损失设计（敏感基因重加权）有参考价值，而不涉及基因型条件化。
caveat_en: Only the bioRxiv abstract was available, not the full text; all claims are self-reported and unverified, and the absence of donor genotype is inferred from the abstract's silence.
caveat_zh: 只有 bioRxiv 摘要可用，没有全文；所有论断均为自报且未核实，无供体基因型一说是从摘要未提及推断而来。

title: A mechanism-informed deep neural network enables prioritization of regulators that drive cell state transitions
key_claim_en: Network predicting cell state from TF expression, cCRE accessibility and learned TF-cCRE interactions; in-silico TF and cCRE perturbation ranks drivers in T2D beta-cell multiome data. Of 2,441 T2D GWAS loci, seven candidate SNPs reached regulators via eQTL or caQTL, five retained.
key_claim_zh: 由 TF 表达、cCRE 可及性和学习到的 TF-cCRE 相互作用预测细胞状态的网络；对 TF 和 cCRE 做计算机内扰动，在 T2D β 细胞多组学数据中排序驱动因子。在 2,441 个 T2D GWAS 位点中，有七个候选 SNP 通过 eQTL 或 caQTL 连到调控因子，保留五个。
so_what_en: Models disease cell states, not drug response; it shows genotype-to-regulator linking via eQTL and caQTL, but only five of 2,441 loci survive a filter that relies on prior knowledge.
so_what_zh: 它建模的是疾病细胞状态，而非药物响应；展示了经 eQTL 和 caQTL 把基因型连到调控因子，但 2,441 个位点中只有五个通过依赖先验知识的过滤。
caveat_en: Published Nature Communications text read via Europe PMC; self-reported; authors call regulators only potential drivers because causality rests on computation, and say TRPS1 needs further experimental validation.
caveat_zh: 已通过 Europe PMC 阅读 Nature Communications 正式发表版；自报；作者因因果性仅靠计算而只称调控因子为潜在驱动因子，并指出 TRPS1 还需进一步实验验证。

title: Biologically informed neural network models are robust to spurious interactions via self-pruning
key_claim_en: LEMBAS (signaling RNN, weights only on known interactions) reimplemented on GPU: 7.1x faster on the tuned high-coverage set, 42% runtime on the low-coverage set. With 100 planted false edges, they are overrepresented among below-median weights except at low L2 on the high-coverage set (self-reported).
key_claim_zh: LEMBAS（信号网络 RNN，权重只落在已知相互作用上）的 GPU 重实现：在调优后的高覆盖数据集上快 7.1x，在低覆盖数据集上运行时间为 42%。植入 100 条假边后，假边在低于中位数的权重中占比偏高，只有高覆盖数据集在低 L2 时例外（自报）。
so_what_en: Design principle: permissive prior networks are tolerable with sufficient L2, tested by planting false edges; evidence comes from two macrophage ligand datasets and one synthetic set, not variants or drugs.
so_what_zh: 设计原则：只要 L2 足够，宽松纳入先验网络是可以容忍的，并可用植入假边来检验；证据来自两个巨噬细胞配体数据集和一个合成数据集，而非变异或药物。
caveat_en: PMC preprint text read (it has no RRA metric); the later bioRxiv v3 abstract adds RRA and says BINNs can, not are, robust. The 7.1x rests on three CPU runs after hyperparameter tuning.
caveat_zh: 已读 PMC 预印本文本（其中没有 RRA 指标）；较新的 bioRxiv v3 摘要新增 RRA，并把“是稳健的”改为“可以是稳健的”。7.1x 基于三次 CPU 运行且经过超参数调优。

title: Zero-shot prediction of drug responses using biologically informed neural networks trained on phosphoproteomic timeseries
key_claim_en: LEMBAS extended to time-resolved phosphoproteomics: a drug is specified by its protein target on a prior network, no measurements needed. Zero-shot on EGF-stimulated MCF10A with four inhibitors reaches R = 0.79 for the PTPN11 inhibitor SHP099 but no gain for RSK1 (self-reported).
key_claim_zh: LEMBAS 扩展到时间分辨磷酸化蛋白质组：药物通过其蛋白靶点在先验网络上指定，无需测量。在 EGF 刺激的 MCF10A 上用四种抑制剂做零样本预测，PTPN11 抑制剂 SHP099 的 R = 0.79，RSK1 抑制剂无提升（自报）。
so_what_en: Shows target-node specification of an unseen intervention on a prior network; zero-shot skill depended on pathway overlap with training drugs (synthetic r about 0.55 with 5 drugs, 0.75 with 15).
so_what_zh: 展示了在先验网络上以靶点节点指定未见干预；零样本能力取决于与训练药物的通路重叠（合成数据中 5 个药物时 r 约 0.55，15 个时约 0.75）。
caveat_en: Published PLoS Computational Biology text read; self-reported; one MCF10A dataset with four inhibitors, readout is phosphorylation not transcription, and the RSK1 inhibitor was not predicted better than the naive baseline.
caveat_zh: 已读 PLoS Computational Biology 正式发表版；自报；仅一个 MCF10A 数据集和四种抑制剂，读出是磷酸化而非转录，RSK1 抑制剂的预测并不优于朴素基线。

title: Biologically informed deep neural network for prostate cancer classification and discovery
key_claim_en: Sparse pathway-hierarchy network (features, genes, 3,007 pathways, outcome) trained on 1,013 prostate cancers from somatic mutation and copy number reaches AUC 0.93 and beats an equal-parameter dense network significantly up to 500 samples (self-reported).
key_claim_zh: 稀疏的通路层级网络（特征、基因、3,007 条通路、结局）基于体细胞突变和拷贝数在 1,013 例前列腺癌上训练，AUC 为 0.93，并在最多 500 个样本时显著优于同参数量的稠密网络（自报）。
so_what_en: Template for variant-aware pathway layers; the sparse prior helps at small sample sizes (up to 500). Inputs are somatic mutation and copy number, not germline or drug response.
so_what_zh: 变异感知通路层的模板；稀疏先验在小样本（最多 500）时有帮助。输入是体细胞突变和拷贝数，而非种系变异或药物响应。
caveat_en: Published Nature version read, not the listed bioRxiv preprint; the preprint abstract reports 1,238 cancers where this text trains and tests on 1,013. Metrics are self-reported.
caveat_zh: 读的是发表于 Nature 的版本，而非所列的 bioRxiv 预印本；预印本摘要报告 1,238 例癌症，本文则在 1,013 例上训练和测试。指标为自报。

title: Simulation and empirical evaluation of biologically-informed neural network performance
key_claim_en: Simulations: small samples, weak signal and extreme sparsity (control frequency 0.001) limit P-NET, which favors linear signal. Prostate cancer: germline plus somatic gave no gain over somatic (AUPRC at least 0.89), but BRCA2 rank improved from 388 to 78 of 4854 genes (self-reported).
key_claim_zh: 模拟：小样本、弱信号和极端稀疏（对照频率 0.001）限制 P-NET，且它偏向线性信号。前列腺癌：种系加体细胞相对仅体细胞无提升（AUPRC 至少 0.89），但 BRCA2 的排名从 4854 个基因中的 388 升至 78（自报）。
so_what_en: Quantifies why sparse germline variant features fail (under one pathogenic variant per sample) and shows added signal can improve interpretation, not accuracy; plan pooling and power before adding genotype terms.
so_what_zh: 量化了稀疏种系变异特征为何失效（每个样本平均不到一个致病变异），并表明新增信号可改善解释而非准确度；加入基因型项前应规划汇聚方式和统计功效。
caveat_en: bioRxiv preprint text read via PMC; a later journal version named in bioRxiv metadata was not read. Self-reported; one prostate cohort and one network architecture.
caveat_zh: 通过 PMC 阅读 bioRxiv 预印本；bioRxiv 元数据所列的后续期刊版本未读。自报；仅一个前列腺队列和一种网络架构。

title: Learning Causal Representations of Single Cells via Sparse Mechanism Shift Modeling
key_claim_en: Each perturbation is a stochastic intervention on a sparse unknown subset of latent variables (sparse mechanism shift VAE, sVAE+). On the Replogle screen (683 strong interventions, held-out pathways) sVAE+ wins interventional NLL in most scenarios; the benefit shrinks when effects are small (self-reported).
key_claim_zh: 每个扰动被视为作用于未知稀疏潜变量子集的随机干预（稀疏机制偏移 VAE，sVAE+）。在 Replogle 筛选（683 个强干预，留出通路）上，sVAE+ 在多数情形下的干预 NLL 最优；效应较小时优势缩小（自报）。
so_what_en: Treats perturbation as a sparse latent intervention; the benefit of action sparsity shrinks for weak or narrow perturbations, so expect little gain for subtle variant effects.
so_what_zh: 把扰动视为稀疏潜变量干预；动作稀疏的收益在弱或窄的扰动下缩小，因此对细微的变异效应预期收益有限。
caveat_en: arXiv PDF text read, version not stated; self-reported benchmarks on K562 gene knockouts, not drugs or genotypes; the small-effect statement is a brief remark without a numeric result.
caveat_zh: 已读 arXiv PDF 文本，版本未注明；自报基准，对象是 K562 基因敲除，而非药物或基因型；小效应一说只是简短评论，没有数值结果。

title: Learning Identifiable Factorized Causal Representations of Cellular Responses
key_claim_en: Latent blocks for covariate, treatment and their interaction; the interaction block is component-wise identifiable, the others block-wise (proved). R2 of predicted treated profiles: FCR 0.87 on sciPlex versus 0.86 for CPA and VCI; CPA wins multiPlex-9, 0.79 versus 0.78 (self-reported).
key_claim_zh: 协变量、处理及其交互各有一个潜变量块；交互块可逐分量识别，其余块可按块识别（已证明）。预测处理后表达谱的 R2：sciPlex 上 FCR 为 0.87，CPA 与 VCI 为 0.86；multiPlex-9 上 CPA 胜出，0.79 对 0.78（自报）。
so_what_en: Separate interaction block models context-dependent drug effects (genetic background named as context), but it cannot predict unseen treatments or covariates, and R2 leads over CPA are at most 0.03.
so_what_zh: 独立的交互块可建模依赖情境的药物效应（文中将遗传背景列为情境），但无法预测未见处理或协变量，且 R2 相对 CPA 的领先至多 0.03。
caveat_en: NeurIPS 2024 PDF text read; self-reported; four datasets with a 2000-gene readout; table layout inferred from extracted text; no cell-line genotype is modelled.
caveat_zh: 已读 NeurIPS 2024 PDF 文本；自报；四个数据集，读出 2000 个基因；表格排布由提取文本推断；未对细胞系基因型建模。

title: Learning Latent Dynamical Causal Processes for Single-Cell Perturbation Prediction
key_claim_en: CITE-VAE splits latents into a perturbation-invariant and a perturbation-responsive block with temporal dynamics and an identifiability analysis. Tested on hiPSC differentiation with 23 single-gene knockouts, leave-one-intervention-out, 3 seeds: stronger DE-gene metrics than causal and linear baselines, comparable genome-wide accuracy (self-reported).
key_claim_zh: CITE-VAE 把潜变量分为扰动不变块和扰动响应块，带时间动力学和可识别性分析。在 hiPSC 分化的 23 个单基因敲除上做留一干预测试，3 个随机种子：DE 基因指标强于因果和线性基线，全基因组精度相当（自报）。
so_what_en: Time-aware latent split into perturbation-invariant and responsive parts, evaluated by leave-one-intervention-out with fold-specific DE genes to avoid leakage; one real dataset with 23 knockouts, no drugs or genotypes.
so_what_zh: 时间感知的潜变量分为扰动不变与响应两部分，用留一干预并在各折内选 DE 基因以避免泄漏；只有一个含 23 个敲除的真实数据集，没有药物或基因型。
caveat_en: arXiv v1 read in full; self-reported; identifiability rests on assumptions the authors acknowledge may not hold in real data; Table 2 values not used.
caveat_zh: 已读 arXiv v1 全文；自报；可识别性依赖作者承认在真实数据中未必成立的假设；未使用表 2 的数值。

title: Identifiability Guarantees for Causal Disentanglement from Soft Interventions
key_claim_en: Latent causal models are identifiable up to an equivalence class from unpaired soft interventions, at least one per latent node (infinite-data limit). On Norman Perturb-seq, 112 held-out double-gene perturbations reach mean R2 0.98 (all genes) and 0.88 (top-20 DE genes) (self-reported).
key_claim_zh: 在无配对的软干预数据下（每个潜变量节点至少一次干预，无限数据极限），潜在因果模型可识别到一个等价类。在 Norman Perturb-seq 上，112 个留出的双基因扰动的平均 R2 为 0.98（全部基因）和 0.88（前 20 个差异表达基因）（自报）。
so_what_en: Template for predicting unseen combinations from single-gene data, but its single-node assumption does not fit multi-target drugs. R2 hardly separates models (0.986 versus 0.984 while MMD differs 0.324 versus 2.966).
so_what_zh: 可作为由单基因数据预测未见组合的模板，但其单节点假设不适用于多靶点药物。R2 几乎无法区分模型（0.986 对 0.984，而 MMD 为 0.324 对 2.966）。
caveat_en: arXiv v3 (November 2023) read in full; the metadata lists no journal reference. Experiments are self-reported on one Perturb-seq dataset, with no benchmark against other methods (the authors defer it).
caveat_zh: 已完整阅读 arXiv v3（2023 年 11 月）；元数据中没有期刊引用信息。实验为自报结果，仅基于一个 Perturb-seq 数据集，未与其他方法做基准比较（作者留待后续）。

title: What Makes a Representation Good for Single-Cell Perturbation Prediction?
key_claim_en: Hypothesis: invariant background dominates expression (about 284 perturbations versus about 19,264 genes). PerturbedVAE splits latents into invariant and perturbation-responsive blocks; 85 invariant plus 20 responsive latents work best. On Norman, 112 held-out double-gene perturbations reach R2 0.98, RMSE 0.4474 (self-reported).
key_claim_zh: 假设：不变的背景程序主导表达（约 284 个扰动对约 19,264 个基因）。PerturbedVAE 把潜变量分成不变块和扰动响应块；85 个不变加 20 个响应潜变量效果最好。在 Norman 数据上，112 个留出的双基因扰动达到 R2 0.98、RMSE 0.4474（自报）。
so_what_en: Template for an invariant-backbone plus responsive-latent design, tested on CRISPR screens only. An additive baseline still wins pseudobulk Delta Pearson (0.9076 versus 0.6869), and all-gene R2 saturates (0.9475 to 0.9865).
so_what_zh: 可作为“不变骨架加响应潜变量”设计的模板，但只在 CRISPR 筛选上测试过。加性基线在伪批量 Delta Pearson 上仍然更好（0.9076 对 0.6869），全基因 R2 也已饱和（0.9475 至 0.9865）。
caveat_en: arXiv v1 read in full; its header carries an ICML 2026 proceedings line, but no acceptance record was seen. Results are self-reported over five seeds; unseen-gene generalization is not addressed.
caveat_zh: 已完整阅读 arXiv v1；其页眉带有 ICML 2026 会议录标注，但未见录用记录。结果为五个随机种子上的自报数据；未处理未见基因的泛化。

title: OCOO-T: A Simple and Scalable Virtual Cell Model for Transcriptional Perturbation Response Prediction
key_claim_en: Rectified-flow Transformer denoises 2,000 HVGs directly (no autoencoder); drug fingerprint plus dose, cell line and PBMC donor embeddings enter via adaLN and in-context tokens, with dual classifier-free guidance. Tahoe100M PDCorr 0.952 versus 0.723 for Linear (self-reported).
key_claim_zh: 整流流（rectified flow）Transformer 直接对 2,000 个高变基因去噪（无自编码器）；药物指纹加剂量、细胞系和 PBMC 供体嵌入通过 adaLN 与上下文 token 输入，并使用双条件无分类器引导。Tahoe100M 上 PDCorr 为 0.952，Linear 为 0.723（自报）。
so_what_en: Donor or genotype as a learned categorical embedding cannot cover unseen contexts; a mean control profile is the authors' alternative. Per-cell-type mean reaches PDCorr 0.412 versus 0.437 on Replogle.
so_what_zh: 把供体或基因型作为学习到的类别嵌入无法覆盖未见背景；平均对照谱是作者给出的替代方案。在 Replogle 上，按细胞类型取平均的基线 PDCorr 达 0.412，对比 0.437。
caveat_en: arXiv v2 (August 2026) read in full; no venue shown. Most baseline numbers are taken from the PerturbDiff paper and all results are self-reported; the authors note the metrics may miss biological utility.
caveat_zh: 已完整阅读 arXiv v2（2026 年 8 月）；未显示发表场所。多数基线数字取自 PerturbDiff 论文，所有结果均为自报；作者指出这些指标可能遗漏生物学效用。

title: D²R²: Discrete Diffusion with Regulation Reinforcement for Single-Cell Perturbation Prediction
key_claim_en: Masked discrete diffusion over 50-bin expression tokens generates genes in an order set by a GRN prior, refined by GRPO. On held-out Norman19 combinations, Pearson Δ is 0.706 versus 0.553 for the best baseline; reversing the prior order scores below random (self-reported).
key_claim_zh: 在 50 个分箱的表达 token 上做掩码离散扩散，按 GRN 先验确定基因生成顺序，并用 GRPO 微调。在留出的 Norman19 组合上，Pearson Δ 为 0.706，最佳基线为 0.553；把先验顺序反过来则低于随机顺序（自报）。
so_what_en: Gene generation order is a design lever: a GRN prior helps and its reverse hurts. Evidence is CRISPR-only (Norman19, VCC-H1) with a cell-type-level prior; genotype or drug conditioning is untested.
so_what_zh: 基因生成顺序是一个设计杠杆：GRN 先验有帮助，反向则有害。证据只来自 CRISPR 数据（Norman19、VCC-H1），先验在细胞类型层面；基因型或药物条件化未经测试。
caveat_en: arXiv v1 (August 2026) read in full; no venue shown. All results are self-reported: five seeds, one fixed generator checkpoint, baselines re-run by the authors with released implementations.
caveat_zh: 已完整阅读 arXiv v1（2026 年 8 月）；未显示发表场所。所有结果均为自报：五个种子、一个固定的生成器检查点，基线由作者用公开实现重新运行。
