title: In silico biological discovery with large perturbation models
key_claim_en: Decoder-only MLP on learned lookup-table embeddings of perturbation, readout and context (context includes genetic background) trains on screens that only partly overlap; it cannot predict unseen contexts or perturbations without supplied embeddings; accuracy gains over baselines and with more data are self-reported.
key_claim_zh: 仅解码器的 MLP，基于对扰动、读出和背景（背景含遗传背景）的可学习查找表嵌入，可在仅部分重叠的筛选数据上训练；没有额外提供的嵌入时无法预测未见背景或扰动；相对基线以及随数据增多的精度提升均为自报。
so_what_en: A genotype given only as a symbol is out of vocabulary for new donors, so it needs feature-based embeddings. Dose and time are collapsed here (10 μM, 24 h).
so_what_zh: 仅以符号给出的基因型对新供体属于词表之外，因此需要基于特征的嵌入。此处剂量与时间被固定（10 μM、24 h）。
caveat_en: Published Nature Computational Science text read (Europe PMC); the arXiv version and supplementary information were not. Most authors are GSK employees and shareholders, and all performance claims are self-reported.
caveat_zh: 已阅读 Europe PMC 上 Nature Computational Science 发表版正文；arXiv 版本和补充信息未读。多数作者为 GSK 员工和股东，所有性能结论均为自报。

title: TxPert: using multiple knowledge graphs for prediction of transcriptomic perturbation effects
key_claim_en: Basal-state MLP on batch-matched controls plus graph-transformer perturbation embeddings (STRING, GO, PxMap, TxMap), added as a latent shift. Unseen single genes approach split-half reproducibility in 3 of 4 cell lines; doubles beat the additive baseline slightly; cross-line prediction beats a nearest-cell-line baseline in two (self-reported).
key_claim_zh: 基态 MLP 作用于批次匹配的对照细胞，再加上图 Transformer 生成的扰动嵌入（STRING、GO、PxMap、TxMap），以潜空间平移方式相加。未见单基因预测在 4 个细胞系中的 3 个接近折半重复性；双基因预测仅略优于加性基线；跨细胞系预测在两个细胞系中优于最近细胞系基线（自报）。
so_what_en: Batch-matched controls and retrieval metrics counter the strong mean baseline; split-half reproducibility is a reference level. The model cannot learn the unseen target gene's downregulation, a limit for cis effects.
so_what_zh: 批次匹配对照和检索指标可抵消强均值基线；折半重复性是一个参照水平。模型学不到未见靶基因自身的下调，这对顺式效应是一个限制。
caveat_en: Published Nature Biotechnology text read (online May 2026); supplementary tables and figure values not seen. The abstract's 8-25% gain is worded ambiguously, with no per-task percentages in the text; two graphs are proprietary.
caveat_zh: 已阅读 Nature Biotechnology 发表版正文（2026 年 5 月在线）；补充表格和图中数值未见。摘要中的 8-25% 提升表述含糊，正文没有分任务的百分比；其中两个图谱为专有数据。

title: Unbalanced Perturbation Dynamics For Cell Fate Design
key_claim_en: Unbalanced generative framework learned from unpaired snapshots jointly models transcriptomic state transitions and cell-number change, with forward prediction of unseen perturbations and contexts and inverse design toward target expression programs or cell-type compositions; abstract-level, self-reported (simulations, sciPlex3 drug, PBMC cytokine data).
key_claim_zh: 在无配对快照上学习的非平衡生成框架，联合建模转录组状态转移和细胞数量变化，可对未见扰动和背景做正向预测，并朝目标表达程序或细胞类型组成做逆向设计；仅为摘要层面的自报结果（模拟、sciPlex3 药物、PBMC 细胞因子数据）。
so_what_en: Models cell-number change that a mass-preserving shift predictor ignores; a genotype that alters drug survival would otherwise be misread as an expression shift. Also offers inverse design toward target programs.
so_what_zh: 它建模了保质量平移预测器所忽略的细胞数量变化；改变药物存活的基因型否则会被误读为表达平移。同时提供朝目标程序的逆向设计。
caveat_en: Abstract only (bioRxiv metadata); full text not read, so no numbers or benchmark details were checked. Version 1, posted July 2026; unreviewed preprint.
caveat_zh: 仅有摘要（bioRxiv 元数据）；未读全文，因此未核对任何数字或基准细节。版本 1，2026 年 7 月发布；未经同行评议的预印本。

title: PerturbNet predicts single-cell responses to unseen chemical and genetic perturbations
key_claim_en: ESM protein-sequence embeddings feed a conditional normalizing flow predicting cell-state distributions for coding variants (163 TP53/KRAS and 257 GATA1 sequences); on held-out sequences the KNN baseline beats it for TP53/KRAS, and its GATA1 large-effect-gene median R2 is 0.2.
key_claim_zh: ESM 蛋白序列嵌入输入条件归一化流，预测编码变异后的细胞状态分布（163 条 TP53/KRAS 序列和 257 条 GATA1 序列）；在留出序列上，TP53/KRAS 的 KNN 基线优于它，其 GATA1 大效应基因的中位 R2 为 0.2。
so_what_en: Class-1 variant encoder, but limited to proteins seen in training, untested with drugs and not clearly beyond nearest neighbours. Its GenotypeVAE encodes target genes by GO terms, not donor genotype.
so_what_zh: 类别 1 变异编码器，但仅限于训练中见过的蛋白，未与药物联合测试，也未明确优于最近邻基线。其 GenotypeVAE 用 GO 术语编码靶基因，而不是供体基因型。
caveat_en: Published Molecular Systems Biology text read (Europe PMC); the 2022 bioRxiv version was not. Results self-reported; Table 6 mean large-effect R2 (-99.65) is worse than KNN (-41.873) despite the text claiming consistent superiority.
caveat_zh: 已阅读 Molecular Systems Biology 发表版正文（Europe PMC）；2022 年 bioRxiv 版本未读。结果为自报；表 6 中大效应基因的平均 R2（-99.65）比 KNN（-41.873）更差，而正文称其一致更优。

title: Predicting cellular responses to complex perturbations in high-throughput screens
key_claim_en: Additive latent composition of basal state, perturbation and covariate embeddings (adversarial disentanglement), with a learned nonlinear dose or time curve and a nonlinear decoder. On Norman combinations a random-cell baseline matches CPA and a linear model on R2; 5,329 unmeasured combinations (97.6%) were imputed.
key_claim_zh: 基态、扰动和协变量嵌入在潜空间中加性组合（对抗式解耦），并配有学到的非线性剂量或时间曲线和非线性解码器。在 Norman 组合上，随机细胞基线的 R2 与 CPA 和线性模型相当；补全了 5,329 个未测量组合（97.6%）。
so_what_en: Genotype entering as another additive covariate embedding would make genotype-by-drug interaction depend only on the nonlinear decoder. Mean R2 cannot test this, as random-cell baselines already match CPA.
so_what_zh: 若基因型作为另一个加性协变量嵌入，基因型×药物交互将只取决于非线性解码器。平均 R2 无法检验这一点，因为随机细胞基线已与 CPA 相当。
caveat_en: Published Molecular Systems Biology text read (Europe PMC, 2023). Numbers are self-reported; the 5,329 imputed combinations were not experimentally validated (uncertainty is a distance score).
caveat_zh: 已阅读 Molecular Systems Biology 发表版正文（Europe PMC，2023）。数字为自报；补全的 5,329 个组合未经实验验证（不确定性只是距离得分）。

title: Predicting transcriptional outcomes of novel multigene perturbations with GEARS
key_claim_en: GNN with GO-derived perturbation and coexpression gene graphs predicts multigene outcomes for never-perturbed genes. Norman two-gene sets: performance up over 30% versus baselines (53% when both genes unseen); interaction precision@10 up over 40% for four of five subtypes (self-reported).
key_claim_zh: 图神经网络使用基于 GO 的扰动图和共表达基因图，可预测含从未被扰动基因的多基因扰动结果。在 Norman 双基因集上，性能比基线提高超过 30%（两个基因均未见时为 53%）；相互作用亚型的 precision@10 在五个亚型中的四个提高超过 40%（自报）。
so_what_en: Knowledge-graph baseline for loss-of-function variants coded as gene perturbations (inside the IterPert code, MD49); needs same-cell-type and combinatorial training data. Interaction scores reach R2 about 0.4 versus 0.0 for CPA.
so_what_zh: 以基因扰动编码功能缺失变异时的知识图谱基线（位于 IterPert 代码中，MD49）；需要同细胞类型和组合扰动的训练数据。相互作用得分的 R2 约为 0.4，CPA 约为 0.0。
caveat_en: Published Nature Biotechnology text read via Europe PMC; the preprint abstract differs (five subtypes, no percentage). Main-text baselines are CPA, no perturbation and GRN propagation; all numbers self-reported.
caveat_zh: 已通过 Europe PMC 阅读 Nature Biotechnology 发表版正文；预印本摘要不同（五个亚型、无百分比）。正文基线为 CPA、无扰动模型和 GRN 传播模型；所有数字为自报。

title: Stack: In-Context Learning of Single-Cell Biology
key_claim_en: Tabular-attention foundation model (149 million cells) post-trained so unlabeled prompt cells from another donor or condition steer predictions without fine-tuning; first in 28 of 31 evaluations (self-reported), but an oracle donor-mean baseline leads pseudobulk correlation across donors.
key_claim_zh: 表格注意力基础模型（1.49 亿个细胞，即 149 million），经后训练后，来自另一供体或条件的无标签提示细胞可在不微调的情况下引导预测；在 31 项评测中 28 项第一（自报），但跨供体时，使用额外数据的 oracle 供体均值基线在伪批量相关性上领先。
so_what_en: Prompt cells can carry a new donor's baseline state without genotype input. Perturbation tests in the text read cover only 2 to 3 donors.
so_what_zh: 提示细胞可以在没有基因型输入的情况下携带新供体的基线状态。文中读到的扰动测试只涉及 2 到 3 个供体。
caveat_en: Text read is the earlier Europe PMC preprint version (201 perturbations, no 40-donor dataset); the v2 abstract (June 2026) reports 892 perturbations and 40 donors. All results self-reported.
caveat_zh: 所读正文是较早的 Europe PMC 预印本版本（201 个扰动，没有 40 供体数据集）；v2 摘要（2026 年 6 月）报告了 892 个扰动和 40 个供体。所有结果均为自报。

title: Modeling and predicting single-cell multi-gene perturbation responses with scLAMBDA
key_claim_en: Deep generative model for single- and multi-gene CRISPR perturbations that disentangles a basal cell state from perturbation-specific salient representations and uses LLM-derived gene embeddings as prior knowledge for unseen target genes; the abstract reports outperforming state-of-the-art methods (self-reported).
key_claim_zh: 用于单基因和多基因 CRISPR 扰动的深度生成模型，把基础细胞状态与扰动特异的显著表示解耦，并以 LLM 基因嵌入作为先验知识来处理未见靶基因；摘要称优于最先进方法（自报）。
so_what_en: A basal/salient split is a slot where a donor or genotype term could enter; LLM gene embeddings offer a route to unseen targets. The abstract mentions no genotype input.
so_what_zh: 基础/显著（basal/salient）划分是可以加入供体或基因型项的位置；LLM 基因嵌入为未见靶标提供了途径。摘要未提及基因型输入。
caveat_en: Abstract only (bioRxiv metadata); full text not read. Outperformance claims are self-reported; version 1 posted December 2024.
caveat_zh: 仅有摘要（bioRxiv 元数据）；未读全文。优于其他方法的结论为自报；版本 1 于 2024 年 12 月发布。

title: Modelling drug-induced cellular perturbation responses with a biologically informed dual-branch transformer
key_claim_en: Dual-branch transformer (self-attention base encoder, cross-attention perturb encoder) taking UniMol drug features, a heterogeneous knowledge graph, and dose (ten ranges) and time tokens. L1000 PCC beats the next-best model by 8.2% to 36.7%; preclinical pretraining adds 15.04% (breast cancer) (self-reported).
key_claim_zh: 双分支 Transformer（自注意力基础编码器、交叉注意力扰动编码器），输入 UniMol 药物特征、异质知识图谱，以及剂量（十个区间）和时间 token。在 L1000 上 PCC 比次优模型高 8.2% 至 36.7%；临床前预训练在乳腺癌上再提高 15.04%（自报）。
so_what_en: Drug-conditioned template with explicit dose and time tokens and a baseline-versus-shift split. Cold-cell performance falls 121% versus warm-start, a proxy for unseen-genotype generalization, and cell-mean baselines stay competitive.
so_what_zh: 带有显式剂量和时间 token 以及基线与位移分离的药物条件化模板。冷细胞设置下性能比热启动下降 121%，可作为未见基因型泛化的代理，而按细胞平均的基线仍有竞争力。
caveat_en: Published Nature Machine Intelligence text read (January 2026). Bulk-level data with 978 landmark genes; all numbers self-reported. The 15.04% is a pretraining gain for breast cancer (pan cancer 2.51%).
caveat_zh: 已阅读 Nature Machine Intelligence 发表版正文（2026 年 1 月）。数据为批量水平，仅 978 个标志基因；所有数字均为自报。15.04% 是乳腺癌的预训练增益（泛癌为 2.51%）。

title: Predicting and interpreting cell-type-specific drug responses in the small-data regime using inductive priors
key_claim_en: Graph attention over cell-type-specific co-expression graphs, control expression and SMILES drug embeddings predicts expression mean and variance for unseen cell types and compounds; self-reported gains over scGen, CPA and chemCPA, but a mean baseline wins most strict out-of-distribution Tahoe lines.
key_claim_zh: 图注意力网络作用于细胞类型特异的共表达图、对照表达和 SMILES 药物嵌入，预测未见细胞类型和化合物的表达均值与方差；相对 scGen、CPA 和 chemCPA 的优势为自报，但在最严格的分布外 Tahoe 设置下，均值基线在大多数细胞系上更好。
so_what_en: Without control cells from the unseen line, a mean baseline beat the model for most Tahoe lines; with them the model won. A new genotype therefore needs baseline cells.
so_what_zh: 没有来自未见细胞系的对照细胞时，均值基线在大多数 Tahoe 细胞系上优于该模型；加入对照细胞后模型更好。因此新的基因型需要基线细胞。
caveat_en: Published Nature Machine Intelligence text read (March 2026). The mean-baseline comparison cites Supplementary Fig. 7, not on disk; all results are self-reported.
caveat_zh: 已阅读 Nature Machine Intelligence 发表版正文（2026 年 3 月）。均值基线的比较引用补充图 7，未在本地；所有结果均为自报。

title: PerturbRx: Learning Treatment-Conditioned Latent Transitions for Patient Drug Response Prediction
key_claim_en: Frozen scFoundation latent space; a drug- and dose-conditioned transition predictor trained on unpaired Tahoe-100M populations is applied to patient bulk profiles. TCGA-186 held-out patients: AUROC 0.626 versus 0.581 for static patient-plus-drug features; on TCGA-508 0.692 versus 0.681 (self-reported).
key_claim_zh: 冻结的 scFoundation 潜空间；在无配对的 Tahoe-100M 群体上训练药物与剂量条件化的转移预测器，并应用于患者批量表达谱。TCGA-186 留出患者：AUROC 为 0.626，静态患者加药物特征为 0.581；TCGA-508 上为 0.692 对 0.681（自报）。
so_what_en: Reusable action-conditioned transition module, but the TCGA-508 gain over static features is below one standard deviation and predicted transitions are not validated against measured post-treatment profiles.
so_what_zh: 可复用的动作条件化转移模块，但 TCGA-508 上相对静态特征的增益小于一个标准差，且预测的转移未用实测的处理后表达谱验证。
caveat_en: arXiv v1 (August 2026) read in full; all results self-reported. Target labels are retrospective (relapse-time proxies in TCGA-186), source cell lines differ from bulk tumors, and dose is not calibrated.
caveat_zh: 已完整阅读 arXiv v1（2026 年 8 月）；所有结果均为自报。目标标签是回顾性的（TCGA-186 使用复发时间代理标签），源细胞系不同于批量肿瘤，剂量未经校准。

title: Tahoe-x1: Scaling Perturbation-Trained Single-Cell Foundation Models to 3 Billion Parameters
key_claim_en: Perturbation-trained single-cell foundation models (70M, 1.3B, 3B parameters) pretrained on 266 million profiles including Tahoe-100M with a masked-expression objective that includes a drug token; the authors report 3-30x compute efficiency and state-of-the-art benchmarks (self-reported); Apache-2.0 code and checkpoints are provided.
key_claim_zh: 以扰动数据训练的单细胞基础模型（70M、1.3B、3B 参数），在包含 Tahoe-100M 的 266 million 个细胞谱上预训练，使用含药物 token 的掩码表达目标；作者称计算效率提高 3-30 倍并在基准上达到最先进水平（自报）；代码和检查点以 Apache-2.0 提供。
so_what_en: Open Apache-2.0 encoder with a drug token that could supply a cell-state embedding; no benchmark numbers appear in the README or abstract.
so_what_zh: 带药物 token 的开放 Apache-2.0 编码器，可提供细胞状态嵌入；README 和摘要中没有基准数字。
caveat_en: README and clone read (last commit 3 June 2026); the preprint text was not read, only its abstract. Efficiency and benchmark claims are self-reported by the developing company.
caveat_zh: 已阅读 README 和克隆仓库（最后提交于 2026 年 6 月 3 日）；预印本正文未读，仅读摘要。效率和基准结论由开发公司自报。

title: Sequential Optimal Experimental Design of Perturbation Screens Guided by Multi-modal Priors
key_claim_en: Active learning on a budget for Perturb-seq: a model selects the next perturbations to profile using multi-modal prior knowledge; in silico on a large CRISPRi Perturb-seq dataset it reached comparable accuracy with one third of the perturbations needed by the next-best active-learning method (self-reported).
key_claim_zh: Perturb-seq 的预算受限主动学习：模型利用多模态先验知识选择下一批要测的扰动；在大型 CRISPRi Perturb-seq 数据集的计算机模拟中，达到相当精度所需的扰动数是次优主动学习方法的三分之一（自报）。
so_what_en: Retrospective protocol for choosing which perturbations to profile next; it could be reused for a genotype-by-drug grid, with a mechanistic prior ranking the next pair (design suggestion, untested).
so_what_zh: 用于选择下一批要测扰动的回溯式方案；可复用于基因型×药物网格，由机理先验对下一个组合排序（设计建议，未经测试）。
caveat_en: Abstract only (bioRxiv metadata); full text not read. The one-third figure is relative to the next-best active-learning method and self-reported; version 1, December 2023.
caveat_zh: 仅有摘要（bioRxiv 元数据）；未读全文。三分之一的数字相对于次优主动学习方法，且为自报；版本 1，2023 年 12 月。

title: Genentech/iterative-perturb-seq (GitHub)
key_claim_en: Apache-2.0 repo accompanying IterPert: README lists eight baseline acquisition strategies run with a GEARS model on replogle_k562_essential_1000hvg; the example call uses 100 initial samples, 5 rounds and 100 queries per round; priors enter through a knowledge-kernel tutorial.
key_claim_zh: IterPert 配套的 Apache-2.0 代码库：README 列出八种基线采集策略，配合 GEARS 模型在 replogle_k562_essential_1000hvg 上运行；示例调用为 100 个初始样本、5 轮、每轮 100 次查询；先验通过知识核教程引入。
so_what_en: Reusable acquisition-function harness under a permissive licence for a retrospective closed-loop benchmark on genetic perturbations; genotype-by-drug use would need a new model and dataset.
so_what_zh: 宽松许可下可复用的采集函数框架，用于遗传扰动的回溯式闭环基准；用于基因型×药物则需要新的模型和数据集。
caveat_en: Shallow clone (last commit 24 May 2024) read verbatim: README, LICENSE and setup files only. setup.py lists license 'XXX' while the LICENSE file is Apache 2.0.
caveat_zh: 已逐字阅读浅克隆（最后提交于 2024 年 5 月 24 日）：仅 README、LICENSE 和 setup 文件。setup.py 的许可写为“XXX”，而 LICENSE 文件为 Apache 2.0。

title: CellBox: Interpretable Machine Learning for Perturbation Biology with Application to the Design of Cancer Combination Therapy
key_claim_en: CellBox couples an explicit cell-dynamics (ODE) model with machine learning on drug-perturbation responses of one melanoma cell line; de novo networks recapitulate some known interactions. Data: RPPA protein and phenotype nodes, 89 drug combinations of 12 drugs; splits: random, leave-one-drug-out, single-to-combo.
key_claim_zh: CellBox 将显式的细胞动力学（ODE）模型与机器学习结合，用于一个黑色素瘤细胞系的药物扰动响应；从头学得的网络复现了部分已知相互作用。数据：RPPA 蛋白与表型节点，由 12 种药物构成的 89 个药物组合；划分方式：随机、留一药物、single-to-combo。
so_what_en: Interaction-network ODE core with leave-one-drug-out and single-to-combo tests, but no genotype input and code limited to CellBox-format data, so HB would need new parameters and preprocessing.
so_what_zh: 相互作用网络的 ODE 核心，配有留一药物与 single-to-combo 测试，但没有基因型输入且代码仅限 CellBox 格式数据，因此 HB 需要新增参数和预处理。
caveat_en: Cell Systems full text not read: only the abstract (Europe PMC) and the README of the PyTorch port were read. Europe PMC lists 2021; the README and DOI say 2020.
caveat_zh: 未读取 Cell Systems 全文：仅读取了摘要（Europe PMC）和 PyTorch 移植版的 README。Europe PMC 标注为 2021 年；README 与 DOI 则为 2020 年。

title: Efficient Parameter Estimation Enables the Prediction of Drug Response Using a Mechanistic Pan-Cancer Pathway Model
key_claim_en: Framework for parameterizing large mechanistic models, used to predict cancer cell-line drug response from exome and transcriptome data; over 10^4 times faster than state-of-the-art methods, and a model with >1,200 species and >2,600 reactions predicts drug-combination effects from single-drug data (abstract only; self-reported).
key_claim_zh: 用于参数化大型机理模型的框架，并用外显子组与转录组数据预测癌细胞系的药物响应；比最先进方法快 10^4 倍以上，含 >1,200 个物种和 >2,600 个反应的模型可由单药数据预测药物组合效应（仅摘要；自报）。
so_what_en: Precedent for predicting cell-line drug response from exome and transcriptome data with a large mechanistic pathway model; how variants enter the model is not verifiable from the abstract.
so_what_zh: 先例：用大型机理通路模型，根据外显子组与转录组数据预测细胞系药物响应；变异如何进入模型无法从摘要核实。
caveat_en: Abstract only (Europe PMC); no full text was available, so how mutations and expression enter the model, and volume and pages, are unverified.
caveat_zh: 仅有摘要（Europe PMC）；没有可用的全文，因此突变和表达如何进入模型，以及卷期页码，均未核实。

title: Combination treatment optimization using a pan-cancer pathway model
key_claim_en: Simulation study: CMA-ES plus Hamiltonian-Monte-Carlo sampling optimizes combinations of 7 agents, trading proliferation against dose, on 12 colorectal, 19 melanoma, 10 pancreatic and 20 breast lines. The pathway model (1228 species, 2704 reactions) is individualized by 108 gene expression levels and 36 gain-of-function mutations.
key_claim_zh: 模拟研究：CMA-ES 结合 Hamiltonian-Monte-Carlo 采样，对 7 种药物的组合进行优化，在增殖抑制与剂量之间权衡，涉及 12 个结直肠、19 个黑色素瘤、10 个胰腺和 20 个乳腺细胞系。该通路模型（1228 个物种、2704 个反应）借助 108 个基因的表达量和 36 个功能获得性突变实现细胞系个体化。
so_what_en: Genotype enters a mechanistic forward model as an input vector (expression plus gain-of-function mutations) inside a dose-penalized design loop; the model assumes static transcription, hence no drug-induced expression shifts.
so_what_zh: 基因型以输入向量（表达量加功能获得性突变）的形式进入机理前向模型，并置于带剂量惩罚的设计循环中；该模型假设转录静态，因此没有药物诱导的表达变化。
caveat_en: Published open-access version read. All results are simulations; the paper reports no laboratory validation, and the pathway model was trained in prior work on proliferation data from 120 cell lines.
caveat_zh: 已读已发表的开放获取版本。所有结果均为模拟；论文未报告实验室验证，通路模型是在先前工作中用 120 个细胞系的增殖数据训练得到的。

title: Predicting Drug Response and Synergy Using a Deep Learning Model of Human Cancer Cells
key_claim_en: DrugCell maps binary mutation status of 3,008 genes through 2,086 Gene Ontology subsystems (12,516 neurons), plus a drug-structure branch; 509,294 cell line-drug pairs; 5-fold overall rho 0.80, per-drug median rho 0.37 versus 0.35 elastic net (self-reported).
key_claim_zh: DrugCell 将 3,008 个基因的二值突变状态输入由 2,086 个 Gene Ontology 子系统构成的可视神经网络（12,516 个神经元），并配一条药物结构分支；训练数据为 509,294 个细胞系-药物对；5 折交叉验证的总体 rho 为 0.80，逐药中位 rho 为 0.37，弹性网络为 0.35（自报）。
so_what_en: Template for a genotype branch (binary mutations into a pathway hierarchy, per-subsystem attributions). Pooled rho 0.80 versus per-drug median 0.37 argues for reporting per-drug metrics.
so_what_zh: 基因型分支的模板（二值突变输入通路层级，并给出每个子系统的归因）。总体 rho 0.80 与逐药中位数 0.37 的差距说明应报告逐药指标。
caveat_en: Author in-press PDF read, not the final issue; the AACR meeting abstract (second URL) was not on disk, and the earlier recorded rho values 0.74 and 0.82 are not in this paper.
caveat_zh: 读取的是作者的在线待刊 PDF，而非最终刊期版本；AACR 会议摘要（第二个 URL）不在磁盘上，先前记录的 rho 值 0.74 和 0.82 不见于本论文。

title: Using deep learning to model the hierarchical structure and function of a cell
key_claim_en: DCell: visible neural network on a hierarchy of 2,526 subsystems, trained on several million genotypes (yeast, per the DrugCell paper); simulates growth nearly as accurately as lab observations (self-reported); 80% of growth-prediction importance lies in 484 subsystems (21% as reported); some mechanisms follow Boolean logic.
key_claim_zh: DCell：建立在 2,526 个子系统层级上的可视神经网络，用数百万个基因型训练（酵母，据 DrugCell 论文）；模拟生长的准确度接近实验室观测（自报）；生长预测 80% 的重要性集中在 484 个子系统（报告为 21%）；部分机制遵循布尔逻辑。
so_what_en: Loose sparsity anchor for HB: model-derived importance concentrates in about one fifth of subsystems for yeast growth; it is not evidence about human drug response.
so_what_zh: 对 HB 而言只是松散的稀疏性锚点：模型导出的重要性集中在约五分之一的子系统，对象是酵母生长；它不能说明人类药物响应。
caveat_en: Abstract only (full text could not be retrieved); yeast comes from MD53; the stated 21% does not match 484 of 2,526; volume and pages unverified.
caveat_zh: 仅有摘要（全文未能获取）；酵母一说来自 MD53；所报告的 21% 与 2,526 个子系统中的 484 个不相符；卷期页码未核实。

title: Drug Resistance Mechanisms in Colorectal Cancer Dissected with Cell Type–Specific Dynamic Logic Models
key_claim_en: Cell-line-specific dynamic logic models built from 14 phosphoproteins under 43 perturbation conditions (5 stimuli, 7 inhibitors) in 14 colorectal lines; model parameters strongly track sensitivity for 14 of 27 drugs, 9 without a genomic biomarker; a MEK-inhibitor plus GSK3 combination was validated.
key_claim_zh: 基于 14 个磷酸化蛋白在 43 种扰动条件（5 种刺激、7 种抑制剂）下、14 个结直肠癌细胞系中的测量，构建细胞系特异的动态逻辑模型；模型参数与 27 种药物中 14 种的敏感性强相关，其中 9 种没有基因组生物标志物；并验证了 MEK 抑制剂与 GSK3 联合用药。
so_what_en: Signaling-dynamics parameters tracked sensitivity for 9 drugs with no genomic biomarker, so static genotype alone may miss response determinants; a pathway-state term is worth testing (abstract only).
so_what_zh: 信号动力学参数与 9 种没有基因组生物标志物的药物的敏感性相关，说明仅凭静态基因型可能遗漏响应决定因素；值得检验加入通路状态项（仅摘要）。
caveat_en: Abstract level only (full-text fetches failed); the assay type, network source and drug-sensitivity dataset are unverified.
caveat_zh: 仅为摘要级别（全文抓取失败）；检测方法、网络来源和药物敏感性数据集均未核实。

title: Patient-specific logic models of signaling pathways from screenings on cancer biopsies to prioritize personalized combination therapies
key_claim_en: Fixed-topology logic-ODE apoptosis network refit to microfluidic caspase-3 screens of 2 pancreatic lines and 4 biopsies; 16 of 93 parameters differ among patients. In vitro, 3 of 3 predicted combinations concordant; in xenografts, 1 of 3 (4 mice per group).
key_claim_zh: 固定拓扑的 logic-ODE 凋亡网络，对 2 个胰腺癌细胞系和 4 份活检的微流控 caspase-3 筛选数据重新拟合；93 个参数中 16 个在患者间不同。体外 3 个预测组合全部吻合；异种移植中仅 1 个（每组 4 只小鼠）。
so_what_en: Mutations and basal expression did not explain signaling differences between two lines, so a genotype-aware model may need a pathway-state term; personalization data are tiny (4 biopsies, one readout).
so_what_zh: 突变和基础表达无法解释两个细胞系间的信号差异，因此基因型感知模型可能需要通路状态项；个体化数据极少（4 份活检，单一读数）。
caveat_en: Published PMC version read. Experimental validation used the two cell lines only; patient-level predictions were in silico. Authors' own numbers (self-reported).
caveat_zh: 已读 PMC 上的已发表版本。实验验证只用了两个细胞系；患者层面的预测仅为计算机模拟。数字为作者自报。

title: X-Cell: Scaling Causal Perturbation Prediction Across Diverse Cellular Contexts via Diffusion Language Models
key_claim_en: Technical report: X-Atlas/Pisces (25.6M perturbed cells; seven CRISPRi screens in 16 contexts) trains X-Cell (55M; 4.9B in Ultra). In an 83M-3.1B sweep on Replogle-Nadig, test-loss exponent is 0.03 and fold-change correlation plateaus near 0.31 above 1.6B parameters (self-reported).
key_claim_zh: 技术报告：X-Atlas/Pisces（25.6M 个受扰动细胞；7 个 CRISPRi 筛选，覆盖 16 种情境）用于训练 X-Cell（55M；Ultra 版为 4.9B）。在 Replogle-Nadig 上的 83M-3.1B 规模扫描中，测试损失指数为 0.03，折叠变化相关性在超过 1.6B 参数后停在 0.31 附近（自报）。
so_what_en: Diversity of perturbation-context pairs, not parameter count, is the authors' stated bottleneck; drugs enter as target-gene perturbations (zero-shot Pearson Δ 0.31 versus 0.22 for STATE, self-reported).
so_what_zh: 作者自己给出的瓶颈是扰动-情境组合的多样性，而不是参数量；药物被当作靶基因扰动输入（零样本 Pearson Δ 为 0.31，STATE 为 0.22，自报）。
caveat_en: Company-authored technical report (no peer-reviewed version seen) read in full; the press release was not retrieved (HTTP 403). Baselines were not retrained at matching scale (STATE on 5.5M cells); numbers are self-reported.
caveat_zh: 已读完公司自撰的技术报告（未见同行评议版本）；新闻稿未能获取（HTTP 403）。基线模型未在相同规模上重新训练（STATE 使用 5.5M 个细胞）；数字为自报。

title: theislab/CPA (GitHub)
key_claim_en: CPA (Compositional Perturbation Autoencoder) learns drug and cell-type latent spaces and dose-response curves for perturbations and combinations; perturbation, dosage (dummy for CRISPR) and cell type go in adata.obs; tutorials cover unseen drug combinations, unseen drugs via RDKit embeddings, and unseen cell types (self-described).
key_claim_zh: CPA（Compositional Perturbation Autoencoder）学习药物与细胞类型的潜空间，以及各扰动及其组合的剂量-响应曲线；扰动、剂量（CRISPR 用占位剂量）和细胞类型放在 adata.obs 中；教程涵盖未见药物组合、借助 RDKit 嵌入的未见药物以及未见细胞类型（自述）。
so_what_en: Candidate baseline with a dose axis and cell-type and batch covariates in adata.obs; adding genotype as another covariate is untested here, and the README documents no uncertainty method.
so_what_zh: 带剂量轴、细胞类型和批次协变量（均放在 adata.obs）的候选基线；把基因型作为另一个协变量尚未在此验证，且 README 未记载不确定性方法。
caveat_en: Shallow clone read (README, LICENSE, pyproject.toml; last commit 2024-08-14); LICENSE says BSD 3-Clause while pyproject.toml says MIT. Commit, issue and release counts cannot be checked from the clone.
caveat_zh: 已读浅克隆（README、LICENSE、pyproject.toml；最近提交 2024-08-14）；LICENSE 写的是 BSD 3-Clause，而 pyproject.toml 写的是 MIT。提交数、议题数和发布条目无法从克隆中核实。

title: Lotfollahi-lab/Perturbgen (GitHub)
key_claim_en: Generative foundation model trained on over 100 million single-cell transcriptomes, predicting how a genetic perturbation at a source state shapes downstream states and trajectories; MIT licence; checkpoint on Hugging Face; training needs a CUDA GPU with 40 GB or more for batch size 64.
key_claim_zh: 在超过 1 亿（100 million）个单细胞转录组上训练的生成式基础模型，预测源状态下的基因扰动如何影响下游状态与轨迹；MIT 许可；检查点在 Hugging Face；训练需要 CUDA GPU，批大小 64 至少需 40 GB 显存。
so_what_en: Source-to-target-state generative prediction is a template for trajectory-aware world-model baselines, but only genetic perturbations are documented and training needs a 40 GB GPU.
so_what_zh: 从源状态到目标状态的生成式预测可作为轨迹感知世界模型基线的模板，但文档只涉及基因扰动，且训练需要 40 GB 显存的 GPU。
caveat_en: Shallow clone read (README, LICENSE, pyproject.toml; last commit 2026-10-12); the architecture is shown only as an image, and the cited bioRxiv preprint was not read.
caveat_zh: 已读浅克隆（README、LICENSE、pyproject.toml；最近提交 2026-10-12）；架构只以图片形式给出，README 引用的 bioRxiv 预印本未读。

title: PULSAR: a Foundation Model for Multi-scale and Multicellular Biology
key_claim_en: PULSAR encodes sets of PBMC cells (36.2M cells, 6,807 donors) into a 512-d donor embedding; a FiLM Virtual Instrument conditioned on cytokine ESM2 embeddings shifts baseline donor embeddings. On Parse-PBMC-10M (12 donors, 90 cytokines), unseen-donor embedding RMSE fell 42.5% versus a linear baseline (self-reported).
key_claim_zh: PULSAR 将 PBMC 细胞集合（36.2M 个细胞、6,807 位供体）编码为 512 维供体嵌入；以细胞因子 ESM2 嵌入为条件的 FiLM Virtual Instrument 对基线供体嵌入做位移。在 Parse-PBMC-10M（12 位供体、90 种细胞因子）上，未见供体的嵌入 RMSE 比线性基线降低 42.5%（自报）。
so_what_en: Donor-as-latent-state with a FiLM-conditioned residual perturbation shift is a template for a genotype-aware model; genetic variants are only listed as future work, not used.
so_what_zh: 把供体作为潜状态、并以 FiLM 条件化的残差扰动位移作用其上，可作为基因型感知模型的模板；遗传变异只被列为未来工作，并未使用。
caveat_en: PMC copy of the bioRxiv preprint read (metadata: version 1, 2025-11-26), not peer reviewed; all numbers are self-reported. For unseen cytokines the model only matched a donor-mean baseline (0.234 versus 0.228).
caveat_zh: 已读 bioRxiv 预印本的 PMC 副本（元数据：版本 1，2025-11-26），未经同行评议；所有数字均为自报。对未见细胞因子，模型仅与供体均值基线相当（0.234 对 0.228）。

title: Predicting donor-specific cytokine effects on PBMCs - cellflow documentation
key_claim_en: PBMC cytokine tutorial (almost ten million cells, 12 donors, 90 cytokines): donors enter as mean-control embeddings, cytokines as ESM2 embeddings, controls are split by donor so mappings stay within a donor; IL-15 is predicted for held-out donors once Donor 8's IL-15 is seen.
key_claim_zh: PBMC 细胞因子教程（近一千万个细胞、12 位供体、90 种细胞因子）：供体以其对照均值嵌入输入，细胞因子以 ESM2 嵌入输入，对照按供体拆分，使映射只发生在同一供体内；在 Donor 8 的 IL-15 已见之后，对留出供体预测 IL-15。
so_what_en: Donor-matched control-to-treated pairing with a mean-control donor embedding is the setup a genotype-matched source population should copy; performance rose significantly once a cytokine was seen in one donor.
so_what_zh: 以均值对照作供体嵌入、并按供体配对对照与处理，是基因型匹配源群体应当照搬的设置；某细胞因子在一位供体中见过之后，性能显著上升。
caveat_en: Official documentation tutorial read in full; evaluation is qualitative UMAP overlays plus energy-distance and R-squared plots with no values in the text, and the metric PCA is fit on all data, including test data.
caveat_zh: 已完整阅读官方文档教程；评估是定性的 UMAP 叠加图加能量距离与 R 方图，文本中无数值，且用于指标的 PCA 在包含测试数据的全部数据上拟合。

title: ArcInstitute/state (GitHub)
key_claim_en: State Transition (ST) model trains on highly variable gene features with a perturbation column and cell-type key (example: 2000 genes); TOML splits hold out whole cell types (zero-shot) or perturbations within cell types (few-shot); README lists Replogle-Nadig and Tahoe-100M notebooks.
key_claim_zh: State Transition（ST）模型以高变基因特征训练，配有扰动列和细胞类型键（示例：2000 个基因）；TOML 划分可留出整类细胞类型（零样本）或细胞类型内的扰动（少样本）；README 列出 Replogle-Nadig 和 Tahoe-100M 笔记本。
so_what_en: Hold-out splits are a template; no donor or genotype covariate is documented. Weights and outputs are non-commercial; the licence counts use as a prior as a derivative work (flag U7).
so_what_zh: 留出划分可作模板；文档未记载供体或基因型协变量。权重与输出为非商业许可，且许可把“用作先验”算作衍生作品（标记 U7）。
caveat_en: Clone read (README, LICENSE, MODEL_LICENSE, pyproject.toml; last commit 2026-07-23); the licence files were on disk only as their first 25 lines, so grant terms are unread.
caveat_zh: 已读克隆（README、LICENSE、MODEL_LICENSE、pyproject.toml；最近提交 2026-07-23）；许可文件在磁盘上仅有前 25 行，因此授权条款未读。

title: theislab/cellflow (GitHub) and cellflow-tools (PyPI)
key_claim_en: Flow-matching framework predicting single-cell phenotypes under drug, genetic, cytokine, morphogen and organoid-protocol perturbations, with cell-fate engineering and organoid-growth optimization as example applications; LICENSE file says MIT but pyproject.toml says PolyForm-Noncommercial-1.0.0.
key_claim_zh: 基于流匹配的框架，预测药物、基因、细胞因子、形态发生素和类器官方案等扰动下的单细胞表型，示例应用包括细胞命运工程和类器官生长优化；LICENSE 文件写 MIT，而 pyproject.toml 写 PolyForm-Noncommercial-1.0.0。
so_what_en: Candidate forward model next to WM28; the README only lists protocol optimization as an application, and the licence (MIT versus PolyForm-Noncommercial) must be resolved before reuse.
so_what_zh: 可作为与 WM28 并列的前向模型候选；README 只把方案优化列为应用，复用前必须厘清许可（MIT 与 PolyForm-Noncommercial 之间的冲突）。
caveat_en: Clone read (README, LICENSE, pyproject.toml; last commit 2026-07-12); the PyPI page and its 0.0.9 release were not on disk, and the PolyForm licence text was not read.
caveat_zh: 已读克隆（README、LICENSE、pyproject.toml；最近提交 2026-07-12）；磁盘上没有 PyPI 页面及其 0.0.9 版本，也未读 PolyForm 许可文本。

title: MolGene-E: Inverse Molecular Design to Modulate Single Cell Transcriptomics
key_claim_en: Expression-to-molecule generator (denoising VAE, CLIP-style contrastive alignment with SELFIES embeddings, MLP prior), trained on MCF7 bulk chemical profiles with a 70-15-15 split without chemical overlap; zero-shot on 1,218 CRISPR-knockout signatures (44 TFs) and Sciplex-3 (188 compounds); scored by similarity to reference molecules (self-reported).
key_claim_zh: 表达谱到分子的生成器（去噪 VAE、CLIP 式对比学习把表达与 SELFIES 嵌入对齐、MLP 先验），在 MCF7 的批量化学扰动谱上训练，采用 70-15-15 划分且各划分间化学物质不重叠；零样本应用于 1,218 个 CRISPR 敲除特征（44 个转录因子）和 Sciplex-3（188 个化合物）；以与参考分子的相似度评分（自报）。
so_what_en: Inverse design here is expression-to-molecule, scored by reference similarity and docking rather than a forward transcriptome model; a guided design loop in the study would add that forward check.
so_what_zh: 这里的逆向设计是由表达到分子，以参考相似度和对接评分，而不是用前向转录组模型；本研究的引导式设计循环会补上这一前向检验。
caveat_en: PMC copy read (its abstract differs from the bioRxiv version 2 dated 2026-05-05 in the metadata); preprint, not peer reviewed; numbers are self-reported. Evaluation uses one cell line (MCF7).
caveat_zh: 已读 PMC 副本（其摘要与元数据中 2026-05-05 的 bioRxiv 版本 2 不同）；预印本，未经同行评议；数字为自报。评估只用一个细胞系（MCF7）。

title: ArcInstitute/stack (GitHub)
key_claim_en: Encoder-decoder foundation model on 150 million single cells with alternating cell-wise and gene-wise (tabular) attention and in-context generation; generation takes base and test .h5ad files with a split column (example donor_id); dataset formats cover human donor/cell-type and drug condition/cell-line/control inputs.
key_claim_zh: 在 150 million 个单细胞上训练的编码器-解码器基础模型，采用细胞维与基因维交替的（表格式）注意力并支持上下文生成；生成命令需要基础与测试 .h5ad 文件及拆分列（示例 donor_id）；数据集格式涵盖人类供体/细胞类型与药物条件/细胞系/对照输入。
so_what_en: Only a donor_id split is documented for donor handling (no genotype covariate); weights are non-commercial, and the licence counts use as a prior as a derivative work.
so_what_zh: 供体处理只记载了 donor_id 拆分（无基因型协变量）；权重为非商业许可，且许可把用作先验算作衍生作品。
caveat_en: Clone read (README, LICENSE, MODEL_LICENSE first 25 lines, pyproject.toml, setup.cfg); setup.cfg says Apache-2.0 while README and LICENSE say CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. The 149-million figure for the preprint (MD42) is not checkable here.
caveat_zh: 已读克隆（README、LICENSE、MODEL_LICENSE 前 25 行、pyproject.toml、setup.cfg）；setup.cfg 写 Apache-2.0，而 README 与 LICENSE 写 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0。预印本的 149 million 数字（MD42）无法在此核实。

title: theislab/ReconEval (GitHub)
key_claim_en: ReconEval tests decoding of latent cell representations to expression: PCA/AE/VAE (latent sizes 10 to 2048), four foundation-model embeddings with MLP, Transformer or KNN decoders, CellFlow and STATE latent shifts; data: Tahoe-100M (1,137 drugs x 50 cell lines), PBMC-10M (90 cytokines x 12 donors), LuCA.
key_claim_zh: ReconEval 检验把潜在细胞表示解码回表达：PCA/AE/VAE（潜维度 10 至 2048）、四种基础模型嵌入配 MLP、Transformer 或 KNN 解码器，以及 CellFlow 与 STATE 的潜空间位移；数据：Tahoe-100M（1,137 种药物 x 50 个细胞系）、PBMC-10M（90 种细胞因子 x 12 位供体）、LuCA。
so_what_en: A ready protocol for checking that predicted latent shifts decode into correct expression on drug and cytokine/donor datasets; its biological metrics (DEG recovery, pathway activity, cytokine response) are reusable.
so_what_zh: 一套现成协议，用于在药物与细胞因子/供体数据集上检验预测的潜空间位移能否解码为正确表达；其生物学指标（DEG 恢复、通路活性、细胞因子响应）可复用。
caveat_en: Clone read (README.rst, LICENSE, pyproject.toml; last commit 2026-10-11); the README reports no results and its paper badge is TBD, and the cited bioRxiv preprint was not read.
caveat_zh: 已读克隆（README.rst、LICENSE、pyproject.toml；最近提交 2026-10-11）；README 未报告结果且论文徽章为 TBD，所引 bioRxiv 预印本未读。

title: A large-scale benchmark for network inference from single-cell perturbation data
key_claim_en: CausalBench: over 200,000 interventional datapoints from two CRISPRi datasets (RPE1, K562), scored by mean Wasserstein distance, false omission rate and biology-based F1. Earlier interventional methods did not beat observational ones; challenge methods using interventions rank first, also at 25% of perturbations.
key_claim_zh: CausalBench：来自两个 CRISPRi 数据集（RPE1、K562）的 200,000 多个干预数据点，以平均 Wasserstein 距离、假遗漏率和基于生物学的 F1 评分。早期利用干预的方法并未胜过仅用观测的方法；利用干预的挑战赛方法排名第一，在仅用 25% 扰动时亦然。
so_what_en: Shows interventional data pay off only when the method exploits them (strongest methods also allow feedback loops); the Wasserstein/FOR pair is a ground-truth-free check for perturbation-effect recovery.
so_what_zh: 表明只有方法真正利用干预数据时它才有回报（最强的方法还允许反馈回路）；Wasserstein/FOR 这一对指标可在没有真值时检验扰动效应的恢复。
caveat_en: Published Communications Biology full text (PMC) read; its body attributes the 'no interventional advantage' result to a previous benchmark version. Authors' own results (self-reported); only two cell lines; the arXiv version was not read.
caveat_zh: 已读 Communications Biology 已发表全文（PMC）；正文把“干预无优势”的结果归于先前的基准版本。结果为作者自报；只有两个细胞系；arXiv 版本未读。

title: Dream to Control: Learning Behaviors by Latent Imagination
key_claim_en: Dreamer learns a latent world model (representation, transition and reward models) and trains action and value models on imagined latent rollouts using analytic value gradients. After 5e6 steps it averages 823 versus 332 for PlaNet and 786 for D4PG at 1e8 steps (self-reported).
key_claim_zh: Dreamer 学习潜在世界模型（表征、转移和奖励模型），并用解析价值梯度在想象的潜在展开上训练动作模型和价值模型。运行 5e6 步后平均得分 823，高于 PlaNet 的 332，也高于 D4PG 在 1e8 步时的 786（自报）。
so_what_en: Reference design for a latent transition core with gradient-based planning inside it. Reward prediction alone was insufficient, so keep an expression-reconstruction term.
so_what_zh: 为潜在转移核心及其内部的基于梯度的规划提供参考设计。仅预测奖励并不足够，因此应保留表达量重建项。
caveat_en: arXiv v3 PDF read in full; its header reads ICLR 2020. Scores are self-reported, on image-based control tasks, not biology.
caveat_zh: 已完整阅读 arXiv v3 PDF，其页眉为 ICLR 2020。分数为自报，来自基于图像的控制任务，而非生物学任务。

title: World Models: A Comprehensive Survey of Architectures, Methodologies, Reasoning Paradigms, and Applications
key_claim_en: Multi-axis survey of world models. Formalizes counterfactuals as abduction (infer latent state), action (swap intervention) and prediction; argues observational accuracy cannot guarantee counterfactual validity because latent dynamics are non-identifiable. Describes JEPA as decoder-free embedding prediction.
key_claim_zh: 世界模型的多轴综述。把反事实形式化为溯因（推断潜在状态）、动作（替换干预）和预测；认为观测层面的准确度无法保证反事实有效性，因为潜在动力学不可识别。把 JEPA 描述为不带解码器的嵌入预测。
so_what_en: Maps onto genotype or drug swaps: infer the latent state once, swap the action, predict. Add out-of-distribution flags and a counterfactual test, since held-out accuracy alone does not establish validity.
so_what_zh: 对应于基因型或药物互换：推断一次潜在状态，替换动作，再预测。应加入分布外标记和反事实检验，因为仅凭留出集准确度不能证明有效性。
caveat_en: arXiv v1 full text read. General survey with no single-cell or transcriptomic content (searched); its medical examples are second-hand descriptions of other papers.
caveat_zh: 已阅读 arXiv v1 全文。这是一篇通用综述，没有单细胞或转录组内容（已检索）；其医学例子是对其他论文的二手描述。

title: A Survey: Learning Embodied Intelligence from Physical Simulators and World Models
key_claim_en: Robotics survey: world models act as neural simulators, dynamics models for model-based RL, and reward models. Deterministic latent transitions are said to limit multimodal prediction and enable planner exploitation; MSE on predicted futures may not track downstream performance.
key_claim_zh: 机器人领域综述：世界模型充当神经模拟器、基于模型强化学习（RL）的动力学模型和奖励模型。文中称确定性潜在转移会限制多模态预测并使规划器可能利用模型误差；对预测未来的 MSE 未必与下游表现一致。
so_what_en: Cautions for the guided-design step: prefer stochastic transitions and uncertainty penalties so planners cannot exploit model errors, and judge the model by downstream decisions, not MSE alone.
so_what_zh: 对引导设计步骤的提醒：优先采用随机转移并加入不确定性惩罚，使规划器无法利用模型误差，并以下游决策而不是仅以 MSE 评价模型。
caveat_en: arXiv v3 full text read. Embodied-robotics survey with no biological content (searched); the model descriptions are second-hand and unrelated to genotype.
caveat_zh: 已阅读 arXiv v3 全文。这是具身机器人综述，没有生物学内容（已检索）；其中的模型描述是二手的，与基因型无关。

title: Is Sora a World Simulator? A Comprehensive Survey on General World Models and Beyond
key_claim_en: Survey of world models for video generation, autonomous driving and agents. States that video generation is not synonymous with world models, that generation metrics such as FID and FVD alone cannot reflect predictive rationality, and that inferring unseen decisions (counterfactuals) is a core challenge.
key_claim_zh: 面向视频生成、自动驾驶和智能体的世界模型综述。指出视频生成不等同于世界模型，仅凭 FID 和 FVD 等生成指标无法反映预测的合理性，而推断从未遇到过的决策（反事实）是核心挑战。
so_what_en: Supports separating generation quality from world-model validity: distribution-matching scores on predicted profiles would not test intervention reasoning, so the test battery needs counterfactual checks.
so_what_zh: 支持把生成质量与世界模型有效性区分开：对预测谱的分布匹配分数无法检验干预推理，因此检验清单需要反事实检查。
caveat_en: arXiv v2 (October 2025) full text read; its running header uses the IEEE TPAMI template, which does not show publication. Video and driving focus with no biology (searched).
caveat_zh: 已阅读 arXiv v2（2025 年 10 月）全文；其页眉使用 IEEE TPAMI 模板，这并不表明已发表。侧重视频和驾驶，没有生物学内容（已检索）。

title: A Step Toward World Models: A Survey on Robotic Manipulation
key_claim_en: Robotic-manipulation survey. Notes that the definition of a world model is unsettled but converges on internal representations capturing dynamics and action consequences. Lists 13 candidate capabilities, including interactivity (modeling how actions change future states), counterfactual reasoning, causality and generalization beyond the training distribution.
key_claim_zh: 机器人操作综述。指出世界模型的定义尚无定论，但共识是内部表示应捕捉动力学和动作后果。列出 13 项候选能力，包括交互性（建模动作如何改变未来状态）、反事实推理、因果性以及超出训练分布的泛化。
so_what_en: Ready-made capability checklist for the world-model test battery: action-conditioned interactivity, counterfactual reasoning and causality map onto drug-conditioned and genotype-swap tests.
so_what_zh: 可直接用于世界模型检验清单的能力清单：动作条件的交互性、反事实推理和因果性对应于药物条件检验和基因型互换检验。
caveat_en: arXiv v2 full text read; the authors call it an initial version. Robotics-only survey; the capability list is the authors' proposal, not a validated standard.
caveat_zh: 已阅读 arXiv v2 全文；作者称其为初始版本。仅限机器人的综述；该能力清单是作者的提议，而不是经过验证的标准。

title: Towards building a World Model to simulate perturbation-induced cellular dynamics by AlphaCell
key_claim_en: AlphaCell builds a latent Virtual Cell Space from the full protein-coding transcriptome rather than highly variable genes, decodes it back to genome-wide expression, and models perturbations as deterministic vector fields (optimal-transport conditional flow matching). It claims zero-shot prediction in unseen cellular contexts.
key_claim_zh: AlphaCell 从全部蛋白编码转录组而不是高变基因构建潜在的 Virtual Cell Space，再解码回全基因组表达，并把扰动建模为确定性向量场（最优传输条件流匹配）。它声称能在未见过的细胞背景中做零样本预测。
so_what_en: Candidate transition design: a flow-matching vector field in a genome-wide latent, with compositional and unseen-cellular-context generalization claimed. The abstract gives no numbers, so treat it as a hypothesis.
so_what_zh: 候选的转移设计：全基因组潜空间中的流匹配向量场，并声称具备组合泛化和未见细胞背景的泛化能力。摘要没有给出数字，因此只应视为假设。
caveat_en: Abstract only (bioRxiv version 1, 5 March 2026); full text not retrieved. Claims are the authors' and unquantified in the abstract; the metadata lists no published version.
caveat_zh: 仅有摘要（bioRxiv 第 1 版，2026 年 3 月 5 日）；未获取全文。其主张出自作者，摘要中没有量化；元数据中没有已发表版本。

title: CellOS: Learning a World Model of Cellular State through Joint Embedding Prediction
key_claim_en: CellOS is a 12-billion-parameter multi-view foundation model trained on 390.5 million single-cell transcriptomes, aligning expression and perception views with an LLM-JEPA objective after cell-sentence language modelling and mixture-of-experts expansion; it reports gains over single-cell foundation models, including on perturbation-response prediction (self-reported).
key_claim_zh: CellOS 是一个 12 billion 参数的多视图基础模型，在 390.5 million 个单细胞转录组上训练，先做细胞句子语言建模和混合专家扩展，再用 LLM-JEPA 目标对齐表达视图与感知视图；它自报优于单细胞基础模型，包括在扰动响应预测上。
so_what_en: Scale and recipe reference (12 billion parameters, 390.5 million cells) for a representation-centric cell model; the abstract names no action-conditioned transition, so it does not test the world-model formulation.
so_what_zh: 表示中心的细胞模型的规模与配方参照（12 billion 参数，390.5 million 个细胞）；摘要没有提到动作条件的转移，因此它并未检验世界模型的表述。
caveat_en: Abstract only (Europe PMC record of a bioRxiv preprint); full text not retrieved. Benchmark gains are self-reported and not quantified in the abstract.
caveat_zh: 仅有摘要（Europe PMC 对一篇 bioRxiv 预印本的记录）；未获取全文。基准上的提升为自报，摘要中没有量化。

title: VCWorld: A Biological World Model for Virtual Cell Simulation
key_claim_en: Knowledge-based inference rather than numerical regression: an LLM reasons step by step over retrieved analogue and contrast training cases and a knowledge graph. On GeneTAK (5 cell lines, 348 drugs from Tahoe-100M) it reports average F1 0.63 versus 0.17 for STATE (self-reported).
key_claim_zh: 用基于知识的推断取代数值回归：LLM 在检索到的类比案例、对比案例和知识图谱上逐步推理。在 GeneTAK（来自 Tahoe-100M 的 5 个细胞系、348 种药物）上，它自报平均 F1 为 0.63，而 STATE 为 0.17。
so_what_en: Reusable: gene-level DE and direction labels on Tahoe-100M and text-supplied cell-line mutations. The F1 gap is weak evidence, because baseline outputs were binarized with a rank test.
so_what_zh: 可复用之处：Tahoe-100M 上的基因水平差异表达与方向标签，以及以文本提供的细胞系突变。F1 差距只是弱证据，因为基线输出是用秩检验二值化的。
caveat_en: arXiv v2 (ICLR 2026 header) read in full. All results are self-reported on the authors' own benchmark; VCWorld's AUROC is 0.28 to 0.56 (Table 3) although its F1 and AUPRC lead.
caveat_zh: 已完整阅读 arXiv v2（页眉为 ICLR 2026）。所有结果均为作者在自建基准上的自报；VCWorld 的 AUROC 为 0.28 至 0.56（表 3），尽管其 F1 和 AUPRC 领先。

title: AROMA: Augmented Reasoning Over a Multimodal Architecture for Virtual Cell Genetic Perturbation Modeling
key_claim_en: LLM classifying target-gene response (up, down, not differential) to a gene perturbation in a cell line, using retrieved graph paths, graph encoders and frozen protein-sequence embeddings, trained on PerturbReason (498k+ samples). Average macro-F1 0.73 versus 0.64 for the best baselines (self-reported).
key_claim_zh: 用 LLM 对细胞系中基因扰动后靶基因的响应（上调、下调、无差异）进行分类，利用检索到的图路径、图编码器和冻结的蛋白序列嵌入，并在 PerturbReason（498k+ 个样本）上训练。平均 macro-F1 为 0.73，最佳基线为 0.64（自报）。
so_what_en: Evaluation protocols to copy: unseen-cell-line holdout (RPE1 0.73 versus 0.77 trained) and test-gene stratification by literature popularity and graph degree. Perturbation-as-query cross-attention is a concrete conditioning design.
so_what_zh: 可借鉴的评测协议：留出未见细胞系（RPE1 为 0.73，训练时为 0.77）以及按文献热度和图度数对测试基因分层。以扰动为查询的交叉注意力是一种具体的条件化设计。
caveat_en: arXiv v1 full text read. Self-reported; every result comes from a single run, perturbations are single-gene only, and the model depends on pre-built knowledge graphs.
caveat_zh: 已阅读 arXiv v1 全文。结果为自报；所有结果来自单次运行，扰动仅限单基因，且模型依赖预先构建的知识图谱。

title: Lingshu-Cell: A generative cellular world model for transcriptome modeling toward virtual cells
key_claim_en: Masked discrete diffusion over about 18,000 genes; cell type or donor and perturbation are prepended tokens. On VCC H1 it reports the best average rank, MAE 0.052 and Pearson-Δ 0.306 (self-reported). PBMC test holds out 63 of 90 cytokines in 4 of 12 donors.
key_claim_zh: 在约 18,000 个基因上做掩码离散扩散；细胞类型或供体与扰动作为前置标记输入。在 VCC H1 上，它自报平均排名最佳、MAE 为 0.052、Pearson-Δ 为 0.306。PBMC 测试在 12 个供体中的 4 个上留出 90 种细胞因子中的 63 种。
so_what_en: Template for conditioning a generative model on cell type or donor plus perturbation via prepended tokens. The PBMC test holds out cytokines within donors, so unseen-donor generalization is not shown.
so_what_zh: 通过前置标记让生成模型以身份（细胞类型或供体）和扰动为条件的模板。PBMC 测试是在供体内部留出细胞因子，因此没有展示对未见供体的泛化。
caveat_en: arXiv v1 full text read. Results are self-reported and Table 2 extracts garbled; only figures stated in the prose were used. Authors state that distribution fidelity does not imply causal mechanism.
caveat_zh: 已阅读 arXiv v1 全文。结果为自报，且表 2 的文本提取已乱码；只使用了正文中明确给出的数字。作者指出分布层面的保真度并不意味着因果机制。

title: GeneJepa: A Predictive World Model of the Transcriptome
key_claim_en: Predicts latent representations of masked gene sets from visible context (JEPA), using a Perceiver encoder for variable gene sets and a Fourier-feature tokenizer for continuous expression; trained on Tahoe-100M. Claims gains on drug-response and perturbation prediction and test-time scaling by enlarging cross-attention (self-reported).
key_claim_zh: 从可见上下文预测被掩码基因集的潜在表示（JEPA），用 Perceiver 编码器处理可变基因集，用 Fourier 特征标记器表示连续表达量；在 Tahoe-100M 上训练。自报在药物响应和扰动预测上有提升，并可通过扩大交叉注意力实现测试时扩展。
so_what_en: Candidate objective for the state encoder: latent prediction of masked gene sets, trained on the Tahoe-100M atlas. It is a representation model with no stated action-conditioned transition.
so_what_zh: 状态编码器的候选目标：对被掩码基因集做潜在预测，在 Tahoe-100M 图谱上训练。它是表示模型，没有说明动作条件的转移。
caveat_en: Abstract only (bioRxiv version 1, 15 October 2025); full text not retrieved. Gains over baselines are the authors' claims, with no numbers or named baselines in the abstract.
caveat_zh: 仅有摘要（bioRxiv 第 1 版，2025 年 10 月 15 日）；未获取全文。相对基线的提升是作者的主张，摘要中没有数字，也没有点名基线。

title: Cell-JEPA: Latent Representation Learning for Single-Cell Transcriptomics
key_claim_en: Adds a JEPA cosine loss on EMA-teacher cell embeddings to scGPT reconstruction. Zero-shot PBMC clustering AvgBIO 0.72 versus 0.53; on unseen single-gene perturbations, Norman pearson rises 0.631 to 0.787 but delta Pearson falls 0.103 to 0.059 (self-reported).
key_claim_zh: 在 scGPT 的重建损失之外，加入针对 EMA 教师细胞嵌入的 JEPA 余弦损失。零样本 PBMC 聚类的 AvgBIO 为 0.72，对照为 0.53；在未见单基因扰动上，Norman 的 pearson 从 0.631 升到 0.787，但 delta Pearson 从 0.103 降到 0.059（自报）。
so_what_en: A direct warning on metric choice: absolute-state Pearson can improve while delta (change-from-control) Pearson drops, so genotype-by-drug effects must be scored on deltas against the right reference.
so_what_zh: 对指标选择的直接警示：绝对状态 Pearson 可以上升，而 delta（相对对照的变化）Pearson 却下降，因此基因型与药物的交互效应必须在合适参照下按 delta 评分。
caveat_en: arXiv v1 full text read. Self-reported; perturbation tests use one cell line (K562) and no mean or additive baseline, and the authors call them preliminary.
caveat_zh: 已阅读 arXiv v1 全文。结果为自报；扰动测试只用了一个细胞系（K562），没有均值或加性基线，作者称其为初步探索。

title: BioM-JEPA: joint-embedding prediction of graph-connected gene blocks in single cells
key_claim_en: Student-teacher JEPA predicting aggregate teacher representations of graph-connected gene blocks, with no gene-level reconstruction. Frozen embeddings reach MSE-LFC 10.31 versus 10.87–10.98 for four foundation models; all 80 Norman double-perturbation displacements align with the additive single-perturbation sum more than random pairs (self-reported).
key_claim_zh: 师生式 JEPA 预测由图连接的基因块的聚合教师表示，不做基因层面的重建。冻结嵌入的 MSE-LFC 为 10.31，而四个基础模型为 10.87–10.98；Norman 的全部 80 个双扰动位移与单扰动位移之和的一致性都高于随机配对（自报）。
so_what_en: Additivity in embedding space is a cheap composition check, though its null is random pairs. The 10.31 versus 10.87 gap is small and no mean or additive baseline was compared.
so_what_zh: 嵌入空间中的可加性是一种廉价的组合检验，但其零假设是随机配对。10.31 与 10.87 的差距很小，且没有与均值或加性基线比较。
caveat_en: arXiv v1 full text read. Self-reported; scVI led on Norman combinations, and study-level overlap between pretraining data and CellBench cannot be excluded.
caveat_zh: 已阅读 arXiv v1 全文。结果为自报；在 Norman 组合扰动上 scVI 领先，且无法排除预训练数据与 CellBench 在研究层面的重叠。

title: JEPA-DNA: Grounding Genomic Foundation Models through Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures
key_claim_en: JEPA latent-prediction loss added to MLM or NTP continual pretraining of DNA models: mean linear-probe AUROC gains of 2.19% to 3.29% across three backbones on 9 tasks (self-reported). Zero-shot variant ranking by reference-versus-variant embedding similarity is mostly AUROC 0.503 to 0.574.
key_claim_zh: 在 DNA 模型的 MLM 或 NTP 持续预训练中加入 JEPA 潜在预测损失：三种骨干在 9 个任务上的线性探针 AUROC 平均提升 2.19% 至 3.29%（自报）。按参考序列与变异序列嵌入相似度做零样本变异排序，多数任务的 AUROC 仅为 0.503 至 0.574。
so_what_en: A sequence-side objective for variant encoders: gains concentrate on regulatory tasks such as meQTL and causal eQTL, but zero-shot reference-versus-variant similarity is weak, so variant input needs supervised probing.
so_what_zh: 面向变异编码器的序列端目标：提升集中在 meQTL 和因果 eQTL 等调控任务上，但参考序列与变异序列的零样本相似度较弱，因此变异输入需要有监督的探针。
caveat_en: arXiv v4 (15 October 2026) read in full; earlier versions were not compared. Self-reported; probes are frozen linear heads, and the main zero-shot table covers only the DNABERT-2 backbone.
caveat_zh: 已完整阅读 arXiv v4（2026 年 10 月 15 日）；未与早期版本比较。结果为自报；探针是冻结的线性头，主要的零样本表只涵盖 DNABERT-2 骨干。

title: JEPA-Anything: Learning Predictive Models across Different Worlds
key_claim_en: peripheral
key_claim_zh: 外围条目
so_what_en: NA
so_what_zh: NA
caveat_en: Retired 2026-10-16 (R1): marked peripheral in iteration 1 and never cited.
caveat_zh: 已于 2026-10-16 退役（R1）：在第 1 轮中被标为边缘，且从未被引用。

title: A world model of the virtual cell
key_claim_en: Cell review: a virtual cell world model keeps a persistent cellular state and simulates its evolution under genetic, chemical and environmental interventions, supporting action-conditioned simulation, counterfactual reasoning and long-horizon planning; it outlines architecture, data, training and evaluation principles.
key_claim_zh: Cell 上的综述：虚拟细胞世界模型保持持久的细胞状态，并模拟其在遗传、化学和环境干预下的演化，支持动作条件模拟、反事实推理和长程规划；文中概述了架构、数据、训练和评测原则。
so_what_en: Journal-published statement of the working definition: persistent state plus intervention-driven evolution, contrasted with endpoint predictors. The formal encoder-transition-decoder form is not in the abstract; WM17 holds it.
so_what_zh: 期刊发表的工作定义表述：持久状态加由干预驱动的演化，与终点预测器相对照。正式的编码器-转移-解码器形式不在摘要中；WM17 中有该形式。
caveat_en: Abstract only (Europe PMC record); the Cell page was not read and its link to the record rests on the title. Probably the published form of the GenBio text WM17; not confirmed.
caveat_zh: 仅有摘要（Europe PMC 记录）；未阅读 Cell 页面，且它与该记录的对应关系仅凭标题。很可能是 GenBio 文本 WM17 的正式发表版本，但未得到确认。

title: A World Model of the Virtual Cell
key_claim_en: Perspective: virtual cell world model = encoder, action-conditioned transition z' = F(z, a) and decoder; genetic edits modify nodes or edges of a biological network, molecular inputs add nodes. Proposes evaluation on unseen and combinatorial perturbations, multi-step rollouts and inverse control.
key_claim_zh: 观点文章：虚拟细胞世界模型 = 编码器、动作条件的转移 z' = F(z, a) 和解码器；遗传编辑修改生物网络的节点或边，分子输入则增加节点。提出在未见和组合扰动、多步展开以及逆向控制上进行评测。
so_what_en: Gives an action scheme for genetic edits and drugs and a test battery including inverse control; no experiments are reported, so it specifies requirements, not evidence.
so_what_zh: 给出了针对遗传编辑和药物的动作方案以及包含逆向控制的检验清单；文中没有实验，因此它规定的是要求，而不是证据。
caveat_en: Company-hosted PDF dated 3 May 2026, read in full; a perspective with no experiments or data. The Cell article (WM16) may be its published form, which was not read.
caveat_zh: 公司托管的 PDF，日期为 2026 年 5 月 3 日，已完整阅读；这是没有实验或数据的观点文章。Cell 文章（WM16）可能是其正式发表版本，但未阅读。

title: Towards World Models in Biomedical Research
key_claim_en: Perspective proposing biomedical world models: latent molecular-to-clinical states with intervention-conditioned dynamics, used as data engines, environment simulators and planning substrates for virtual cells, organoids and virtual patients; data, benchmark, safety and governance needs are outlined.
key_claim_zh: 提出生物医学世界模型的观点文章：学习从分子到临床的潜在状态及干预条件的动力学，用作虚拟细胞、类器官和虚拟患者的数据引擎、环境模拟器和规划基底；文中概述了数据、基准、安全和治理方面的需求。
so_what_en: Restates the state-action-dynamics framing across scales; a model-written overview (secondary) stresses counterfactual validity as the missing benchmark. Overlap with WM17 and WM02 cannot be judged without the paper.
so_what_zh: 在不同尺度上重述状态、动作与动力学的框架；模型生成的概述（二手）强调反事实有效性是缺失的基准。没有论文全文，无法判断其与 WM17 和 WM02 的重叠程度。
caveat_en: alphaXiv page read: verbatim abstract plus a model-written overview; the paper itself was not read. Page metadata dates it 26 August 2026; the arXiv number suggests June 2026.
caveat_zh: 已阅读 alphaXiv 页面：包含摘要原文和模型生成的概述；未阅读论文本身。页面元数据标注日期为 2026 年 8 月 26 日；arXiv 编号提示为 2026 年 6 月。

title: VCLMU: Mechanism-Centric Virtual Cell World Modeling for Perturbation Response
key_claim_en: World model: the control cell becomes a sparse set of Latent Mechanism Units, the perturbation acts on each unit through residual stochastic transitions, and a decoder gives per-gene mean and variance. Best Jaccard@20 on six benchmarks (self-reported); 86.6% of 1,101 held-out perturbations match an LMU.
key_claim_zh: 单步世界模型：对照细胞被表示为稀疏的潜在机制单元集合，扰动通过残差随机转移作用于每个单元，解码器给出每个基因的均值与方差。在六个基准上 Jaccard@20 最佳（自报）；1,101 个留出扰动中有 86.6% 与某个 LMU 相匹配。
so_what_en: Design for letting one drug or variant move some programs and not others, with stochastic transitions. Margins over the included Perturbed Mean baseline are small on Adamson and Norman.
so_what_zh: 让同一药物或变异推动某些程序而不影响其他程序的设计，并带有随机转移。在 Adamson 和 Norman 上，相对所含 Perturbed Mean 基线的优势很小。
caveat_en: arXiv v1 workshop paper read in full. Self-reported; Jaccard and delta-Pearson results appear only in figures, and perturbations are single-gene only.
caveat_zh: 已完整阅读 arXiv v1 研讨会论文。结果为自报；Jaccard 和 delta Pearson 的结果只出现在图中，且扰动仅限单基因。

title: Chreode: A Cell World Model for One-Step Temporal Dynamics and Perturbation Prediction
key_claim_en: One-step action-conditioned residual transition (downhill potential gradient, antisymmetric flow, stochastic spread) pretrained on a 2.4M-cell mouse embryonic atlas. Swapping its representation into GEARS lowers Norman DE20 MSE from 0.2121 to 0.1858, a 12.4% relative gain (self-reported).
key_claim_zh: 一步式动作条件残差转移（下坡势梯度、反对称流、随机扩散），在 2.4M 个细胞的小鼠胚胎图谱上预训练。把其表示换入 GEARS 后，Norman 的 DE20 MSE 从 0.2121 降到 0.1858，相对提升 12.4%（自报）。
so_what_en: Shows a dynamics-pretrained embedding can help perturbation prediction, but only inside GEARS on one dataset; the perturbation arm is not a standalone transition model.
so_what_zh: 表明经动力学预训练的嵌入可能有助于扰动预测，但仅限于在一个数据集上嵌入 GEARS；扰动部分并不是独立的转移模型。
caveat_en: arXiv v1 read in full. Self-reported; pretraining is a single seed, no uncertainty is reported, and no mean baseline is named for the Norman test.
caveat_zh: 已完整阅读 arXiv v1。结果为自报；预训练只用单个种子，没有报告不确定性，Norman 测试中也未列出均值基线。

title: What Makes a Virtual Cell a World Model? Three Gaps, Three Experiments, and a Roadmap
key_claim_en: Preprint defining a virtual cell world model as a maintained cellular state with context, an intervention-conditioned transition and time-varying structure. It names three gaps (representation is not dynamics, prediction is not intervention, multimodality is not multiscale) and three diagnostic axes with L0 to L3 ladders.
key_claim_zh: 预印本把虚拟细胞世界模型定义为带有背景的持续细胞状态、干预条件的转移和随时间变化的结构。它指出三个缺口（表征不等于动力学、预测不等于干预、多模态不等于多尺度）和三个带 L0 至 L3 等级的诊断轴。
so_what_en: Source of a graded test ladder (dynamics, intervention, scale) for the world-model label; the motivating experiments are qualitative in the abstract.
so_what_zh: 为“世界模型”标签提供分级检验阶梯（动力学、干预、尺度）的来源；摘要中的动机实验是定性的。
caveat_en: Abstract only, from the Europe PMC record of a Research Square preprint; the ResearchGate page returned 403 and the full text was not read.
caveat_zh: 仅有摘要，来自 Europe PMC 对 Research Square 预印本的记录；ResearchGate 页面返回 403，未阅读全文。

title: Immune World Model
key_claim_en: Action-conditioned multi-cell latent-dynamics world model; the action vector covers gene KO, drug, cytokine dose and neighbour summary, with KO encoded through gene features. On a synthetic toy, OOD-gene Pearson on delta is 0.915 versus ridge 0.664 (self-reported).
key_claim_zh: 动作条件化的多细胞潜空间动力学世界模型；动作向量包含基因敲除、药物、细胞因子剂量和邻居摘要，其中敲除通过基因特征编码。在合成玩具数据上，OOD-gene 的 delta Pearson 为 0.915，岭回归为 0.664（自报）。
so_what_en: Feature-based action encoding reaches unseen perturbations, a pattern for unseen variants; but ridge beat it on the other three splits (OOD-temporal 0.719 versus 0.677), so report every split.
so_what_zh: 基于特征的动作编码可覆盖未见过的扰动，可作为处理未见变异的参考模式；但岭回归在其余三个划分上更优（OOD-temporal 为 0.719 对 0.677），因此应报告全部划分。
caveat_en: README and clone read; all numbers self-reported on a synthetic toy with no real-data result. MIT declared in pyproject.toml but no LICENSE file. The README's 'four OOD splits' are IID plus three OOD splits.
caveat_zh: 已读 README 与克隆仓库；所有数字均为自报，来自合成玩具数据，没有真实数据结果。pyproject.toml 声明 MIT 但没有 LICENSE 文件。README 所说的“四个 OOD 划分”实为 IID 加三个 OOD 划分。

title: CellFluxRL: Biologically-Constrained Virtual Cell Modeling via Reinforcement Learning
key_claim_en: RL post-training of the image-based perturbation model CellFlux on BBBC021 (about 98K images, 26 perturbation conditions) with seven non-differentiable biological rewards; MoA accuracy rises from 0.61 to 0.66, and held-out CLIP and DINOv2 MoA classifiers also improve (0.45 to 0.52; 0.34 to 0.40).
key_claim_zh: 对基于图像的扰动模型 CellFlux 做强化学习后训练，使用七个不可微的生物学奖励，数据为 BBBC021（约 98K 张图像、26 种扰动条件）；MoA 准确率由 0.61 升至 0.66，留出的 CLIP 与 DINOv2 MoA 分类器得分也上升（0.45 至 0.52；0.34 至 0.40）。
so_what_en: Template for guided inverse design: verifier rewards used for post-training and best-of-N selection, with held-out evaluators to detect reward hacking. Image domain only, no transcriptome or genotype.
so_what_zh: 可作为引导式逆向设计的模板：用验证器奖励做后训练和 best-of-N 选择，并以留出的评估器检测奖励投机。仅限图像领域，没有转录组或基因型数据。
caveat_en: Preprint v4 read; gains are self-reported. The text's overall reward (−4.44 to −1.54) does not match the Table 1 overall row as extracted (−2.44 to 0.46).
caveat_zh: 已读预印本 v4；提升均为自报。正文中的总体奖励（−4.44 至 −1.54）与提取出的表 1 总体行（−2.44 至 0.46）不一致。

title: How to build the virtual cell with artificial intelligence: Priorities and opportunities
key_claim_en: Perspective proposing a virtual cell whose Manipulator networks map a cell representation to a perturbed one, conditioned on genetic or chemical perturbations; confidence estimates would steer active learning and lab-in-the-loop experiments, and evaluation should test unseen cell types and genetic backgrounds.
key_claim_zh: 提出虚拟细胞愿景的观点文章：Manipulator 网络把细胞表示映射为受扰动后的表示，可以基因或化学扰动为条件；置信度估计将引导主动学习和 lab-in-the-loop 实验，评估应检验未见细胞类型和未见遗传背景。
so_what_en: Conceptual design checklist for the predictor: perturbation-conditioned transitions, uncertainty that drives experiment choice, and held-out genetic backgrounds as the generalization test; no effect-size anchors.
so_what_zh: 为预测器提供概念性设计清单：以扰动为条件的状态转移、驱动实验选择的不确定性，以及以留出的遗传背景作为泛化检验；没有效应量锚点。
caveat_en: arXiv v2 (14 Oct 2024) read, not the Cell version; differences unknown. Two-column PDF extraction interleaves some lines. Perspective article, so claims are proposals, not results.
caveat_zh: 已读 arXiv v2（2024 年 10 月 14 日），未读 Cell 正式版，差异未知；双栏 PDF 提取使部分行交错。属于观点性文章，所以其主张是提议而非结果。

title: Grow AI virtual cells: three data pillars and closed-loop learning
key_claim_en: Short editorial: AI virtual cells need three data pillars (prior knowledge, static architecture, dynamic states), with perturbation omics as the critical data; proposes closed-loop active learning where model uncertainty selects perturbations (CRISPR knockouts, small molecules) for robotic experiments, starting with yeast.
key_claim_zh: 短篇社论：AI 虚拟细胞需要三类数据支柱（先验知识、静态结构、动态状态），其中扰动组学数据最关键；提出闭环主动学习，由模型不确定性挑选扰动（CRISPR 敲除、小分子）供机器人实验，并建议从酵母起步。
so_what_en: Argues for picking perturbations by potential to reduce model uncertainty, to cover the combinatorial response space; opinion only, no data, so motivation for an acquisition step, not evidence.
so_what_zh: 主张按降低模型不确定性的潜力挑选扰动，以覆盖组合式响应空间；仅为观点、没有数据，因此只能作为采集步骤的动机，而非证据。
caveat_en: Journal page read in full. Short editorial with no data or benchmarks; the pilot study it cites on perturbation proteomics was not examined.
caveat_zh: 已完整阅读期刊页面。属于短篇社论，没有数据或基准；其引用的扰动蛋白质组学先导研究未经核查。

title: Large Language Models Meet Virtual Cell: A Survey
key_claim_en: Survey of LLMs for virtual cells: LLMs as Oracles (sequence and omics models) versus LLMs as Agents (experiment planning, workflow automation), covering three tasks (cell representation, perturbation prediction, gene regulation); perturbation benchmarks named are Adamson, Norman and Systema.
key_claim_zh: 关于大语言模型与虚拟细胞的综述：LLM 作为 Oracle（序列与组学模型）与作为 Agent（实验规划、流程自动化）两种范式，覆盖细胞表征、扰动预测、基因调控三类任务；点名的扰动基准为 Adamson、Norman 和 Systema。
so_what_en: Names reverse perturbation as a task and indexes experiment-planning agents (PerTurboAgent, BioDiscoveryAgent) relevant to guided design; perturbation modeling itself gets little depth.
so_what_zh: 把反向扰动列为任务，并索引了规划扰动实验的智能体（PerTurboAgent、BioDiscoveryAgent），与引导式设计相关；扰动建模本身着墨不深。
caveat_en: arXiv v1 read in full; survey without original results, and cellular imaging is not covered extensively.
caveat_zh: 已完整阅读 arXiv v1；这是没有原创结果的综述，且未广泛涵盖细胞成像。

title: Generative inverse design steers human hematopoietic cell fate in vitro
key_claim_en: LabCompass: flow-matching generative model, guided by a forward surrogate predicting cell phenotypes, proposes culture designs (continuous cytokine and small-molecule parameters) toward target cell states in primary CD34+ cells; four lab-in-the-loop rounds yielded a 78-million-cell spectral flow cytometry dataset (self-reported).
key_claim_zh: LabCompass：由预测细胞表型的正向代理模型引导的 flow-matching 生成模型，针对原代 CD34+ 细胞提出朝目标细胞状态的培养设计（连续的细胞因子与小分子参数）；四轮 lab-in-the-loop 产生了 7800 万（78 million）个细胞的光谱流式细胞术数据集（自报）。
so_what_en: Template for guided inverse design with lab-in-the-loop updates; argues virtual cells should be judged by how well they guide experiments. Flow-cytometry readout, no genotype structure in the abstract.
so_what_zh: 引导式逆向设计与 lab-in-the-loop 更新的范本；主张虚拟细胞应以其引导实验的效果来评判。读出为流式细胞术，摘要中没有基因型结构。
caveat_en: Abstract only (bioRxiv metadata); full text not read. Preprint v1 posted 2026-10-09, no peer-reviewed version indicated in the metadata; all results are the authors' own claims.
caveat_zh: 仅读摘要（bioRxiv 元数据），未读全文。预印本 v1 于 2026-10-09 发布，元数据未显示同行评议版本；所有结果均为作者自己的主张。

title: theislab/LabCompass (GitHub)
key_claim_en: Conditional flow-matching forward model (control to perturbed cell states; drug, genetic-edit, dose and time covariates, one encoder per covariate representation) with two inverse routes: covariate optimization (MAP, Langevin, amortized; optional log-prior) and training-free loss or KKT-constrained guidance of a pretrained flow.
key_claim_zh: 条件 flow-matching 正向模型（从对照到扰动后细胞状态；药物、基因编辑、剂量和时间协变量，每种协变量表示一个编码器），带两条逆向路线：协变量优化（MAP、Langevin、摊销式；可选 log-prior）以及对预训练 flow 的免训练损失引导或 KKT 约束引导。
so_what_en: Guidance steers a one-step endpoint estimate; its KKT variant treats a constraint as active only within 1e-6 of its boundary, so met or violated constraints get no multiplier (code read).
so_what_zh: 引导作用于一步终点估计；其 KKT 变体只在约束位于边界 1e-6 以内时才视其为活动约束，因此已满足或被违反的约束都得不到乘子（已读代码）。
caveat_en: Shallow clone read (README, LICENSE first 25 lines, pyproject.toml, inverse-model code); tests not read. BSD-3, version 0.0.1, synthetic README example, no genotype handling; train_inverse_model builds its validation loader from the training data.
caveat_zh: 已读浅克隆（README、LICENSE 前 25 行、pyproject.toml、逆向模型代码）；测试未读。BSD-3，版本 0.0.1，README 示例为合成数据，没有基因型处理；train_inverse_model 用训练数据构建其验证加载器。

title: theislab/LabCompass-reproducibility (GitHub)
key_claim_en: LabCompass pipeline on spectral flow cytometry: conditional flow-matching forward model, cell-type classifier, flow-matching protocol prior, loss-guided inverse design (default 350 forward passes per candidate), noise-draw uncertainty re-scoring; models train on cumulative loop data. Data: about 60 GB, 13 GB inference-only checkpoints, 1.07 M unfiltered designs.
key_claim_zh: LabCompass 在光谱流式细胞术上的流程：条件流匹配前向模型、细胞类型分类器、流匹配方案先验、损失引导的逆向设计（默认每个候选 350 次前向传播）、噪声抽样不确定性重新打分；模型在累积的各轮数据上训练。数据：约 60 GB、13 GB 仅推理检查点、1.07 M 个未过滤设计。
so_what_en: Re-scoring earlier candidates under later loops' checkpoints quantifies each loop's uncertainty reduction. Protocol priors cannot be retrained from the published checkpoints.
so_what_zh: 在后续轮次的检查点下对更早的候选重新打分，可量化每一轮对不确定性的降低。方案先验无法从已发布的检查点重新训练。
caveat_en: README and clone read, nothing run; Hugging Face files not inspected. Eight chained loop datasets (loop 0 is baseline) versus four loops in the WM27 abstract. BSD 2-Clause.
caveat_zh: 已读 README 与克隆仓库，未运行任何代码；未查看 Hugging Face 上的文件。链式共有八个循环数据集（loop 0 为基线），而 WM27 摘要为四个循环。BSD 2-Clause。

title: Fabian Theis on X: post about presenting LabCompass at SCG 2026
key_claim_en: Post by Fabian Theis on 2026-09-18 after presenting LabCompass at SCG 2026: a generative inverse design approach using cellular world models not only to predict biology but to help decide the next experiment; no data, methods or results in the post.
key_claim_zh: Fabian Theis 于 2026-09-18 在 X 上发帖，称其在 SCG 2026 上介绍了 LabCompass：一种生成式逆向设计方法，用细胞世界模型不仅预测生物学，也帮助决定下一步做什么实验；帖子中没有数据、方法或结果。
so_what_en: Shows the method was presented publicly the day before this 2026-09-18 post; frames a world model as a decision aid for choosing experiments, a framing and not evidence.
so_what_zh: 表明该方法在这条 2026-09-18 的帖子前一天已公开报告；把世界模型定位为挑选实验的决策辅助，这只是一种表述，不是证据。
caveat_en: Social post read in full (secondary source); announcement only, with no data, methods or results; the post is the author's own framing.
caveat_zh: 已完整阅读该社交媒体帖子（二手来源）；仅为公告，没有数据、方法或结果；内容是作者自己的表述。

title: LinkedIn post about LabCompass (seen only through search summaries; author attribution unverified)
key_claim_en: NA
key_claim_zh: NA
so_what_en: NA
so_what_zh: NA
