Retired 2026-10-17 (R7): The URL is a profile page rather than the post and nothing could be read; the viral-infection scRNA-seq application is stated by WM32.
caveat_zh: 二手或非同行评议来源（T3 级），只通过检索工具的摘要或摘录见到。 作者归属未核实，且各摘要相互矛盾。 已于 2026-10-17 退役（R7）：该 URL 是个人主页而不是帖子，无法读取任何内容；病毒感染 scRNA-seq 应用已由 WM32 陈述。

title: Weekly reads 5/10/26 (Behind the Bioinformatics newsletter)
key_claim_en: Blog summary of the preprint: design prior plus differentiable surrogate steers generation to a target cell state, no retraining for new targets; 116-condition training screen (10 cytokines or small molecules, hypoxia versus normoxia), 20-color spectral flow cytometry; scRNA-seq on HCMV infection also shown.
key_claim_zh: 对预印本的博客式综述：设计先验加可微代理模型引导生成朝向目标细胞状态，更换新目标无需重新训练；训练用 116 个条件的筛选（10 种细胞因子或小分子，缺氧对常氧），20 色光谱流式细胞术；还展示了 HCMV 感染的 scRNA-seq。
so_what_en: Adds design-space size, readout and a scRNA-seq demonstration beyond the preprint abstract (WM27); uncertainty reportedly fell with each round, up to 66% on held-out conditions. All second-hand.
so_what_zh: 在预印本摘要（WM27）之外补充了设计空间规模、读出方式和一个 scRNA-seq 演示；据称每一轮不确定性都下降，对留出条件最多下降 66%。以上均为二手信息。
caveat_en: Blog page read in full; secondary source relaying the preprint, whose full text was not read here, so 116 conditions, 20-color and 66% are unchecked. Blogger calls wins enrichment-level and lineage-limited.
caveat_zh: 已完整阅读博客页面；这是转述预印本的二手来源，而此处未读预印本全文，因此 116 个条件、20 色和 66% 均未核对。博主称成果仅限于富集水平且局限于特定谱系。

title: Predicting how perturbations reshape cellular trajectories with PerturbGen
key_claim_en: PerturbGen: generative foundation model on over 100 million single-cell transcriptomes predicting how a genetic perturbation at a source state reshapes downstream states; in hematopoiesis, perturbation programs anchored to human genetics simulate monogenic blood disorders; a Wnt prediction in skin organoids was validated (self-reported).
key_claim_zh: PerturbGen：在超过 100 million 个单细胞转录组上训练的生成式基础模型，预测源状态的基因扰动如何重塑下游状态；在造血中，将扰动程序锚定到人类遗传学以模拟单基因血液疾病；其对皮肤类器官中 Wnt 作用的预测得到实验验证（自报）。
so_what_en: Genetics-to-perturbation bridge: gene-level perturbation programs mapped to monogenic disease, and early-perturbation to later-state prediction along differentiation. Abstract only; architecture, genotype handling and metrics are not visible.
so_what_zh: 遗传学到扰动的桥梁：基因层面的扰动程序对应单基因疾病，以及沿分化轨迹由早期扰动预测后期状态。仅有摘要；架构、基因型处理和指标均不可见。
caveat_en: Abstract only (bioRxiv metadata); full text not read. Preprint v1 posted 2026-03-05 with no published version listed; training scale, validation and all results are the authors' own claims.
caveat_zh: 仅读摘要（bioRxiv 元数据），未读全文。预印本 v1 于 2026-03-05 发布，元数据中未列出正式发表版本；训练规模、验证和所有结果均为作者自己的主张。

title: ARTEMIS integrates autoencoders and Schrödinger Bridges to predict continuous dynamics of gene expression, cell population, and perturbation from time-series single-cell data
key_claim_en: VAE plus unbalanced diffusion Schrödinger bridge with a kill-rate network for cell birth and death, on three public scRNA-seq time courses. Lowest held-out Wasserstein distance versus scNODE, MIOFlow and PRESCIENT in 4 of 6 settings; in silico perturbations edit gene expression at one timepoint (self-reported).
key_claim_zh: 变分自编码器加非平衡扩散 Schrödinger 桥，并用 kill-rate 网络刻画细胞出生与死亡，在三个公开 scRNA-seq 时间序列数据集上测试。与 scNODE、MIOFlow 和 PRESCIENT 相比，在 6 个设置中有 4 个的留出时间点 Wasserstein 距离最低；in silico 扰动只在某一个时间点修改基因表达（自报）。
so_what_en: Population change is fitted to per-timepoint cell counts and perturbations are post hoc state edits without experimental ground truth: useful for bridge-based dynamics, not for perturbation conditioning.
so_what_zh: 群体变化是对各时间点细胞计数拟合出来的，而扰动是事后的状态编辑，没有实验真值：适用于基于桥的动力学，不适用于扰动条件化。
caveat_en: Published Bioinformatics version read via Europe PMC (supplement not on disk); preprint read only as its near-identical abstract. Text claims superiority at both pancreatic timepoints, but Table 2 shows scNODE lower at t=3.
caveat_zh: 已读 Bioinformatics 正式版（经 Europe PMC，补充材料不在磁盘上）；预印本仅读了近乎相同的摘要。正文称在胰腺两个时间点上均更优，但表 2 显示 t=3 时 scNODE 更低。

title: Reinforcement learning enables single-cell foundation models to learn cellular differentiation
key_claim_en: DiRL: reinforcement-learning agents plan multi-step perturbations inside a single-cell foundation model treated as the environment, with differentiation cast as a goal-conditioned decision problem; on iPSC-derived organoid data it beats random perturbation baselines with a 69% win rate, and performance scales with planning horizon (self-reported).
key_claim_zh: DiRL：强化学习智能体在被当作环境的单细胞基础模型内规划多步扰动，把分化表述为目标条件化的决策问题；在 iPSC 来源的类器官数据上，以 69% 的胜率优于随机扰动基线，且性能随规划视野扩大而提升（自报）。
so_what_en: Precedent for planning inside a foundation-model simulator; the abstract names only random-perturbation baselines and no wet-lab test, so policy reliability rests on the simulator.
so_what_zh: 为在基础模型模拟器内部做规划提供先例；摘要只提到随机扰动基线，且没有湿实验检验，因此策略的可靠性取决于模拟器。
caveat_en: Abstract only (bioRxiv metadata); full text not read. Preprint v1 posted 2025-12-12 with no published version listed; the 69% win rate and its baselines are the authors' own claims, definitions not visible.
caveat_zh: 仅读摘要（bioRxiv 元数据），未读全文。预印本 v1 于 2025-12-12 发布，元数据中未列出正式发表版本；69% 的胜率及其基线均为作者自己的主张，定义不可见。

title: scDiffEq: drift-diffusion modeling of single-cell dynamics with neural stochastic differential equations
key_claim_en: scDiffEq: generative neural SDE learning drift and diffusion (prior solutions keep diffusion constant), fitted to lineage-traced single-cell data and extended to single-time-point data; improves trajectory reconstruction and fate prediction in hematopoiesis; in silico perturbations of progenitors recapitulate CRISPR-perturbed hematopoiesis (self-reported).
key_claim_zh: scDiffEq：生成式神经 SDE，同时学习漂移与扩散（已有方案把扩散设为常数），拟合带谱系追踪的单细胞数据，并扩展到单时间点数据；在造血中改进了轨迹重建与命运预测；对祖细胞施加的 in silico 扰动再现了 CRISPR 扰动造血的动态（自报）。
so_what_en: Perturbation enters as an in silico edit of progenitor states, checked against CRISPR data in one lineage-traced system; the abstract does not describe the intervention operator.
so_what_zh: 扰动是对祖细胞状态的 in silico 编辑，并在一个谱系追踪体系中与 CRISPR 数据对照；摘要没有描述干预算子。
caveat_en: Abstract only (bioRxiv metadata); full text not read. Row URL is v1 (2023); metadata lists version 2 dated 2025-01-24; no published version listed. All results are the authors' own claims.
caveat_zh: 仅读摘要（bioRxiv 元数据），未读全文。行内 URL 是 v1（2023）；元数据列出的是 2025-01-24 的版本 2；未列出正式发表版本。所有结果均为作者自己的主张。

title: Generative modeling of single-cell time series with PRESCIENT enables prediction of cell trajectories with interventions
key_claim_en: Neural potential landscape on PCA-projected scRNA-seq: drift is the negative potential gradient, trained with a regularized Wasserstein loss and proliferation weights. In silico perturbation sets target-gene z-scores, projects to PCA and simulates forward; known fate regulators recovered in hematopoiesis and pancreatic differentiation (self-reported).
key_claim_zh: 在 PCA 投影的 scRNA-seq 上学习神经势能景观：漂移为势能的负梯度，用正则化 Wasserstein 损失和增殖权重训练。in silico 扰动先设定目标基因的 z-score，投影到 PCA 后向前模拟；在造血和胰腺分化中复现了已知的命运调控因子（自报）。
so_what_en: Anchor: proliferation weighting lifts fate-bias correlation from r = 0.196 to 0.347 (upper bound 0.487). Perturbation checks are expected-direction shifts against known regulators, not measured perturbation outcomes.
so_what_zh: 定量锚点：增殖加权使命运偏向相关性由 r = 0.196 升至 0.347（上限 0.487）。扰动检验只是相对已知调控因子的预期方向变化，而非实测的扰动结果。
caveat_en: Published Nature Communications 2021 version read via Europe PMC text; all performance numbers are self-reported on one lineage-tracing hematopoiesis dataset. Model assumes the final timepoint is at steady state, and PCA loses gene-level information.
caveat_zh: 已读 2021 年发表于 Nature Communications 的版本（经 Europe PMC 全文）；所有性能数字均为自报，仅来自一个谱系追踪造血数据集。模型假设最后一个时间点处于稳态，且 PCA 丢失基因层面的信息。

title: V-JEPA 2: Self-Supervised Video Models Enable Understanding, Prediction and Planning
key_claim_en: V-JEPA 2-AC: a latent action-conditioned world model post-trained on under 62 hours of unlabeled Droid robot video; plans by minimizing a goal-conditioned latent energy with the cross-entropy method in a model-predictive loop; deployed zero-shot on Franka arms in two labs (self-reported).
key_claim_zh: V-JEPA 2-AC：在少于 62 小时的无标签 Droid 机器人视频上后训练的潜空间动作条件世界模型；在模型预测控制回路中用交叉熵方法最小化以目标为条件的潜空间能量来规划；零样本部署于两个实验室的 Franka 机械臂（自报）。
so_what_en: Sampling-based planning in a learned latent space needs no differentiable objective, an alternative to gradient guidance when the readout is not differentiable.
so_what_zh: 在学得的潜空间中做基于采样的规划不需要可微目标，当读出不可微时可替代梯度引导。
caveat_en: Robot-control preprint (arXiv v1) read in full; it has no biology content; results are the authors' own.
caveat_zh: 机器人控制预印本（arXiv v1）已通读，不含生物学内容；结果为作者自己的。

title: D-Flow: Differentiating through Flows for Controlled Generation
key_claim_en: D-Flow optimizes the source noise point of a frozen diffusion or flow-matching model by backpropagating an arbitrary cost through the ODE solve; theory says this projects gradients onto data directions. On QM9 property-conditional generation, Δε MAE 1.39 versus 2.37 best baseline (self-reported).
key_claim_zh: D-Flow 通过把任意代价反向传播穿过 ODE 求解，优化冻结的扩散或流匹配模型的源噪声点；理论表明这会把梯度投影到数据方向上。在 QM9 属性条件生成中，Δε 的 MAE 为 1.39，而最佳基线为 2.37（自报）。
so_what_en: Alternative to endpoint-gradient guidance (WM28): differentiates the whole ODE, costing 5-15 minutes per ImageNet-128 sample, and needs a differentiable cost.
so_what_zh: 端点梯度引导（WM28）的替代方案：对整个 ODE 求导，每个 ImageNet-128 样本耗时 5-15 分钟，并且需要可微的代价函数。
caveat_en: arXiv v2 in ICML 2024 format read; the PMLR page range is not in the text. Results are self-reported; flow-model molecular stability is 72.2% versus 82.1% for conditional EDM.
caveat_zh: 已读 ICML 2024 格式的 arXiv v2；文本中没有 PMLR 页码范围。结果为自报；流模型的分子稳定性为 72.2%，条件 EDM 为 82.1%。

title: Training Free Guided Flow Matching with Optimal Control
key_claim_en: OC-Flow casts training-free guidance of a pretrained flow as optimal control, with convergence analysis, extended to SO(3); it shows backprop-through-ODE methods (D-Flow, FlowGrad) are special cases. QM9 Δε MAE 1.383 versus D-Flow 1.566 on the same model (self-reported).
key_claim_zh: OC-Flow 把对预训练流的免训练引导表述为最优控制，附收敛性分析并扩展到 SO(3)；证明基于 ODE 反向传播的方法（D-Flow、FlowGrad）是其特例。在同一模型上，QM9 的 Δε MAE 为 1.383，D-Flow 为 1.566（自报）。
so_what_en: Frames guidance as a trade-off between target reward and proximity to the prior (relevant to WM28 schedules); image sampling takes 216s versus 15 minutes for D-Flow (WM39).
so_what_zh: 把引导表述为目标奖励与贴近先验之间的权衡（与 WM28 的调度相关）；图像采样耗时 216 秒，而 D-Flow（WM39）为 15 分钟。
caveat_en: arXiv v3 in ICLR 2025 format read; comparisons with D-Flow (WM39) are self-reported and re-run on EquiFM, where D-Flow's Δε is 1.566.
caveat_zh: 已读 ICLR 2025 格式的 arXiv v3；与 D-Flow（WM39）的比较为自报，并在 EquiFM 上重新运行，其中 D-Flow 的 Δε 为 1.566。

title: Deep-learning-based gene perturbation effect prediction does not yet outperform simple linear baselines
key_claim_en: On CRISPR data (Norman, Adamson, Replogle), deep models (five foundation models, GEARS, CPA) did not outperform additive, mean or linear baselines; none beat 'no change' at predicting genetic interactions (5,035 of 124,000 candidates at FDR 5%); a linear model with perturbation-pretrained embeddings was best.
key_claim_zh: 在 CRISPR 数据（Norman、Adamson、Replogle）上，深度模型（五个基础模型、GEARS、CPA）没有超过加性、均值或线性基线；预测遗传互作时没有一个胜过“无变化”基线（124,000 个候选中 5,035 个，FDR 5%）；使用扰动预训练嵌入的线性模型表现最好。
so_what_en: Baseline ladder for a genotype-aware predictor: no-change, additive, mean and low-dimensional linear models, scored by L2 error on the 1,000 most expressed genes. Covers genetic perturbations only, no drugs.
so_what_zh: 为基因型感知预测器提供基线阶梯：无变化、加性、均值和低维线性模型，并以表达量最高的 1,000 个基因上的 L2 误差评分。仅涵盖遗传扰动，不含药物。
caveat_en: Published Nature Methods version read in full; it adds the mean baseline suggested by later preprints. Only four datasets, all cancer cell lines (paper's wording); authors' own benchmark (self-reported).
caveat_zh: 已通读 Nature Methods 发表版；该版加入了后来预印本建议的均值基线。仅四个数据集，且均为癌细胞系（论文原话）；基准由作者自行完成（自报）。

title: PerturBench: Benchmarking Machine Learning Models for Cellular Perturbation Analysis
key_claim_en: Six datasets with covariate-transfer (unseen cell lines) and combination tasks: a covariate-only decoder fits RMSE and cosine LogFC yet is no better than random on the rank metric (0.5 = random); Latent Additive baselines are competitive and may scale better than CPA or SAMS-VAE.
key_claim_zh: 六个数据集，含协变量迁移（未见细胞系）和组合扰动任务：仅用协变量的解码器在 RMSE 和 cosine LogFC 上拟合尚可，但在排名指标上并不优于随机（0.5 = 随机）；Latent Additive 基线有竞争力，且可能比 CPA 或 SAMS-VAE 扩展得更好。
so_what_en: A covariate-only baseline (cell line; by analogy genotype) can pass fit metrics, so add a rank metric; Latent Additive (control encoding plus perturbation embedding) is a cheap reference model.
so_what_zh: 仅用协变量（细胞系；类比基因型）的基线就可能通过拟合指标，因此应加入排名指标；Latent Additive（对照编码加扰动嵌入）是廉价的参考模型。
caveat_en: Preprint v4 (24 Oct 2025) read in full. Authors' own benchmark (self-reported); models re-implement core components, not exact copies of the public models (authors' caveat).
caveat_zh: 已通读预印本 v4（2025 年 10 月 24 日）。基准由作者自行完成（自报）；模型是对核心组件的重新实现，并非公开模型的精确复制（作者自述）。

title: scPerturBench (GitHub)
key_claim_en: Benchmark of 27 methods (README table lists 23) on 29 datasets: cellular-context generalization (12 datasets, i.i.d. and o.o.d. splits; 10 published methods plus four baselines) and perturbation generalization (genetic, chemical); proposes bioLord-emCell (cell-line embedding plus disentanglement); data on Figshare and Zenodo.
key_claim_zh: 27 种方法（README 表格列出 23 种）、29 个数据集的基准：细胞背景泛化（12 个数据集，独立同分布与分布外划分；10 种已发表方法加四个基线）和扰动泛化（遗传、化学）；提出 bioLord-emCell（细胞系嵌入加解耦表示）；数据在 Figshare 和 Zenodo 上。
so_what_en: Ready scripts for holding out whole cellular contexts (i.i.d. versus o.o.d.), adaptable to unseen-genotype splits; cell-line embeddings are one prior-knowledge route to context conditioning.
so_what_zh: 提供整体留出细胞背景（独立同分布与分布外）的现成脚本，可改造为未见基因型划分；细胞系嵌入是引入先验知识来做背景条件化的一种途径。
caveat_en: README and clone read; the Results folder was not read, so no performance claim is used. README cites a 2025 Nature Methods paper; its relation to EV35 is unconfirmed.
caveat_zh: 已读 README 与克隆；Results 文件夹未读，因此不采用任何性能论断。README 引用了一篇 2025 年 Nature Methods 论文；其与 EV35 的关系未确认。

title: Virtual Cell Challenge 2025 Wrap-Up: Winners and Reflections (Arc)
key_claim_en: Organizer report on the 2025 Virtual Cell Challenge (300 CRISPRi perturbations in H1 hESCs, ~300,000 cells): models did not consistently beat naive baselines across metrics; almost all were worse than baseline on MAE; winners combined deep learning with statistical features and protein embeddings.
key_claim_zh: 主办方关于 2025 年 Virtual Cell Challenge 的总结（H1 hESC 中的 300 个 CRISPRi 扰动，约 300,000 个细胞）：模型在各项指标上没有稳定超过朴素基线；几乎所有模型在 MAE 上都不如基线；获胜者把深度学习与统计特征和蛋白嵌入结合。
so_what_en: Warns that MAE rarely beats a mean-cell baseline and that PDS rewards larger prediction magnitudes; report several metrics, and consider protein-embedding priors.
so_what_zh: 提醒 MAE 很少优于均值细胞基线，且 PDS 奖励更大的预测幅度；应报告多种指标，并考虑蛋白嵌入先验。
caveat_en: Organizer's own post, read in full; no leaderboard scores are given, and winning methods are the organizer's summaries (self-reported); team papers were still forthcoming.
caveat_zh: 主办方自己的帖子，已通读；未给出排行榜分数，获胜方法是主办方的概述（自报）；各团队的论文当时仍待发表。

title: NeurIPS 2025: Altos Labs Wins Generalist Prize at Arc's Virtual Cell Challenge (news)
key_claim_en: News report on the inaugural Virtual Cell Challenge (NeurIPS 2025): over 5,000 registrants from 114 countries and over 1,200 teams submitting results; the Generalist Prize (seven metrics) went to a flow-matching model; Arc's Goodarzi says pure end-to-end networks were yet to beat hybrid models.
key_claim_zh: 关于首届 Virtual Cell Challenge（NeurIPS 2025）的新闻报道：来自 114 个国家的 5,000 多人注册，1,200 多支队伍提交了结果；Generalist Prize（七项指标）授予一个流匹配模型；Arc 的 Goodarzi 称纯端到端网络尚未胜过混合模型。
so_what_en: Duplicates EV05 on the outcome; its only extra is an Arc investigator's view that pure end-to-end scaling needs more biological priors.
so_what_zh: 在结果方面与 EV05 重复；仅有的额外内容是 Arc 一位研究者的观点：纯端到端的扩展需要更多生物学先验。
caveat_en: Secondary news report, read in full; no publication date on the page. It says the winner was ranked with PerturBench, unlike Arc's own page (EV05), so that detail is unconfirmed. Retired 2026-10-17 (R7): Secondary news report of the same event as EV05; its participation figures also appear on the primary page and it adds no distinct mechanism, design or evaluation point.
caveat_zh: 二手新闻报道，已通读；页面未显示发表日期。文章称获胜模型是用 PerturBench 排名的，与 Arc 自己的页面（EV05）不同，因此该细节未确认。 已于 2026-10-17 退役（R7）：与 EV05 报道同一事件的二手新闻；其参赛数字在一手页面上也有，且没有提供独特的机理、设计或评测要点。

title: Virtual Cell Challenge 2026: Benchmarking zero-shot generalization across cellular contexts
key_claim_en: Cell article on the 2026 Virtual Cell Challenge: zero-shot prediction of gene knockdown responses across multiple independent cellular contexts, using a new Arc-generated dataset of unseen cell lines.
key_claim_zh: Cell 上关于 2026 年 Virtual Cell Challenge 的文章：在多个独立细胞背景中零样本预测基因敲低响应，使用 Arc 新生成的、包含未见细胞系的数据集。
so_what_en: Journal-level confirmation that the 2026 test is unseen cell lines, the same axis as an unseen genotype; design details are in EV08, not in this abstract.
so_what_zh: 期刊层面确认 2026 年的测试针对未见细胞系，与未见基因型属于同一维度；设计细节见 EV08，不在本摘要中。
caveat_en: Abstract only, from Europe PMC metadata; the Cell full text was not read, so the single-context contrast and design details are unchecked here (see EV08).
caveat_zh: 仅有摘要（来自 Europe PMC 元数据）；未读 Cell 全文，因此单一背景的对比和设计细节在此未核实（见 EV08）。

title: The 2026 Virtual Cell Challenge: predicting perturbation responses in cell contexts a model has never seen (Arc)
key_claim_en: 2026 Virtual Cell Challenge, per Arc: zero-shot CRISPRi knockdown prediction in six unseen cell lines (three validation, three final test) from the unperturbed state plus target genes; no challenge training set; six-metric aggregate ranking; final test released 22 Oct, due 5 Nov 2026.
key_claim_zh: 2026 年 Virtual Cell Challenge（据 Arc）：在六个未见细胞系中零样本预测 CRISPRi 敲低响应，输入为未扰动状态加靶基因（三个用于验证、三个用于最终测试）；无挑战专用训练集；最终排名汇总六项指标；最终测试集 10 月 22 日发布，11 月 5 日截止。
so_what_en: Template for unseen-genotype tests: the model sees only the new context's unperturbed profile and must infer how perturbation effects transfer; any public data may be used.
so_what_zh: 未见基因型测试的模板：模型只看到新背景的未扰动表达谱，必须推断扰动效应如何迁移；可使用任何公开数据。
caveat_en: Organizer's own announcement dated 20 Aug 2026, read in full; the six scoring metrics are not named on this page; dates are as announced then.
caveat_zh: 主办方自己的公告，日期为 2026 年 8 月 20 日，已通读；本页未列出这六项评分指标；日期以当时公告为准。

title: Generating high-quality Perturb-seq data for the 2026 Virtual Cell Challenge (Arc)
key_claim_en: 2026 challenge data: CRISPRi Perturb-seq in six cell lines (tissue, lineage, disease status) with identical sgRNAs, time point and platform; over 10,000 perturbations per line, median 500 cells each; curated to perturbations with at least 80% median knockdown, subsampled to 400 cells each.
key_claim_zh: 2026 年挑战赛数据：六个细胞系（组织来源、谱系、疾病状态各异）的 CRISPRi Perturb-seq，sgRNA、时间点和平台完全一致；每个细胞系分析超过 10,000 个扰动，每个扰动中位数 500 个细胞；筛选出中位敲低至少 80% 的扰动并下采样到每个扰动 400 个细胞。
so_what_en: Template for a cross-context dataset: the same sgRNAs and protocol in every line, about 50,000 control cells per experiment as baseline, curation by knockdown efficiency.
so_what_zh: 跨背景数据集的模板：每个细胞系使用相同的 sgRNA 和流程，每次实验约 50,000 个对照细胞作基线，按敲低效率筛选扰动。
caveat_en: Organizer's page dated 1 Oct 2026, read in full; all figures are Arc's own (self-reported); the page does not name the cell lines or say how or when the dataset is released.
caveat_zh: 主办方的页面，日期为 2026 年 10 月 1 日，已通读；所有数字均为 Arc 自己的（自报）；页面没有列出细胞系名称，也没有说明数据集如何或何时发布。

title: yashnil/virtual-cell-generalization (third-party repository)
key_claim_en: Third-party preregistered CRISPRi cross-context study (self-reported): response splits into conserved β (30.1% of energy, 80.8% reproducible) and context-specific γ (21.0%, 49.5%); zero-shot γ did not help; 20 anchors recovered only 9–13% of the 743-anchor γ⊥ gain, with no plateau by 743–885 anchors.
key_claim_zh: 第三方预注册的 CRISPRi 跨背景研究（自报）：响应可分为保守的 β（占能量 30.1%，可重复性 80.8%）和背景特异的 γ（21.0%，49.5%）；零样本使用 γ 没有帮助；20 个锚点只恢复了 743 个锚点时 γ⊥ 增益的 9–13%，到 743–885 个锚点仍未出现平台期。
so_what_en: Anchors the size of a context-by-perturbation term: a conserved core transfers, but context-specific response keeps improving into hundreds of target anchors, so a genotype term likely needs many measurements.
so_what_zh: 为背景与扰动交互项的大小提供锚点：保守的核心部分可迁移，但背景特异的响应在数百个目标锚点之后仍在改善，因此基因型项很可能需要大量测量。
caveat_en: Third-party README and clone read; numbers are the author's own (self-reported) and rest on reports not read; one range was corrected on 2026-10-07; the manuscript is still being consolidated.
caveat_zh: 已读第三方 README 与克隆；数字是作者自己的（自报），依赖未读的报告；一个范围已于 2026-10-07 更正；论文稿仍在整理中。

title: Harmonised benchmarking of foundation models for single-cell and spatial transcriptomics reveals context-dependent generalisation
key_claim_en: Four foundation models (CellPLM, scGPT-spatial, GenePT-w, scELMo) on K562 Perturb-seq (Adamson, Norman, Replogle): global Pearson is 0.98–0.99 for all, but delta metrics separate them and fall on Replogle (best Pearson Delta DE 0.4604 versus 0.7389 on Norman); rankings change with metric.
key_claim_zh: 四个基础模型（CellPLM、scGPT-spatial、GenePT-w、scELMo）在 K562 的 Perturb-seq 数据（Adamson、Norman、Replogle）上：全局 Pearson 对所有模型都是 0.98–0.99，但 delta 指标才能区分它们，且在 Replogle 上更低（最佳 Pearson Delta DE 为 0.4604，Norman 上为 0.7389）；排名随指标而变。
so_what_en: Global correlation saturates, so score delta metrics on top DE genes. Language-derived gene embeddings were competitive priors in a shared GEARS decoder, but no simple baselines were run.
so_what_zh: 全局相关性已经饱和，因此应对前几位差异表达基因评分 delta 指标。语言来源的基因嵌入在共享的 GEARS 解码器中是有竞争力的先验，但没有运行简单基线。
caveat_en: Preprint PDF read in full (no version stamp; PDF date matches the 17 Sep 2026 revision); numbers are the authors' own (self-reported); the perturbation task has four models, K562 only, and no simple baselines.
caveat_zh: 已通读预印本 PDF（无版本标记；PDF 日期与 2026 年 9 月 17 日的修订版一致）；数字是作者自己的（自报）；扰动任务只有四个模型、仅用 K562，且没有简单基线。

title: Parameter-free representations outperform single-cell foundation models on downstream benchmarks
key_claim_en: Parameter-free or linear pipelines (rank-normalized pseudo-bulk projection; ANOVA, PCA and logistic regression) matched or beat TranscriptFormer's reported scores on cross-species annotation, Tabula Sapiens classification (five tissues, mean macro F1 0.899 versus 0.910 and 0.907) and SARS-CoV-2 infection status (0.862); no perturbation data.
key_claim_zh: 无参数或线性流程（秩归一化的伪批量投影；ANOVA、PCA 加逻辑回归）在跨物种注释、Tabula Sapiens 分类（五个组织，平均 macro F1 为 0.899，对比 0.910 和 0.907）以及 SARS-CoV-2 感染状态（0.862）上，达到或超过 TranscriptFormer 已报告的分数；没有扰动数据。
so_what_en: Normalized-expression linear baselines can saturate cell-identity and disease-state benchmarks, so a genotype-aware model needs one; infection signals were separable only within cell clusters, not globally.
so_what_zh: 归一化表达的线性基线可能使细胞身份和疾病状态基准饱和，因此基因型感知模型需要这样的基线；感染信号只能在细胞簇内部区分，无法全局区分。
caveat_en: Preprint v1 (18 Feb 2026) read in full; authors' own numbers (self-reported), compared with foundation-model scores reported by others, not re-run; no perturbation data; claim limited to current scRNA-seq benchmarks.
caveat_zh: 已通读预印本 v1（2026 年 2 月 18 日）；数字是作者自己的（自报），与他人报告的基础模型分数比较，未重新运行；没有扰动数据；结论仅限于当前的 scRNA-seq 基准。

title: A benchmark for prediction of transcriptomic responses to chemical perturbations across cell types
key_claim_en: OP3: 146 compounds in PBMCs (four cell types) from three donors, CC BY 4.0 on GEO; target is signed −log10 p from limma, chosen by cross-donor retrieval; competition winner used ChemBERTa embeddings; GRN and pathway priors did not help; errors correlate with DE-gene count.
key_claim_zh: OP3：146 种化合物作用于来自三位供体的 PBMC（四种细胞类型），数据为 CC BY 4.0 并存于 GEO；目标是来自 limma 的带符号 −log10 p，通过跨供体检索选定；竞赛获胜者使用 ChemBERTa 嵌入；GRN 与通路先验没有帮助；误差与差异表达基因数相关。
so_what_en: Drug-by-donor-by-cell-type data at one dose (1 µM) and one time (24 h); authors note existing datasets lack genetic-background variation.
so_what_zh: 药物×供体×细胞类型的数据，只有一个剂量（1 µM）和一个时间点（24 小时）；作者指出现有数据集缺少遗传背景的变异。
caveat_en: PDF from the NeurIPS proceedings URL read in full; its header says 'Submitted to NeurIPS 2024 ... Do not distribute', so camera-ready status is unconfirmed; results are the authors' own (self-reported).
caveat_zh: 已通读 NeurIPS 会议论文集网址上的 PDF；其页眉写着“Submitted to NeurIPS 2024 ... Do not distribute”，因此是否为终稿未确认；结果是作者自己的（自报）。

title: The EFFECT benchmark suite: measuring cancer sensitivity prediction performance - without the bias
key_claim_en: On DepMap and GDSC cancer cell-line essentiality and drug sensitivity, Pearson correlation is misleading because of data biases; proposes cell-line/perturbation-exclusive splits, perturbation-wise evaluation and a Bias Detector; corrected correlations of standard non-linear models are rather low.
key_claim_zh: 在 DepMap 和 GDSC 的癌细胞系基因必需性与药物敏感性数据上，Pearson 相关因数据偏倚而具有误导性；提出细胞系/扰动互斥的划分、逐扰动评估和 Bias Detector；标准非线性模型校正后的相关性相当低。
so_what_en: Shows why per-perturbation, bias-corrected scores are needed: raw Pearson is misleading under data bias. Targets are gene essentiality and drug sensitivity, not transcriptomes, so it informs split design only.
so_what_zh: 说明为何需要逐扰动、经偏倚校正的评分：数据存在偏倚时，原始 Pearson 具有误导性。目标是基因必需性和药物敏感性而非转录组，因此只对划分设计有参考价值。
caveat_en: Abstract only (bioRxiv v2, 30 Oct 2023, from metadata); full text not read, so the bias sources and effect sizes are not verified here.
caveat_zh: 仅有摘要（bioRxiv v2，2023 年 10 月 30 日，来自元数据）；未读全文，因此偏倚来源和效应大小在此未核实。

title: Benchmarking Chemical, Genetic, and Cell Line Encodings for Cancer Perturbation Response Prediction
key_claim_en: On cancer cell viability and gene dependency (not transcriptomes): raw cell-line expression outperformed foundation-model embeddings and genotype-based encodings; STRING-based encodings beat GO-term and protein-language-model encodings for genetic perturbations; chemical encoders were comparable, except bio-assay-pretrained ones, which were best.
key_claim_zh: 在癌细胞活力和基因依赖性（不是转录组）上：原始细胞系表达优于基础模型嵌入和基于基因型的编码；对遗传扰动，基于 STRING 的编码优于 GO 术语和蛋白语言模型编码；化学编码器表现相近，只有用其他生物检测数据预训练的编码器最好。
so_what_en: Raw expression beat genotype encodings as cell-line context, a point for conditioning a genotype-aware model on expression; STRING features gave the best gene-perturbation encodings. Targets are viability, not transcriptomes.
so_what_zh: 作为细胞系背景，原始表达优于基因型编码，这支持让基因型感知模型以表达为条件；STRING 特征给出最好的基因扰动编码。目标是活力而非转录组。
caveat_en: Abstract only (bioRxiv v1, 17 Dec 2025, from metadata); full text not read, so effect sizes and datasets are unchecked; results are the authors' own (self-reported).
caveat_zh: 仅有摘要（bioRxiv v1，2025 年 12 月 17 日，来自元数据）；未读全文，因此效应大小和数据集未核实；结果是作者自己的（自报）。

title: Learning and actioning general principles of cancer cell drug sensitivity
key_claim_en: Trained on GDSC (286 drugs, 686 cell lines) and PRISM (6337 drugs, 887 lines) to predict drug sensitivity from basal transcriptomes: aggregated ρ 0.88–0.89 but median per-drug ρ 0.40; restricting genes to LLM-curated MOA pathways raised GDSC median ρ to 0.5 (self-reported).
key_claim_zh: 在 GDSC（286 种药物、686 个细胞系）和 PRISM（6337 种药物、887 个细胞系）上训练，用基础转录组预测药物敏感性：汇总 ρ 为 0.88–0.89，但每种药物的中位 ρ 仅为 0.40；把基因限制在由 LLM 整理的 MOA 通路后，GDSC 的中位 ρ 升至 0.5（自报）。
so_what_en: Aggregated correlation hides modest per-drug skill, so score per drug. A variant-driven response (BRAF and Dabrafenib) was recovered through expression signatures, not BRAF expression itself.
so_what_zh: 汇总相关性掩盖了每种药物预测能力有限的事实，因此应按药物评分。由变异决定的响应（BRAF 与 Dabrafenib）是通过表达特征而非 BRAF 自身表达恢复的。
caveat_en: Published Nature Communications version read in full (Europe PMC XML); numbers are the authors' own (self-reported); targets are IC50 or viability from basal expression, not drug-induced transcription; patient-level validation is limited.
caveat_zh: 已通读 Nature Communications 发表版（Europe PMC XML）；数字是作者自己的（自报）；目标是基于基础表达的 IC50 或活力，而不是药物诱导的转录；患者层面的验证有限。

title: Predicting gene essentiality and drug response from perturbation screens in preclinical cancer models with LEAP: Layered Ensemble of Autoencoders and Predictors
key_claim_en: LEAP ensembles regressors on autoencoder expression representations to predict gene dependency and drug response (AAC) in unscreened cell lines; PS-LASSO reaches Spearman 0.321 and 0.350 on two tasks, and 0.199 on external PRISM versus 0.220 cross-study label reproducibility (self-reported).
key_claim_zh: LEAP 在自编码器表达表示上集成回归器，预测未筛选细胞系的基因依赖性和药物响应（AAC）；PS-LASSO 在两个任务上的 Spearman 为 0.321 和 0.350，在外部 PRISM 上为 0.199，而跨研究标签重复性为 0.220（自报）。
so_what_en: Cross-study label reproducibility (0.220) is a ceiling to compare model scores against. Perturbation-specific LASSO is a cheap, near-best baseline.
so_what_zh: 跨研究标签重复性（0.220）是对照模型得分的上限。逐扰动 LASSO 是廉价且接近最佳的基线。
caveat_en: Preprint PDF read in full; arXiv lists two versions and the one read was not checked against them. Authors' own numbers (self-reported); targets are viability and drug response from basal expression.
caveat_zh: 已通读预印本 PDF；arXiv 列有两个版本，所读版本未与之核对。数字是作者自己的（自报）；目标是基于基础表达的活力和药物响应。

title: A gene essentiality signature enables predicting the mechanism of action of drugs
key_claim_en: Integrating loss-of-function (gene-essentiality) screens with drug-sensitivity screens yields a drug signature that predicts drug targets more accurately than chemical fingerprints or drug-perturbed expression signatures (abstract, self-reported); target predictions for noncancer drugs were validated by a proteome solubility assay.
key_claim_zh: 将功能缺失（基因必需性）筛选与药物敏感性筛选整合，得到的药物特征在预测药物靶点上比化学指纹或药物扰动表达特征更准确（摘要，自报）；对非癌症药物的靶点预测经蛋白质组溶解度实验验证。
so_what_en: A possible drug-target prior for the action space, from dependency data rather than expression; the abstract reports nothing on genotype-dependent transcription.
so_what_zh: 可作为动作空间中药物—靶点先验的一个来源，基于依赖性数据而非表达；摘要没有报告任何与基因型相关的转录结果。
caveat_en: Abstract only (bioRxiv v2 metadata); no full text on disk. The recorded role as a source for F18 item b is not supported by the abstract.
caveat_zh: 仅有摘要（bioRxiv v2 元数据），磁盘上没有全文。记录中作为 F18 项 b 来源的角色没有得到摘要支持。

title: A Systematic Comparison of Single-Cell Perturbation Response Prediction Models
key_claim_en: 13 models plus baselines, 25 datasets, 3 tasks (unseen single-gene perturbations, combinations, cell-type transfer), 24 metrics. Raw-profile Pearson exceeds 0.95 for most datasets; delta and DE metrics discriminate better; additive and linear baselines compete when components are seen; no method transfers across cell types consistently.
key_claim_zh: 13 个模型加基线，25 个数据集，3 个任务（未见单基因扰动、组合扰动、细胞类型迁移），24 项指标。多数数据集上原始表达谱 Pearson 超过 0.95；delta 与 DE 指标的区分力更强；当组成扰动已见时，加性与线性基线具有竞争力；没有方法能在细胞类型间稳定迁移。
so_what_en: Score small genotype-by-drug effects with delta, DE-overlap and distributional metrics, not raw-profile correlation; the benchmark has no donor or genotype split, so add one.
so_what_zh: 评估小幅基因型×药物效应时应使用 delta、DE 重叠和分布类指标，而不是原始表达谱相关性；该基准没有供体或基因型划分，需要补上。
caveat_en: Published Science Advances full text read (Europe PMC); the bioRxiv preprint was not compared. Abstract says 13 methods and baselines, while the body counts 13 models plus separate baselines.
caveat_zh: 读取的是已发表的 Science Advances 全文（Europe PMC）；未与 bioRxiv 预印本比对。摘要称 13 种方法和基线，而正文是 13 个模型加另列的基线。

title: Single Cell Foundation Models Evaluation (scFME) for In-Silico Perturbation
key_claim_en: Evaluation protocol for fine-tuned single-cell foundation models on in-silico perturbation: require sufficient control-versus-perturbed separation up front, score accuracy against zero-perturbation and random-perturbation baselines, and break results down by gene category (abstract only; no results reported).
key_claim_zh: 针对微调后单细胞基础模型的 in-silico 扰动评测协议：先要求对照与扰动细胞之间有足够的分离，以零扰动和随机扰动基线衡量准确度，并按基因类别拆分结果（仅摘要；未报告结果）。
so_what_en: Reusable protocol for genotype-aware predictors: filter to cases with measurable control separation and always report zero- and random-perturbation baselines before ranking models.
so_what_zh: 可复用于基因型感知预测器的协议：先筛选出与对照有可测分离的情形，并在给模型排名前始终报告零扰动和随机扰动基线。
caveat_en: Abstract only (bioRxiv v1); it reports no results and no GEARS comparison, so the 'limited gains over GEARS' statement is unsupported here.
caveat_zh: 仅有摘要（bioRxiv v1）；其中没有报告结果，也没有与 GEARS 的比较，因此“相对 GEARS 增益有限”的说法在此没有依据。

title: Benchmarking and Evaluation of AI Models in Biology: Outcomes and Recommendations from the CZI Virtual Cells Workshop
key_claim_en: Workshop recommendations, with no experiments or numbers: multi-metric evaluation broken down by laboratory or time point, test-only dataset release to prevent leakage, and replicability via data splitting; the report notes that cellular behavior varies with genetic variants and that ancestral bias pervades biomedical repositories.
key_claim_zh: 研讨会建议，不含实验或数字：多指标评测并按实验室或时间点拆分，数据集仅作测试用途发布以防泄漏，并通过数据划分保证可复现；报告指出细胞行为随遗传变异而变化，且祖源偏倚普遍存在于生物医学数据库中。
so_what_en: Generic checklist rather than evidence: stratify evaluation by laboratory and time point, hold test data back to prevent leakage, and use several complementary metrics.
so_what_zh: 这是通用清单而非证据：按实验室和时间点分层评测，保留测试数据以防泄漏，并使用多个互补指标。
caveat_en: arXiv full text read; opinion-style workshop report with no experiments, so nothing here is empirical evidence.
caveat_zh: 已读取 arXiv 全文；这是观点式的研讨会报告，没有实验，因此其中没有经验证据。

title: On the cross-population generalizability of gene expression prediction models
key_claim_en: Cross-population expression prediction is modulated by both shared eQTL architecture and shared ancestry; in simulations eQTL sharing is the primary driver. In GEUVADIS (n = 89 per population), mean R2 into YRI is 0.062-0.084 versus 0.103-0.137 among European groups.
key_claim_zh: 跨人群表达预测同时受共享 eQTL 结构和共享祖源的调节；模拟中 eQTL 共享是主要驱动因素。在 GEUVADIS（每个人群 n = 89）中，预测到 YRI 的平均 R2 为 0.062-0.084，而欧洲各组之间为 0.103-0.137。
so_what_en: Evaluate germline expression predictors with ancestry-matched and cross-ancestry splits separately, and expect lower transfer where causal eQTLs differ; effect sharing matters more than genetic distance.
so_what_zh: 应分别用祖源匹配和跨祖源划分评估种系表达预测器，并预期在因果 eQTL 不同处迁移更差；效应共享比遗传距离更重要。
caveat_en: Published PLOS Genetics full text read. Real-data evidence is a 39-subject cohort with possible technical heterogeneity; the main mechanism result comes from simulation, and R2 values cover genes with positive correlation.
caveat_zh: 已读取 PLOS Genetics 已发表全文。真实数据证据来自 39 名受试者的队列，可能存在技术异质性；主要机理结论来自模拟，R2 数值只涵盖预测与测量呈正相关的基因。

title: Allele frequency impacts the cross-ancestry portability of gene expression prediction in lymphoblastoid cell lines
key_claim_en: In lymphoblastoid cell lines, cis-genetic effects are highly similar across European and African individuals, but portability from European training falls by over 32% when the causal variant is common (MAF > 5%) in Europeans and rarer (MAF < 5%) in Africans.
key_claim_zh: 在淋巴母细胞系中，欧洲人与非洲人的顺式遗传效应高度相似，但当因果变异在欧洲人中常见（MAF > 5%）而在非洲人中较罕见（MAF < 5%）时，从欧洲训练迁移的可移植性下降超过 32%。
so_what_en: Cis effects look shared across ancestries and fine-mapping alone does not close the gap, so stratify germline-track evaluation by ancestry and causal-variant MAF.
so_what_zh: 顺式效应在不同祖源间看起来是共享的，而且仅靠精细定位无法弥合差距，因此应按祖源和因果变异的 MAF 对种系轨道评测分层。
caveat_en: Abstract only (Europe PMC metadata); no full text on disk. Scope is lymphoblastoid cell lines and European-to-African transfer.
caveat_zh: 仅有摘要（Europe PMC 元数据）；磁盘上没有全文。范围限于淋巴母细胞系和从欧洲到非洲的迁移。

title: Impact of admixture and ancestry on eQTL analysis and GWAS colocalization in GTEx
key_claim_en: GTEx v8 has 838 genotyped donors, up to 15% non-European. In 117 admixed donors, local-ancestry adjustment gave modestly more eGenes than genotype PCs but no systematic colocalization difference; local ancestry explained at least 7% of residual expression variance for 1% of genes.
key_claim_zh: GTEx v8 有 838 名已基因分型供体，非欧洲裔最多占 15%。在 117 名混合祖源供体中，局部祖源校正比基因型主成分多检出少量 eGene，但共定位无系统性差异；局部祖源解释了 1% 基因至少 7% 的残余表达方差。
so_what_en: Suggests global ancestry PCs suffice for most genes, with local ancestry reserved for ancestry-stratified loci such as copy-number-variable genes; relevant to covariates for admixed donors.
so_what_zh: 提示多数基因用全局祖源主成分即可，局部祖源只需留给祖源分层的位点（如拷贝数可变基因）；与混合祖源供体的协变量设置相关。
caveat_en: Genome Biology full text read via Europe PMC. Abstract gives up to 15% non-European; Introduction and Discussion give 17% non-European or admixed. The admixed cohort is small (117 donors).
caveat_zh: 已通过 Europe PMC 读取 Genome Biology 全文。摘要称非欧洲裔最多 15%；引言和讨论称非欧洲裔或混合祖源最多 17%。混合祖源队列较小（117 名供体）。

title: Transferability of Single- and Cross-Tissue Transcriptome Imputation Models Across Ancestry Groups
key_claim_en: European-trained PrediXcan and UTMOST models (587 GTEx donors, 49 tissues) predict expression better in 111 European than 111 African American donors (mean r2 gap 0.00473 and 0.00212), but the median gap is negative in 10 and 15 of 49 tissues.
key_claim_zh: 在欧洲裔训练的 PrediXcan 和 UTMOST 模型（587 名 GTEx 供体，49 个组织）中，对 111 名欧洲裔供体的表达预测优于 111 名非裔美国人供体（平均 r2 差距为 0.00473 和 0.00212），但分别有 10 和 15 个（共 49 个）组织的中位差距为负。
so_what_en: Report per-tissue r2 gaps and the share of models predictive per ancestry, not one pooled figure; the gap grows with tissue sample size and flips sign in some small-sample tissues.
so_what_zh: 应报告各组织的 r2 差距和各祖源中可预测模型的比例，而不是单一的汇总数字；差距随组织样本量增大而增大，并在一些小样本组织中符号反转。
caveat_en: Full text read (Europe PMC). Only European-trained models were tested, so matched-ancestry superiority is inferred from the European-versus-African American test gap; comparison covers only models predictive in both test sets.
caveat_zh: 已读取全文（Europe PMC）。只测试了欧洲裔训练的模型，因此“祖源匹配最优”是由欧洲裔与非裔美国人测试集之间的差距推断而来；比较只涵盖在两个测试集中都可预测的模型。

title: Power and linkage disequilibrium differences are major confounders of human eQTL portability across ancestries and cohorts
key_claim_en: Ten eQTL summary-statistic datasets: portability metrics in use give markedly different pictures of conservation or divergence; sample size, minor allele frequency and LD drive the observed differences in portability across studies; the authors add a power-corrected portability call and empirical-Bayes shrinkage meta-analysis.
key_claim_zh: 十个 eQTL 汇总统计数据集：现行的可移植性指标对保守或分化给出明显不同的图景；样本量、次要等位基因频率和 LD 驱动了各研究间观察到的可移植性差异；作者提出了校正统计效能的可移植性判定方法和经验贝叶斯收缩的荟萃分析。
so_what_en: Treat apparent cross-ancestry eQTL non-replication as partly a power artifact; correct for sample size, MAF and LD before reading it as biology, and pool populations to stabilize effect estimates.
so_what_zh: 应把跨祖源 eQTL 表观不可重复部分视为统计效能假象；在解读为生物学差异前先校正样本量、MAF 和 LD，并合并人群以稳定效应估计。
caveat_en: Abstract of v2 only; no full text. Recorded title differs from the current bioRxiv title and the URL points to v1, so text may differ between versions.
caveat_zh: 仅有 v2 摘要；没有全文。记录的标题与当前 bioRxiv 标题不同，URL 指向 v1，因此各版本文本可能不同。

title: Empirical Evaluation of Single-Cell Foundation Models for Predicting Cancer Outcomes
key_claim_en: peripheral
key_claim_zh: 外围条目
so_what_en: NA
so_what_zh: NA
caveat_en: Retired 2026-10-16 (R1): marked peripheral in iteration 1 and never cited.
caveat_zh: 已于 2026-10-16 退役（R1）：在第 1 轮中被标为边缘，且从未被引用。

title: Systema: a framework for evaluating genetic perturbation response prediction beyond systematic variation
key_claim_en: Across ten datasets, perturbed-mean baselines match or beat GEARS, scGPT and CPA on control-referenced Pearson delta; per-dataset systematic variation correlates 0.91 (scGPT) and 0.95 (GEARS) with scores. Re-referencing to the perturbed-cell centroid gives substantially lower scores; centroid accuracy barely exceeds the perturbed-mean baseline.
key_claim_zh: 在十个数据集上，perturbed-mean 基线在以对照为参照的 Pearson delta 上与 GEARS、scGPT 和 CPA 持平或更优；各数据集的系统性变异与得分的相关性为 0.91（scGPT）和 0.95（GEARS）。将参照改为扰动细胞质心后得分显著降低；centroid accuracy 仅略高于 perturbed-mean 基线。
so_what_en: Report the average-effect baseline and a perturbed-centroid reference; for genotype-by-drug the matching null is the drug effect averaged over genotypes, though reference-based metrics are noisy for weak effects.
so_what_zh: 应报告平均效应基线和以扰动质心为参照的结果；对基因型×药物而言，对应的零模型是跨基因型平均的药物效应，但基于参照的指标在效应很弱时噪声较大。
caveat_en: Published full text read (Europe PMC); supplementary figures not read. Only three methods (CPA, GEARS, scGPT) and genetic perturbations were tested, so extrapolating to drugs is untested.
caveat_zh: 已读取已发表全文（Europe PMC）；未读补充图表。只测试了三种方法（CPA、GEARS、scGPT）和遗传扰动，因此外推到药物尚未检验。

title: Diversity by Design: Addressing Mode Collapse Improves scRNA-seq Perturbation Modeling on Well-Calibrated Metrics
key_claim_en: Mean-of-perturbed-cells baseline scores well because control-referenced Pearson delta rewards control bias (r = 0.54 simulated, 0.63 Norman, 0.58 Replogle). Proposes DEG-weighted metrics, a technical-duplicate ceiling and a WMSE loss lifting GEARS median weighted R2 on Norman from -0.068 to 0.555 (self-reported).
key_claim_zh: 扰动细胞均值基线得分很高，是因为以对照为参照的 Pearson delta 会奖励对照偏倚（模拟中 r = 0.54，Norman 为 0.63，Replogle 为 0.58）。作者提出按 DEG 加权的指标、technical-duplicate 上限，以及一种 WMSE 损失，使 GEARS 在 Norman 上的加权 R2 中位数从 -0.068 升到 0.555（自报）。
so_what_en: Calibrate any genotype-by-drug score with a mean-prediction null, a control-only baseline and a technical-duplicate ceiling, and take deltas against the pooled-condition mean rather than control.
so_what_zh: 任何基因型×药物得分都应以均值预测零模型、仅对照基线和 technical-duplicate 上限来校准，并以合并条件的均值而非对照来计算 delta。
caveat_en: arXiv v1 full text read. Gains are self-reported by authors at Shift Bioscience on two datasets (Norman, Replogle); the authors note unseen-combination gains may be inflated by data leakage.
caveat_zh: 已读取 arXiv v1 全文。增益由 Shift Bioscience 的作者自报，仅在两个数据集（Norman、Replogle）上；作者指出未见组合的增益可能因数据泄漏而被夸大。

title: Evaluating Single-Cell Perturbation Response Models Is Far from Straightforward
key_claim_en: Cross-splitting, noise and synthetic experiments show correlation and distribution metrics are influenced by scale, sparsity and dimensionality (Wasserstein fails under variance scaling in high dimensions; Energy distance can miss gene-gene dependency disruption); deep models often underperform simple baselines, far from empirical bounds (self-reported).
key_claim_zh: 交叉划分、噪声和合成数据实验表明，相关性和分布类指标受规模、稀疏性和维度影响（Wasserstein 在高维方差缩放下失效；Energy distance 可能漏掉基因间依赖关系的破坏）；深度模型常不如简单基线，且远低于经验上限（自报）。
so_what_en: Report genotype-by-drug results against empirical ceilings and simple baselines, and test the metric itself for scale, sparsity and dimensionality artifacts before trusting model rankings.
so_what_zh: 报告基因型×药物结果时应对照经验上限和简单基线，并在信任模型排名前检验指标本身是否存在规模、稀疏性和维度伪象。
caveat_en: Abstract only (bioRxiv v1); datasets, models and results are not named in the abstract and remain unverified.
caveat_zh: 仅有摘要（bioRxiv v1）；摘要没有点名数据集和模型，结果仍未验证。

title: Mechanisms Matter: Transportability of Cellular Perturbation Effects
key_claim_en: Cross-context generalization is governed by shared causal mechanisms, not just distributional similarity. Across six deep models and five simple baselines, cross-context performance often falls to baseline level; even on synthetic data none transfers across differing mechanisms (self-reported). Lower transcriptome-wide-impact concordance tracks larger transfer gaps.
key_claim_zh: 跨情境泛化由共享的因果机制决定，而不只是分布相似性。在六个深度模型和五个简单基线上，跨情境表现常降到基线水平；即使在合成数据上，也没有模型能在机制不同的情境之间迁移（自报）。跨情境转录组范围影响一致性越低，迁移差距越大。
so_what_en: A variant that rewires a mechanism defines a new context where transfer should fail unless the mechanism is modeled; the tunable-divergence simulator and the concordance proxy give a unit test.
so_what_zh: 改变机制的变异定义了一个新情境，除非对机制建模，否则迁移应当失败；可调分化的模拟器和一致性代理指标可用作单元测试。
caveat_en: Abstract of bioRxiv v3 only; earlier summaries gave four deep models and six baselines against six and five here, so versions may differ. No full text.
caveat_zh: 仅有 bioRxiv v3 摘要；早先的摘要称有四个深度模型和六个基线，而此处为六个和五个，因此各版本可能不同。没有全文。

title: A mechanism-annotated benchmark reveals limited fidelity to drug-response signatures in single-cell perturbation models
key_claim_en: Benchmark linking matched control and drug-treated scRNA-seq to literature-curated key-gene directions (181 datasets, 423 response cases, 2.5 million cells). Across 12 models, 3 baselines and 10 splits, expression-similarity metrics were weakly aligned with the Mechanism Fidelity Score; mechanism-aware selection improved early drug retrieval (self-reported).
key_claim_zh: 该基准把配对的对照与药物处理 scRNA-seq 同文献整理的关键基因方向联系起来（181 个数据集、423 个响应案例、2.5 百万个细胞）。在 12 个模型、3 个基线和 10 种划分上，表达相似性指标与 Mechanism Fidelity Score 的一致性较弱；机制感知的选择提高了早期药物检索（自报）。
so_what_en: A mechanism-level check for the evaluation battery: expression similarity alone does not preserve drug-response signatures, so also score key-gene direction per genotype background.
so_what_zh: 评测组合中可加入机制层面的检查：仅有表达相似性无法保证保留药物响应特征，因此还应按基因型背景评分关键基因方向。
caveat_en: Abstract only (bioRxiv v2 metadata); the benchmark, score definition and all results are unreviewed and unverified in full text.
caveat_zh: 仅有摘要（bioRxiv v2 元数据）；基准、评分定义和所有结果均未经同行评议，也未在全文中验证。

title: Drug Response Prediction Provides a Biologically Relevant Benchmark for Perturbation Response Models
key_claim_en: Perturbation response models are judged by downstream drug-response prediction: simple baselines match them at reconstructing post-treatment profiles, yet predictors trained on model-generated profiles significantly outperform those trained on baseline or pre-treatment profiles, because models preserve variation in response-relevant genes (self-reported).
key_claim_zh: 以下游药物响应预测来评判扰动响应模型：简单基线在重建处理后表达谱上与模型相当，但在模型生成表达谱上训练的预测器显著优于在基线或处理前表达谱上训练的预测器，原因是模型保留了响应相关基因的变异（自报）。
so_what_en: A downstream-utility test for generated profiles; the analogue here is whether genotype-conditioned generated profiles improve genotype-aware drug-response prediction over baseline or pre-treatment inputs.
so_what_zh: 这是针对生成表达谱的下游效用检验；对应到本研究，就是以基因型为条件生成的表达谱能否比基线或处理前输入更好地改进基因型感知的药物响应预测。
caveat_en: Abstract only (bioRxiv v1, December 2025); datasets, splits and effect sizes are not stated and remain unverified.
caveat_zh: 仅有摘要（bioRxiv v1，2025 年 12 月）；数据集、划分和效应量均未说明，仍未验证。

title: Benchmarking virtual cell models for in-the-wild perturbation response
key_claim_en: 11 models on 7 scPerturb datasets (6 studies) under unseen cell-line, unseen-patient (Kang2018), unseen-perturbation and cross-dataset scenarios, dose and time fixed: embedding-based splits lower performance versus random splits, PCC discriminates poorly, and naive dataset merging often degrades results.
key_claim_zh: 在 7 个 scPerturb 数据集（6 项研究）上评测 11 个模型，涵盖未见细胞系、未见患者（Kang2018）、未见扰动和跨数据集场景，剂量和时间固定：基于嵌入的划分比随机划分使表现下降，PCC 区分力差，简单合并数据集常使结果变差。
so_what_en: Evaluate unseen cell context, unseen perturbation and unseen dataset as separate splits; this benchmark already includes an unseen-donor split (Kang2018), so unseen genotype is a further split to add.
so_what_zh: 应把未见细胞情境、未见扰动和未见数据集作为独立划分来评估；该基准已含未见供体划分（Kang2018），因此未见基因型是需要补充的另一种划分。
caveat_en: arXiv v1 full text read; scope is 7 datasets and 11 models with dose and time fixed. The unseen-patient split rests on one dataset (Kang2018, 8 patients).
caveat_zh: 已读取 arXiv v1 全文；范围为 7 个数据集和 11 个模型，剂量和时间固定。未见患者划分只依赖一个数据集（Kang2018，8 名患者）。

title: mlbio-epfl/systema (GitHub)
key_claim_en: Repository runs CPA, GEARS and scGPT plus two non-parametric baselines (non-control mean, matching mean) on eight listed datasets; evaluation code provides delta-profile Pearson correlation against the perturbed-cell centroid and centroid accuracy; a Zenodo DOI is given.
key_claim_zh: 该仓库运行 CPA、GEARS 和 scGPT，外加两个非参数基线（non-control mean、matching mean），覆盖八个列出的数据集；评测代码提供以扰动细胞质心为参照的 delta 谱 Pearson 相关和 centroid accuracy；并给出 Zenodo DOI。
so_what_en: Two implementable checks: delta correlation referenced to the perturbed-cell centroid, and centroid accuracy; for genotype-by-drug, test whether a predicted profile is nearest its own genotype-and-drug centroid.
so_what_zh: 两个可实现的检查：以扰动细胞质心为参照的 delta 相关，以及 centroid accuracy；对基因型×药物，则检验预测谱是否最接近其自身基因型与药物组合的质心。
caveat_en: README and shallow clone read (last commit 2026-01-14); no LICENSE among top-level entries. README lists eight datasets; EV29 counts ten because Frangieh is split into three conditions.
caveat_zh: 已读取 README 和浅克隆（最后提交 2026-01-14）；顶层条目中没有 LICENSE。README 列出八个数据集；EV29 计为十个，因为 Frangieh 被拆成三种条件。

title: Xaira-Therapeutics/X-Atlas-Orion (Hugging Face dataset card)
key_claim_en: Dataset card: two genome-wide FiCS Perturb-seq screens (18,903 target genes), eight million HCT116 and HEK293T cells, median 16,000 UMIs per cell; median on-target knockdown 75.4% and 51.5%; median at least 140 cells per perturbation; CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
key_claim_zh: 数据集卡片：两次全基因组 FiCS Perturb-seq 筛选（18,903 个靶基因），八百万个 HCT116 和 HEK293T 细胞，每个细胞中位 16,000 个 UMI；中位靶向敲低 75.4% 和 51.5%；每个扰动中位至少 140 个细胞；CC BY-NC-SA 4.0。
so_what_en: Graded knockdown strength across two lines is the closest public proxy for hypomorphic alleles; the non-commercial share-alike licence limits reuse.
so_what_zh: 两个细胞系间梯度的敲低强度是亚效等位基因最接近的公开代理；非商业相同方式共享的许可限制了复用。
caveat_en: Dataset card read; the numbers are the owner's own; the preprint full text is covered by DS18.
caveat_zh: 已阅读数据集卡片；数字为所有者自己的；预印本全文见 DS18。

title: Decoding heterogeneous single-cell perturbation responses
key_claim_en: Perturbation-response score (PS) rates each Perturb-seq cell from 0 to 1. In K562 essential-gene CRISPRi, 395 of 488 Hill-fitted genes were buffered (ED50 ≤ 0.5), with complex partners upregulated; CCNT1 perturbation gave over 100 DEGs in stimulated but one in unstimulated Jurkat cells.
key_claim_zh: 扰动响应评分（PS）为每个 Perturb-seq 细胞给出 0 到 1 的扰动强度。在 K562 必需基因 CRISPRi 数据中，488 个完成 Hill 拟合的基因里有 395 个为缓冲型（ED50 ≤ 0.5），同一复合体的其他成员上调；CCNT1 扰动在受刺激的 Jurkat 细胞中产生超过 100 个差异表达基因，未受刺激时仅 1 个。
so_what_en: Partial gene loss maps nonlinearly and gene-specifically to transcriptional response, so a hypomorphic-allele or copy-number input should be a graded, context-conditioned covariate rather than a binary flag.
so_what_zh: 基因部分缺失与转录响应之间呈非线性且因基因而异的映射，因此低效等位基因或拷贝数输入应作为分级且依赖情境的协变量，而不是二元标记。
caveat_en: Fractions apply only to the 488 of 2,285 genes that passed fit filters; knockdown or knockout, not drug or inherited variants; PS sees only surviving cells (survival bias).
caveat_zh: 比例仅适用于通过拟合筛选的 488 个基因（共 2,285 个）；研究的是基因敲低或敲除，而非药物或遗传变异；PS 只能看到存活的细胞（存活偏倚）。

title: PerturbDiff: Functional Diffusion for Single-Cell Perturbation Modeling
key_claim_en: Diffusion over cell populations as random variables (kernel mean embedding, MMD loss, MM-DiT with control batch), pretrained on 61 million CellxGene cells; tested on PBMC cytokines, Tahoe100M and Replogle against mean, linear, CPA, STATE, CellFlow and Squidiff baselines (self-reported).
key_claim_zh: 把细胞群体作为随机变量做扩散（核均值嵌入、MMD 损失、带对照批次的 MM-DiT），并在 6100 万（61 million）个 CellxGene 细胞上预训练；在 PBMC 细胞因子、Tahoe100M 和 Replogle 数据上与均值、线性、CPA、STATE、CellFlow 和 Squidiff 基线比较（自报）。
so_what_en: Models hidden donor or batch variation as a distribution over responses, a fit for latent genotype; its donor-held-out PBMC split (4 of 12 donors) is a ready unseen-donor protocol.
so_what_zh: 把隐藏的供体或批次变异建模为响应上的分布，适合潜在基因型；其按供体留出的 PBMC 划分（12 名供体中留出 4 名）是现成的未见供体评测协议。
caveat_en: Preprint v1 (arXiv, February 2026); code and data 'will be made publicly available' (unverified); baselines rerun by the authors; from scratch it trails STATE on Replogle; random initialisation scores non-trivially on some PBMC metrics.
caveat_zh: 预印本 v1（arXiv，2026 年 2 月）；代码与数据“将公开”（未核实）；基线由作者重新运行；从头训练时在 Replogle 上落后于 STATE；随机初始化在部分 PBMC 指标上得分并不低。

title: An isogenic cell line panel for sequence-based screening of targeted anticancer drugs
key_claim_en: 100 validated isogenic tumour-suppressor knockout lines (19 pathways; RPE1, MCF10A, RPTec backgrounds) came from over 1,800 clones; 81 lines screened against 2,658 compounds by barcode growth (430,596 scored interactions) gave one hit shared by two backgrounds, TP53 loss with MK-1775.
key_claim_zh: 100 个经验证的同基因抑癌基因敲除细胞系（19 条通路；RPE1、MCF10A、RPTec 三种背景）来自 1,800 多个克隆；用条形码生长读数对 81 个细胞系筛选 2,658 个化合物（评分 430,596 个相互作用），仅得到两种背景共有的一个命中：TP53 缺失与 MK-1775。
so_what_en: Genotype-by-drug growth labels for 19 pathway losses in clean backgrounds (no transcriptome). Only 152 of over 1,800 clones were validated knockouts, so genotype labels need per-clone validation.
so_what_zh: 19 条通路缺失的基因型×药物生长标签，背景干净（无转录组）。1,800 多个克隆中只有 152 个经验证为敲除，因此基因型标签需要逐克隆验证。
caveat_en: Growth readout (1 and 10 µM, 72 h); a 50% read reduction was detectable in 75% of RPE1 wells but 38% of MCF10A; RNA-seq is baseline only (97 lines); the MK-1775 effect was already known.
caveat_zh: 读数为生长（1 和 10 µM，72 小时）；读数降低 50% 在 RPE1 孔中 75% 可检出，在 MCF10A 中仅 38%；RNA-seq 仅为基线（97 个细胞系）；MK-1775 的效应此前已知。

title: Deep Mutational Scanning Reveals EGFR Mutations Conferring Resistance to the 4th-generation EGFR tyrosine kinase inhibitor BLU-945
key_claim_en: EGFR L858R kinase-domain saturation mutagenesis in Ba/F3 (16,882 of 16,884 variants recovered; 100 nM, 14 days) enriched L718X under osimertinib and many more variants under BLU-945; osimertinib plus BLU-945 enriched only L718, as predicted from single-agent profiles.
key_claim_zh: 在 Ba/F3 细胞中对 EGFR L858R 激酶结构域做饱和突变（16,884 个变异中回收 16,882 个；100 nM，14 天）：osimertinib 选出 L718X，BLU-945 选出多得多的变异；osimertinib 加 BLU-945 只选出 L718 变异，与由单药谱预测的一致。
so_what_en: Drug-by-variant resistance map for a class-1 target; single-agent profiles predicted combination escape. Allelic context was L858R only, so labels may not transfer to other EGFR alleles.
so_what_zh: 针对第 1 类靶点的药物×变异耐药图谱；单药谱预测了联合用药的逃逸。等位背景仅为 L858R，因此标签未必能迁移到其他 EGFR 等位基因。
caveat_en: Text read is the published version (10.1038/s41698-025-01086-2), not the preprint; single high dose (>EC90, 100 nM), Ba/F3 growth readout, no transcriptome; BLU-945 is no longer in clinical development; two patients only.
caveat_zh: 所读文本为正式发表版（10.1038/s41698-025-01086-2），而非预印本；仅单一高剂量（>EC90，100 nM），读数为 Ba/F3 生长，无转录组；BLU-945 已不再临床开发；仅两例患者。

title: Saturation mutagenesis identifies activating and resistance-inducing FGFR kinase domain mutations
key_claim_en: Saturation mutagenesis of FGFR1–4 kinase domains (11,520 possible point mutations): 474 activating and 738 resistance mutations to pemigatinib or futibatinib, 301 druggable; the screens matched 28 of 29 acquired-resistance cases in trials; REVEL, EVE and AlphaMissense did not predict gain of function.
key_claim_zh: 对 FGFR1–4 激酶结构域做饱和突变（11,520 个可能的点突变）：474 个激活突变和 738 个对 pemigatinib 或 futibatinib 的耐药突变，其中 301 个可用药；筛选结果与试验中 29 例获得性耐药中的 28 例相符；REVEL、EVE 和 AlphaMissense 未能预测功能获得。
so_what_en: Measured class-1 variant-by-drug labels that matched clinical resistance (28 of 29 cases), plus a caution for GV17: pathogenicity scores did not predict gain of function.
so_what_zh: 实测的第 1 类变异×药物标签与临床耐药相符（29 例中 28 例），并对 GV17 提出警示：致病性评分未能预测功能获得。
caveat_en: Growth readout in two cell lines (MCF10A activation; NCI-H1581 resistance at one dose per drug), no transcriptome; the abstract's 738 resistance mutations is not reconciled with 635 plus 407 in the body.
caveat_zh: 读数为两种细胞系中的生长（MCF10A 测激活；NCI-H1581 测耐药，每种药一个剂量），无转录组；摘要中的 738 个耐药突变与正文中的 635 加 407 未能对上。

title: Optimal dosing of anti-cancer treatment under drug-induced plasticity
key_claim_en: Two-state model (drug-sensitive versus drug-tolerant) with dose-dependent transitions: the optimal schedule steers to a fixed equilibrium composition; linear tolerance induction favours a constant low dose, uniform induction the maximum dose, continuous or pulsed; under linear induction, breaks of 20–30% or longer worsen growth.
key_claim_zh: 含剂量依赖转换的两状态模型（药物敏感与药物耐受）：最优方案把肿瘤引导到固定的平衡组成；线性诱导耐受时最优为恒定低剂量，均匀诱导时最优为最大剂量（连续或脉冲）；线性诱导下，治疗间隔达 20–30% 或更长会使生长变差。
so_what_en: A dose-conditioned world model must learn how dose drives state transitions, not only kill, because the induction form flips the optimal plan; this gives analytic checks for dose-schedule priors.
so_what_zh: 带剂量条件的世界模型必须学习剂量如何驱动状态转换，而不只是杀伤，因为诱导形式会翻转最优方案；这为剂量方案先验提供了解析检验。
caveat_en: Theory with two cell states, exponential growth, no pharmacokinetics or transcriptome; only linear and uniform induction proved; one in vitro case study (two colorectal lines from Russo et al.); arXiv v2 (July 2025) read.
caveat_zh: 理论模型，仅两种细胞状态、指数生长，无药代动力学或转录组；只证明了线性和均匀两种诱导形式；一个体外案例（Russo 等的两个结直肠细胞系）；所读为 arXiv v2（2025 年 7 月）。

title: Clonal dynamics shaped by diverse drug-tolerant persister states in melanoma resistance
key_claim_en: Lineage-barcoded BRAF V600E melanoma xenografts under dabrafenib plus trametinib: 261 of 1,127 pre-treatment barcodes persisted to relapse, and six relapsed tumors with 200 to 300 coding alterations each shared no mutation. Four persister states recur across 3 models; data in GEO GSE299589.
key_claim_zh: 带谱系条形码的 BRAF V600E 黑色素瘤异种移植瘤在达拉非尼加曲美替尼处理下：治疗前 1,127 个条形码中有 261 个持续到复发，6 个复发肿瘤各有 200 至 300 个编码区改变却没有共享突变。四种持久耐受状态在 3 个模型中重现；数据存于 GEO GSE299589。
so_what_en: Under one driver genotype, drug-induced states were multiple and reported as largely non-genetic, so a genotype-conditioned generator needs a latent state or clone variable and distributional outputs.
so_what_zh: 在同一驱动基因型下，药物诱导的状态有多种，并被报告为主要由非遗传机制产生；因此基因型条件生成器需要潜在状态或克隆变量以及分布式输出。
caveat_en: bioRxiv preprint (PMC12458950 text) read in full, not peer reviewed. Mutations were called from bulk RNA-seq, CNV was inferred from expression, and scRNA-seq replicates were pooled per time point; one barcoded model.
caveat_zh: 已完整阅读 bioRxiv 预印本（PMC12458950 文本），未经同行评议。突变由批量 RNA-seq 推断，拷贝数变异由表达推断，scRNA-seq 重复样本在每个时间点合并；仅一个带条形码模型。

title: Generative modeling of single-cell gene expression for dose-dependent chemical perturbations
key_claim_en: VAE regressing a held-out cell type's latent response shift on its control state, then interpolating doses log-linearly from control and top dose. TCDD portal hepatocytes: R2 0.92 (HVGs), 0.81 (DEGs); pseudo-dose, a cell's projection on that shift, tracks real dose (R2 0.76) (self-reported).
key_claim_zh: 变分自编码器对留出细胞类型的潜在响应位移按其对照状态回归，再仅从对照与最高剂量出发做对数线性剂量插值。TCDD 处理的门静脉肝细胞：高变基因 R2 0.92，差异表达基因 R2 0.81；拟剂量（细胞在该位移上的投影）与真实剂量一致（R2 0.76）（自报）。
so_what_en: A cheap dose-axis baseline: one latent response direction, interpolated log-linearly in dose, plus a per-cell sensitivity coordinate. It beat scGen only at higher doses, so test dose-conditioned decoders against it.
so_what_zh: 低成本的剂量轴基线：一个潜在响应方向，按剂量做对数线性插值，外加每个细胞的敏感度坐标。它仅在较高剂量下优于 scGen，因此应用它来检验剂量条件解码器。
caveat_en: Patterns paper (Europe PMC text) read in full; self-reported. Scored by R2 of mean expression; epigenetic-mechanism drugs scored worst, and the margin over scGen was only 0.92 versus 0.91 in rat LPS6.
caveat_zh: 已完整阅读 Patterns 论文（Europe PMC 文本）；自报。以平均表达的 R2 评分；表观遗传机制药物得分最差，在大鼠 LPS6 中相对 scGen 的优势仅为 0.92 对 0.91。

title: STRAND: Sequence-Conditioned Transport for Single-Cell Perturbations
key_claim_en: Generator conditioned on DNA sequence at the perturbed locus (frozen Flashzoi/Borzoi embeddings), moving control cells to perturbed cells by latent bridge diffusion. On CRISPRi data (K562, Jurkat, RPE1), transport cuts energy distance 38.9% versus regression; low-sample discrimination 0.72 versus 0.54 for STATE (self-reported).
key_claim_zh: 以靶向位点 DNA 序列为条件的生成器（冻结的 Flashzoi/Borzoi 嵌入），用潜在扩散桥把对照细胞转运到扰动细胞。在 CRISPRi 数据（K562、Jurkat、RPE1）上，转运相对回归使能量距离降低 38.9%；低样本区间判别分数 0.72，对比 STATE 的 0.54（自报）。
so_what_en: Perturbations can be specified by DNA sequence rather than gene ID, a possible route to allele-aware conditioning; regulatory variants were not tested.
so_what_zh: 扰动可由 DNA 序列而非基因 ID 指定，是通向等位基因感知条件化的可能途径；调控变异未经测试。
caveat_en: arXiv v1 full text read; all numbers self-reported. Benchmark perturbations are modelled as canonical-TSS windows of 200 bp either side, so alternative-TSS resolution rests on one FLVCR1 case study; no CRISPRa or variants.
caveat_zh: 已完整阅读 arXiv v1；所有数字均为自报。基准扰动被建模为规范 TSS 两侧各 200 bp 的窗口，因此替代 TSS 的分辨依赖单个 FLVCR1 案例；未测试 CRISPRa 或变异。

title: A knowledge-driven framework for predicting single-cell responses for unprofiled drugs
key_claim_en: MAP-KG joins 187,089 drugs, 22,924 genes and drug-gene edges; its pretrained drug and gene embeddings condition a single-cell foundation-model predictor. For 16 held-out Tahoe-100M drugs, top-50 DEG Pearson delta improved 11.8% over baselines (leakage-controlled split); removing drug-gene edges hurt most (self-reported).
key_claim_zh: MAP-KG 连接 187,089 个药物、22,924 个基因及药物-基因边；其预训练的药物和基因嵌入为单细胞基础模型预测器提供条件。对 16 个留出的 Tahoe-100M 药物，top-50 差异表达基因 Pearson delta 比基线提高 11.8%（防泄漏划分）；去掉药物-基因边下降最多（自报）。
so_what_en: Drug-target edges were the most useful knowledge for zero-shot compounds, and held-out entities were removed from the graph before pretraining. Reuse both for a target-aware action prior over unseen drugs.
so_what_zh: 药物-靶点边是零样本化合物最有用的知识，且留出实体在预训练前已从图中移除。可复用二者构建对未见药物的靶点感知动作先验。
caveat_en: Published article read in full; self-reported, pseudobulk, n = 5 repeats on one test set. Abstract says up to +11.8% for unprofiled drugs but the text lists 19.8% (OP3).
caveat_zh: 已完整阅读已发表文章；自报，伪批量水平，在同一测试集上重复 n = 5 次。摘要称未分析药物最多提高 11.8%，正文却列出 19.8%（OP3）。

title: Chem2Gen-Bench: Benchmarking Chemical-to-Genetic Translation in Perturbation Response Space
key_claim_en: Benchmark of 260,084 chemical and 1,099,045 genetic perturbation profiles in cell-target contexts, scoring chemical-to-genetic retrieval at exact, cross-context and specificity levels. Exact retrieval: mean success 0.563 versus 0.498 for permuted labels (68,541 queries); in K562, seven foundation-model embeddings did not consistently beat gene deltas (self-reported).
key_claim_zh: 包含 260,084 个化学扰动谱和 1,099,045 个遗传扰动谱、按细胞-靶点情境组织的基准，在精确、跨情境和特异性三个层次评估化学到遗传的检索。精确检索：平均成功率 0.563，对比标签置换的 0.498（68,541 个查询）；在 K562 中，七种基础模型嵌入未能稳定优于基因差值（自报）。
so_what_en: Use genetic perturbation profiles as proxies for target-matched drug responses only after per-context validation; fidelity is heterogeneous and embeddings need a gene-delta baseline.
so_what_zh: 仅在逐情境验证后，才把遗传扰动谱用作靶点匹配药物响应的代理；保真度因情境而异，嵌入需要与基因差值基线比较。
caveat_en: arXiv v1 preprint read in full; self-reported. No data or code section, component datasets unnamed in the text, a draft note about the Systema-style stratum remains, and bulk and single-cell profiles are mixed.
caveat_zh: 已完整阅读 arXiv v1 预印本；自报。文中没有数据或代码部分，组成数据集未具名，Systema 式分层仍留有草稿备注，且批量与单细胞谱混用。

title: PRiMeFlow: Capturing Complex Expression Heterogeneity in Perturbation Response Modelling
key_claim_en: Conditional flow matching directly in gene-expression space with a U-Net velocity field. Ablations favour gene space over a PCA latent, U-Net over MLP, and independent over optimal-transport coupling. It trails CPA and SAMS-VAE on pseudobulk metrics but leads on most distribution metrics (self-reported).
key_claim_zh: 在基因表达空间中直接做条件流匹配，速度场用 U-Net。消融结果支持基因空间优于 PCA 潜空间、U-Net 优于 MLP、独立耦合优于最优传输耦合。它在伪批量指标上落后于 CPA 和 SAMS-VAE，但在多数分布指标上领先（自报）。
so_what_en: Ablation evidence against latent compression and optimal-transport pairing, the CellFlow-like (MD05) design. Mean-based and distribution-based metrics rank models differently; stronger guidance trades fit for DEG recall.
so_what_zh: 消融证据不支持潜空间压缩和最优传输配对（类 CellFlow 的 MD05 设计）。基于均值与基于分布的指标对模型排序不同；更强的引导以拟合度换取 DEG 召回。
caveat_en: arXiv v2 (13 May 2026) read in full; self-reported. PRiMeFlow hyperparameters were set manually, the pretraining atlas (6,975,767 cells) includes one proprietary dataset, and Challenge fine-tuning used external data for the test perturbations.
caveat_zh: 已完整阅读 arXiv v2（2026 年 5 月 13 日）；自报。PRiMeFlow 的超参数为手动设定，预训练图谱（6,975,767 个细胞）含一个专有数据集，挑战赛微调使用了针对测试扰动的外部数据。

title: CellRFT: Reinforcement Fine-Tuning for Single-Cell Perturbation Modeling
key_claim_en: Reinforcement fine-tuning of a diffusion perturbation model (PerturbDiff) using Cell-Eval metrics as policy-gradient rewards, averaged within then across metric categories. On Replogle (HepG2 target), scratch-model DEOver rose 0.190 to 0.236 and all 13 metrics improved; single-metric rewards mostly harmed other metrics (self-reported).
key_claim_zh: 用 Cell-Eval 指标作为策略梯度奖励，对扩散扰动模型（PerturbDiff）做强化微调，奖励先在类别内再跨类别平均。在 Replogle（HepG2 为目标）上，从头训练模型的 DEOver 由 0.190 升至 0.236，13 项指标全部改善；单指标奖励多会损害其他指标（自报）。
so_what_en: Metric suites behave as coupled objectives: single-metric rewards usually harm others, and a four-metric subset showed reward hacking (recall 0.382 to 0.833, precision falling). Balance rewards across categories.
so_what_zh: 指标套件表现为相互耦合的目标：单指标奖励通常会损害其他指标，四指标子集出现奖励投机（召回由 0.382 升至 0.833，精确率下降）。应在各类别间平衡奖励。
caveat_en: arXiv v1 read in full; self-reported, one dataset, code not released. Only MSE, MAE and ES were excluded from the rewards, and superiority over all baselines is claimed only on four differential-expression metrics.
caveat_zh: 已完整阅读 arXiv v1；自报，仅一个数据集，代码未发布。仅 MSE、MAE 和 ES 被排除在奖励之外，且只在四项差异表达指标上声称优于所有基线。

title: CellxPert: Inference-Time MCMC Steering of a Multi-Omics Single-Cell Foundation Model for In-Silico Perturbation
key_claim_en: Training-free steering of a masked-token multi-omic foundation model: a Metropolis-Hastings chain clamps perturbed genes, resamples 15% of the rest per step, and favors states near a perturbed-cell medoid. K562 predictions nearer the perturbed than control state: 94.6% versus 76.3% for one-shot imputation (self-reported).
key_claim_zh: 对掩码词元多组学基础模型做免训练的推理期引导：Metropolis-Hastings 链固定被扰动基因，每步重采样其余基因的 15%，并偏向接近扰动细胞中心点的状态。K562 中预测更接近扰动态而非对照态的比例：94.6%，一次性插补为 76.3%（自报）。
so_what_en: Template for guided design: clamp the intervention, resample the rest, accept moves toward a target state. It needs a same-perturbation anchor, so it steers rather than predicts unseen perturbations.
so_what_zh: 引导式设计的模板：固定干预、重采样其余部分、接受朝目标状态的移动。它需要同一扰动的锚点，因此是引导而非对未见扰动的预测。
caveat_en: Workshop paper (ICLR 2026), arXiv v1 read in full; self-reported. Steering targets come from training-split cells of the same perturbation, so unseen-perturbation prediction is not shown; only 224 of 1092 K562 targets passed the filters.
caveat_zh: ICLR 2026 研讨会论文，已完整阅读 arXiv v1；自报。引导目标来自同一扰动的训练划分细胞，因此未展示对未见扰动的预测；K562 的 1092 个靶点中仅 224 个通过筛选。

title: Cell reprogramming design by transfer learning of functional transcriptional networks
key_claim_en: Bulk-transcriptome control: eigengene KNN cell-type model plus a library of mean knockdown or overexpression responses, added linearly and solved by constrained least squares with a gene budget. AUROC 0.91 against 63 known reprogramming protocols (self-reported); authors report VAEs give comparable mean-expression predictions (SI, not read).
key_claim_zh: 基于批量转录组的控制方法：特征基因（eigengene）加 KNN 细胞类型模型，外加由基因敲低或过表达的平均响应构成的库；响应线性相加，用带基因数预算的约束最小二乘求解。对 63 个已知重编程方案的 AUROC 为 0.91（自报）；作者称 VAE 给出相当的平均表达预测（SI，未读）。
so_what_en: An interpretable additive action-selection baseline that nonlinear planners should beat; differential-expression lists alone mislead for perturbation combinations because off-target effects are not calibrated.
so_what_zh: 一个可解释的可加行动选择基线，非线性规划器应当超过它；对于扰动组合，仅靠差异表达基因列表会产生误导，因为脱靶效应没有被校准。
caveat_en: Published PNAS paper; SI Appendix not read. Bulk data, genetic not drug perturbations measured 24 to 96 h after induction, no genotype; abstract and Table 1 disagree on microarray cell-type and perturbation counts.
caveat_zh: 已发表于 PNAS；SI Appendix 未读。批量数据，扰动为遗传而非药物，在诱导后 24 至 96 小时测量，不含基因型；摘要与表 1 对微阵列的细胞类型数和扰动数不一致。

title: Getting Your Guidance Weights Right in diffusion and flow-matching posterior sampling
key_claim_en: Per-step guidance weights of training-free posterior sampling are fitted offline by two-parameter least squares from one minibatch of trajectories (known linear operator, images). After calibration, three different measurement-consistency terms converge to 32.91, 32.97 and 32.84 dB on FFHQ random inpainting (self-reported).
key_claim_zh: 训练无关后验采样中的逐步引导权重，用两参数最小二乘从一个小批量轨迹离线拟合（已知线性算子，图像）。校准后，三种不同的测量一致性项在 FFHQ 随机修复上收敛到 32.91、32.97 和 32.84 dB（自报）。
so_what_en: Guidance schedule, not likelihood sophistication, drove quality here; a calibrated schedule could replace the user-set multiple in WM28 loss guidance (inference; untested beyond linear imaging operators).
so_what_zh: 这里决定质量的是引导计划而非似然项的复杂程度；校准后的计划也许可以取代 WM28 损失引导中用户设定的倍数（推断；尚未在线性成像算子之外检验）。
caveat_en: arXiv v1 preprint (2 Oct 2026), code not yet released; self-reported imaging results with a known linear operator. At 50 steps the body, unlike the abstract, reports moderately worse LPIPS and FID.
caveat_zh: arXiv v1 预印本（2026 年 10 月 2 日），代码尚未发布；自报的成像结果，使用已知线性算子。在 50 步时，正文与摘要不同，报告 LPIPS 和 FID 略有变差。

title: On the Guidance of Flow Matching
key_claim_en: General flow-matching guidance for any source distribution and coupling (authors' 'first framework'): gradient-free Monte Carlo (asymptotically exact), trained, and gradient approximations recovering DPS, ΠGDM and LGD. Monte Carlo guidance was best on 7 of 9 offline-RL planning tasks but poor on image inverse problems.
key_claim_zh: 适用于任意源分布与耦合的通用流匹配引导（作者称“首个框架”）：无梯度的蒙特卡洛（渐近精确）、训练式，以及可还原 DPS、ΠGDM 和 LGD 的梯度近似。蒙特卡洛引导在 9 个离线强化学习规划任务中的 7 个最优，但在图像逆问题上表现差。
so_what_en: Choose by dimension and smoothness: exact Monte Carlo guidance suits low-dimensional smooth objectives, gradient approximations suit high-dimensional ones; diffusion-style guidance is inexact when the flow's source is not Gaussian.
so_what_zh: 按维度与平滑度选择：精确的蒙特卡洛引导适合低维平滑目标，梯度近似适合高维目标；当流的源分布不是高斯时，扩散式引导并不精确。
caveat_en: arXiv v3 (26 May 2025) read; it carries the ICML 2025 header, not compared with the PMLR version. Results are the authors' own; the method assumes a reverse-coupling ratio near 1.
caveat_zh: 已读 arXiv v3（2025 年 5 月 26 日）；它带有 ICML 2025 页眉，未与 PMLR 版本比对。结果为作者自报；该方法假设反向耦合比接近 1。

title: ESS-Flow: Training-free guidance of flow-based models as inference in source space
key_claim_en: Gradient-free guidance of a pretrained flow: elliptical slice sampling in the Gaussian source space needs only forward passes, so non-differentiable potentials work. On materials design, bulk-modulus error was 9.05 versus 26.67 for the next best (self-reported); 1200 MCMC steps, each needing a 50-step ODE solve.
key_claim_zh: 对预训练流的无梯度引导：在高斯源空间中做椭圆切片采样，只需前向计算，因此可用于不可微势函数。在材料设计上，体模量误差为 9.05，次优方法为 26.67（自报）；1200 个 MCMC 步，每步需要一次 50 步的 ODE 求解。
so_what_en: Option for non-differentiable design objectives (simulators, discrete readouts) where gradient guidance such as WM39 breaks; costs many forward passes and fails when the prior poorly informs the target.
so_what_zh: 适用于不可微设计目标（模拟器、离散读出），此时 WM39 等梯度引导会失效；代价是大量前向计算，且当先验对目标信息不足时会失败。
caveat_en: arXiv v1 (7 Oct 2025), marked 'Preprint. Under review'; self-reported results with author-adapted baselines on materials and one 147-residue protein, not cells. Protein runs needed 10 parallel chains because single chains got trapped.
caveat_zh: arXiv v1（2025 年 10 月 7 日），标注为“Preprint. Under review”；自报结果，基线由作者改造，仅在材料和一个 147 残基的蛋白上测试，未涉及细胞。蛋白实验因单链陷入模式而需要 10 条并行链。

title: ParetoTransport: Generative Optimization by Mass Transport Toward The Pareto Front
key_claim_en: Training-free guidance of a pretrained flow over designs toward the Pareto front: Wasserstein matching to proxy distributions plus a normal-direction improvement step controls convergence and spread along the front. Self-reported best average rank on ZDT and DTLZ benchmarks (60k offline designs, 2-3 objectives, 10-30 variables).
key_claim_zh: 对预训练流在设计空间上朝帕累托前沿做免训练引导：与代理分布的 Wasserstein 匹配加法向改进步骤，同时控制收敛与沿前沿的分布。在 ZDT 和 DTLZ 基准（60k 条离线设计，2-3 个目标，10-30 个变量）上平均排名最佳（自报）。
so_what_en: A candidate for multi-objective action planning, such as mutant kill versus wild-type sparing as a front rather than one KKT cap (inference); evidence is low-dimensional engineering benchmarks only.
so_what_zh: 可作为多目标行动规划的候选，例如把突变体杀伤与野生型保护表示为一条前沿，而不是单个 KKT 上限（推断）；证据仅来自低维工程基准。
caveat_en: arXiv v1 (7 Sep 2026), unreviewed; benchmark results are self-reported. The convergence theorem assumes exact Wasserstein matching, but the method runs 10 Adam steps per guided step; four or more objectives are left open.
caveat_zh: arXiv v1（2026 年 9 月 7 日），未经评审；基准结果为自报。收敛定理假设 Wasserstein 匹配是精确的，但该方法每个引导步只运行 10 步 Adam；四个或更多目标的情形未解决。

title: The Metric Picks the Winner: Evaluation Choice Flips Model Rankings for Drug-Response Prediction in Unseen Chemistry
key_claim_en: Unseen-chemistry prediction on THP-1 DRUG-seq (14,026 training compounds, scaffold split): ranking flips with the metric. Ridge on fingerprints wins under an inverse-variance proxy but ranks fifth of six under the contest's active-set weighted MSE, where a deep MLP leads (0.4977 versus 0.5390 mean baseline).
key_claim_zh: THP-1 DRUG-seq 上的未见化学结构预测（14,026 个训练化合物，骨架划分）：排名随指标翻转。在逆方差代理指标下，指纹岭回归居首，但在竞赛的活性集加权 MSE 下排第五（共六个），此时深度 MLP 领先（0.4977，均值基线为 0.5390）。
so_what_en: Score unseen-drug predictors with activity-weighted metrics on scaffold-held-out splits and report the mean baseline; a variance-weighted proxy crowned a linear model that the active-set metric ranks fifth of six.
so_what_zh: 评估未见药物预测器时，应在骨架留出的划分上使用按活性加权的指标并报告均值基线；方差加权的代理指标推举的线性模型，在活性集指标下只排第五（共六个）。
caveat_en: arXiv v1 hackathon preprint, self-reported; one cell line and dose; deep models on two scaffold folds only; test labels unavailable offline. Mean baseline 0.535 in text, 0.5390 in Table 3, 0.507 organizer reference.
caveat_zh: arXiv v1 黑客松预印本，自报；单一细胞系和剂量；深度模型只在两个骨架折上评估；测试标签离线不可得。均值基线在正文中为 0.535，表 3 中为 0.5390，组织者参考值为 0.507。

title: Benchmarking methods for inferring single-cell transcription factor activity using large-scale perturbation sequencing data
key_claim_en: Benchmark of eight single-cell TF-activity tools on 17 cell-line Perturb-seq datasets (174 perturbations of 135 TFs): mean AUROC for separating perturbed from control cells was 0.681 for metaTF, 0.645 for pySCENIC and 0.597 for decoupleR with CollecTRI.
key_claim_zh: 八种单细胞转录因子活性工具在 17 个细胞系 Perturb-seq 数据集（针对 135 个转录因子的 174 个扰动）上的基准：区分扰动细胞与对照细胞的平均 AUROC，metaTF 为 0.681，pySCENIC 为 0.645，使用 CollecTRI 的 decoupleR 为 0.597。
so_what_en: TF-activity readouts built on CollecTRI (KB20) separate perturbed from control cells only modestly (AUROC 0.597), so objectives that use them need their own validation.
so_what_zh: 基于 CollecTRI（KB20）的转录因子活性读出只能中等程度地区分扰动细胞与对照细胞（AUROC 0.597），因此使用它们的目标函数需要各自验证。
caveat_en: Published in Briefings in Bioinformatics 2026; Europe PMC full text read, supplementary tables not. Only genetic TF perturbations in cell lines (135 of 1423 TFs); no drug-induced response, genotype or in vivo data.
caveat_zh: 发表于 Briefings in Bioinformatics，2026 年；已读 Europe PMC 全文，未读补充表。仅有细胞系中的遗传性转录因子扰动（1423 个转录因子中的 135 个）；没有药物诱导响应、基因型或体内数据。
